articleTitle: Low Voltage Governance in Distribution Networks Based on Wide Range On-load Regulating Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The problem of over-radius of power supply is common in rural distribution network, which causes the problem of low voltage in terminal area. The existing distribution transformers in the station area have short regulation steps and a narrow range, which are not suitable for the current demand of low voltage management in the rural distribution network station area. To address this, this paper constructs a model of 10kV medium voltage distribution system and analyzes the distribution line length when low voltage occurs under typical operating conditions, so as to clarify the applicable range of wide range on-load regulating transformers. Through the research of a provincial distribution network regulating range needs, designed -5 ~ +15% regulating range, 5% wide step of the wide range of on-load regulators, its internal controller to take into account the unbalanced conditions of the regulating control strategy, in order to apply the three-phase unbalance caused by low voltage problems in the station area. A simulation study was conducted with the exit voltage data of a three-phase balanced low-voltage station area and a three-phase unbalanced low-voltage station area in Hunan province to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of using a wide range of on-load regulating transformers described in this paper to manage the low-voltage problem in the distribution network station area.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation of Lithium Battery Based on Extended Kalman Filter Optimized by Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Charge state of battery is one of the important parameters of battery. Accurate estimation of SOC can improve battery safety, prolong battery life and improve battery utilization efficiency. Straightforward valuation of battery SOC is very essential for retired electric vehicle batteries. The traditional SOC estimation method based on extended Kalman filter (EKF) is excessively dependent on the accurate battery model, and requires that the system noise must be subject to Gaussian white noise, and the SOC prediction error is large. To address the mentioned above existing problems, a method based on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) to correct the SOC error of Extended Kalman Filter is proposed to realize the accurate estimation of SOC. By comparing the experimental results, it can be obtained that its algorithm can accurate to predict SOC, and the error is within 1.3 %. and has good convergence and robustness, which has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Model of Distribution Network Reconfiguration Considering Soft Open Point
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High penetration of renewable distributed generation will bring great challenges to the security and stability of distribution network. Active distribution network reconfiguration technology and the application of soft open point are effective means to improve the reliability and economy of power system operation. This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization model of distribution network reconfiguration considering soft open point based on NSGA-II. The pareto front is generated by minimizing line loss and voltage offset of distribution network as two objective functions so that the decision-maker(DM) can obtain more feasible operation schemes and select the appropriate operation strategy for the distribution network. Finally, an example of IEEE 33 bus system is given to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Single-phase Grounding Fault Handling True Test of Primary and Secondary Integration Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, the accuracy rate of single-phase grounding fault disposal of column circuit breaker with primary and secondary integration is low, so it is urgent to carry out assessment and verification of single-phase grounding fault disposal. The single-phase grounding test in the operation site is subject to the influence of safety risk and user power supply reliability. It is not easy to carry out many times. In this paper, through the establishment of real distribution network test system, to achieve the rapid access of test objects, flexible reproduction of distribution network single-phase ground fault, put forward a complete set of circuit breaker on the primary and secondary fusion columns single-phase ground fault treatment true test method, effectively verify the primary and secondary fusion column circuit breaker single-phase ground fault disposal function and accuracy rate, found nine bad reasons. Through the establishment of real distribution network test platform, the quality of distribution network equipment access network is improved, and the reliability of distribution network power supply is further improved.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatching Strategy of Multi-terminal DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: DC distribution network is more friendly to access new power facilities such as renewable energy, flexible loads, and energy storage system (ESS), which is trend of future distribution network. Considering the stability, security and economy of the multi-terminal DC distribution network dispatching, not only the dispatching mode of the internal controllable resources such as ESS, but also the power of the converters at each terminal should be calculated. The optimal dispatching model is actually a multi-objective optimization problem. Based on the power flow calculation in normal state, this paper aims to optimize the economics of each distributed power source, the voltage quality and the loss of the DC distribution network, and comprehensively considers the devices operation constraints to establish a multi-objects optimal model and achieve secure and economical operation. Finally, a three-terminal DC distribution network is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed optimal dispatching strategy.

articleTitle: High Impedance Fault Detection Method Based on Sparsity of Traveling Wave Full Waveform Energy Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The transition resistance of high impedance fault (HIF) in distribution network can reach thousands of ohms. The fault characteristics are weak, and it is easy to be confused with normal transient disturbances (NTD), such as no-load line switching, load switching, capacitor switching. Therefore, the fault detection is very difficult. In this paper, the difference of traveling wave full waveform energy distribution between HIF and NTD is deeply analyzed: the energy distribution of HIF is relatively uniform, and the degree of sparseness is small; the energy distribution of NTD is relatively concentrated, and the degree of sparseness is large. Accordingly, a HIF detection method based on the energy distribution sparsity of the traveling wave full waveform is proposed. By calculating the sparseness factor of the time-frequency energy spectrum matrix of the traveling wave full waveform, the sparsity of the energy distribution is represented, and the HIF detection criterion is constructed to reliably identify the and NTD. Simulation analysis shows that this method can sensitively and reliably detect HIF in distribution networks up to 5kΩ.

articleTitle: Wide-area Monitoring and Analysis of Wide-band Oscillation in New-type Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The wide-band oscillation resulting from the interaction between power electronics and the power grid is increasingly evident to the power system. It is necessary to monitor the dynamic behavior of the wide-band oscillation. However, the existing phasor measurement unit (PMU) and the corresponding wide-area measurement system (WAMS) can hardly capture wide-band phasors. To get a better view of wide-band oscillation, a measurement method to capture wide-band phasors is proposed in this paper, as well as a frame of a corresponding wide-area monitoring system for wide-band oscillation (WOMS) is constructed. The prototype of the wide-band phasor measurement unit (WPMU)-based on this measurement method is developed. The essential software and hardware of the WPMU are elaborated. The steady tests and dynamic tests are executed to verify the capability of the WPMU. The results indicate that WPMU and WOMS are highly effective in analyzing wide-band oscillation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Distributed Photovoltaic on Power Quality of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the large-scale access of distributed photovoltaics to the distribution network, the large-scale, multi-point decentralized access, intermittent and random characteristics of distributed photovoltaics bring power quality problems such as voltage exceeding the upper limit and harmonics to the distribution network. This paper uses Matlab. 2020b-Simulink builds a model of distributed photovoltaics connected to the distribution network, focusing on the analysis of the impact of distributed photovoltaics on the voltage distribution and harmonics of the distribution network under different penetration rates.

articleTitle: Missing Data Reconstruction Method of Distribution Network based on RES-AT-UNET
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: When the power monitoring equipment in distribution network is affected by extreme events such as typhoon, thunderstorm and strong electromagnetic pulse, the measurement data is missing, the evaluation of equipment observability and availability cannot be realized effectively. The traditional data reconstruction method adopts linear interpolation method, which ignores the change rule of power system measurement data and context constraints, the reconstruction accuracy is very low. In this paper, a data missing value reconstruction method based on Residual Attention UNET(RES-AT-UNET) network is proposed. Considering the characteristics of distribution network and avoiding complex explicit modeling, the proposed method adopts the end-to-end model training method, which can still maintain the accuracy of data reconstruction in the case of missing large interval time series data. The experimental results show that the root mean square error of the data reconstructed by the proposed method is the smallest compared with the actual data, and the reconstruction model has strong applicability to the data under different missing rates.

articleTitle: Optimal Strategy for Distribution Network Considering the Dispatching Capability of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An optimal strategy for distribution networks considering EVs (Electric Vehicles) was proposed in this paper. Firstly, a behavioral model of EV based on HMM is established. Secondly, the corresponding data of EVs are obtained according to the model, including real-time state, spatial location, real-time energy, and so on. Next, an optimal strategy considering multi-source cooperation is established. Finally, the modified IEEE33 is taken as an example to obtain the Spatio-temporal state of the EV cluster in a day and conduct the distribution network optimization analysis. The results verify the effectiveness of the proposed model and strategy.

articleTitle: A Fault Line Selection Method for Small Current Grounding Systems Based on Zero-Mode Transient Information
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the result of grounding line selection is unsatisfactory and the reliability is difficult to make quantitative analysis of fault line identification method for distribution with neutral point grounding through the arc extinguishing coil, a fault line selection method based on zero-mode transient information with modified ensemble empirical mode decomposition is proposed. Firstly, this paper utilized zero-mode transient information to extract the fault information, because of the direction of fault line is in the opposite to the non-fault line during a fault grounding transient. Then, the extracted signals were decomposed by MEEMD and HHT transformation. Lastly, the simulation and analysis in PSCAD and MATLAB illustrated that the proposed method can exactly identify fault line for small current grounding systems and it has higher reliability and sensitivity.

articleTitle: Simulation Calculation and Influence Analysis of Ground Potential Distribution Caused by Metro Stray Current
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Metro stray current can cause ground potential changes. Reasonable assessment of the potential fluctuation range is of great significance to ensure the urban AC power grid safe operation. Based on the multi-resistor parallel equivalent calculation method, the three-dimensional spatial distribution of multiple conductors in the power supply system can be reduced to the planar distribution of a single conductor. Then the numerical distribution of metro stray currents was effectively modeled. Based on CDEGS simulation software, a coupled model of stray current distribution and ground electric field was built, and the ground potential distribution caused by metro stray current was realized. Based on the actual metro line topology and structural parameters, the influence of the number of trains, operating conditions and soil resistivity on the potential distribution was analyzed. The research results can provide a certain reference for the substations location selection and the grounding equipment corrosion protection near the metro lines.

articleTitle: Research on Large-scale Distributed Energy Cluster Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Driven by the goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutralization, the development of green energy has experienced a blowout growth. The problems such as reverse power flow and voltage quality of distribution network caused by the grid connection of a large number of distributed energy have brought many challenges to the safe and stable operation of large power grid, which has seriously affected and limited the development of distributed energy. In order to solve the problems of economic consumption and efficient utilization of a large-scale distributed energy and reduce the negative impact of large-scale distributed energy connection to power grid, this paper analyzes and studies the cluster control technology of large-scale distributed energy. Firstly, it analyzes the problems and challenges faced by large-scale power grid, distribution network, energy aggregators and power load terminal under the large-scale grid connection of distributed energy; Secondly, according to the different control demands of power grid companies and energy aggregators, different distributed energy cluster control solutions are given. The solutions deeply analyze the Data Acquisition scheme, control architecture and cluster division principle of cluster control, then introduce the application case of Xiangtan distributed energy management and control project. Finally the paper summarize and point out the development direction of cluster control system in the future.

articleTitle: Graph Theory-based Distribution System Reliability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reliability evaluation helps distribution system planning and regulation by quantitatively assessing the power supply capacity under uncertainty. Its role is highlighted by the increasing frequency of extreme weather. This paper proposes a method of distribution system reliability evaluation based on graph theory. First, the reliability model of distribution system components such as lines, transformers, and loads are established. According to component reliability parameters, the sequential Monte Carlo simulation is used to randomly sample component states to generate the sequential state transition process of components, based on which the system states can be obtained. Then, combined with the distribution system graph model, the zone partitioning and minimal path search is applied to evaluate distribution system states. Finally, the reliability indices of distribution systems are calculated according to the system state evaluation results. The proposed method is applied to Roy Billinton Test System (RBTS) bus2 to verify its effectiveness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on three-phase imbalance control strategy of low-voltage distribution station area
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Low-voltage distribution network because of its single-phase load quantity, strong randomness and other characteristics, lead to three-phase imbalance phenomenon for a long time, with the distributed generation of high proportion access, the three-phase imbalance problem further aggravated, so this paper proposes a low-voltage distribution station area three-phase imbalance control strategy, first through MATLAB simulation distribution network balance and imbalance two states, gives the phase conversion of system implementation scheme. Then, a multi-objective optimization model with the minimum number of switching times and the minimum three-phase current imbalance of the phase conversion device in the low-voltage distribution station area is established, and a solution method based on the fast non-dominant genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) is proposed, finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: IoT-based Electrical Safety Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis for Low-voltage Distribution Facilities
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An electrical safety monitoring and fault diagnosis system is designed and developed based on the IoT architecture for the operation and inspection management of 0.4kV low-voltage distribution facilities. The electrical safety IoT sensing terminal unit and edge computing gateway are used to collect multi-dimensional operational parameters, complete in-place fault diagnosis for low-voltage circuit breakers, and transmit data to the IoT software platform through 4G/5G communication network. The platform application software implements real-time online monitoring, alarming, and operation evaluation. The system has been proven to be effective in identifying potential electrical safety hazards in low-voltage distribution facilities, providing a decision-making basis for the power supply operation and inspection department to handle faults and speed up the repair process.

articleTitle: Harmonic pollution zoning method based on improved DBSCAN clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the diversification of new energy power generation methods and the access of a large number of power electronic loads, the problem of harmonic pollution in the power grid tends to be more complicated and more diversified, making it more difficult to trace the location of harmonic sources. Starting from the engineering application of harmonic tracing and using power quality monitoring data, a method of harmonic zoning tracing based on density clustering is proposed. Based on the characteristics of harmonic measurement data, DBSCAN (Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise), a time series clustering algorithm based on density is adopted. The method is based on a clustering concept which requires the number of objects contained in a certain area in the clustering space is not less than a given threshold, and the correlation information associated with harmonic pollution is mined. To improve the performance of the algorithm, K-Average Nearest Neighbor (K-ANN) algorithm and mathematical expectation method are introduced to solve the problem that the two important clustering parameters Eps and MinPts of this algorithm need to be manually set, and realize self-adaptation selection, thereby reducing the influence of human factors on the clustering results. The analysis shows that the proposed method can effectively realize the regional positioning of multi-harmonic sources. The position of the dominant harmonic source can be checked, and it is suitable for large-scale harmonic source access scenarios. Based on the data measured by the monitoring platform in a certain area, the practicability and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Sub-synchronous Oscillation Disturbance Path and Damping Characteristics of Photovoltaic Incorporated into Weak AC Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In photovoltaic power station integrated with weak AC power grid, the interaction between photovoltaic inverter control system and power grid impedance characteristics may lead to secondary synchronous oscillation (SSO) accident, which threatens the safe and stable operation of power grid. However, the disturbance paths within the system are rarely involved in the existing studies, which cannot further reveal the sub-synchronous interaction between the systems. To solve the above problems, this paper adopted a method combining closed-loop transfer function block diagram with damping torque method, deduced the SSO disturbance path, carried out the damping torque analysis of the disturbance path, and studied the influence of system parameters on the DC capacity-dominated SSO mode damping.The research results can provide a theoretical reference for the parameter design and damping controller design of photovoltaic power station in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Load Transfer Between Provinces and Localities Based on Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the provincial power grid and the prefecture-level power grid, the load transfer scheme selection based on risk analysis is carried out. First, it is necessary to locate the area where the load can be transferred after the fault, and obtain the loop set related to the faulty equipment, so as to determine the feasible load transfer path, and remove the infeasible load transfer path by loop classification. On this basis, the risk calculation of the feasible load transfer scheme is carried out, so as to obtain the optimal load transfer strategy.

articleTitle: Development and Application of 10kV Pole-mounted Fully Insulated and Visualized Load Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the urban distribution network, the safe operation of switchgear devices along 10kV overhead lines plays a vital role in power supply reliability. In 2019, State Grid Shanghai Urban Electric Power Company (SUEPC), as the first pilot unit on full insulation renovation for overhead lines in China, carried out the full insulation renovation project to reduce the number of tripping failures and improve the reliability of power supply in Shanghai urban area. Considering the insulation defect of 10kV overhead lines in Shanghai, SUEPC has developed a new 10kV pole-mounted fully insulated and visualized load switch (PFIVLS) to solve the problems that the traditional S&C-type pole-mounted load switch (PLS) has an exposed blade so that the tripping failures caused by the contact of foreign matters such as small animals often occur, and the ZW-32-type fully enclosed PLS has no apparent breakpoint, which makes it difficult to carry out maintenance work under the premise of safety. According to the characteristics of PFIVLS, this paper proposes three scenarios that PFIVLS can be applied: a) the renovation of section switches and tie switches along overhead lines; b) the installation of pole- climb joints for crossover cables; c) the replacement of drop-out fuses for medium-voltage users. Engineering practice demonstrated that the new device could effectively reduce the tripping rate of 10kV overhead lines, shorten the repair time, and enhance the safety of power grid operation in contrast with traditional PLS, which helped SUEPC become the first prefectural electric power company in China to achieve Average Service Availability Index (ASAI) of power supply reliability above 99.999% in 2020.

articleTitle: Research on AC/DC Hybrid Distribution System in Multi-station Integration Project Based on Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the multi-station integration project, the DC power supply and load of substations, data center stations, photovoltaic power stations, energy storage stations, electric vehicle charging stations and 5G base stations are increasing rapidly. The traditional power distribution system is difficult to meet the requirement of multi-voltage DC equipment In addition, electric energy needs to be converted multiple times, reducing efficiency. The advantages and disadvantages of the traditional AC power distribution system scheme and the AC/DC power distribution system scheme are analyzed. On the basis of the traditional scheme, in order to give full play to the advantages of the DC distribution system and energy routers, an AC/DC distribution system scheme based on energy routers in multi-station integration project is proposed to realize the flexible interconnection of AC/DC power systems and multiple DC voltage level output, to improve the reliability, flexibility and versatility of the system. The topological structure and operating mode of the system are discussed, and the working mode and control strategy of energy routers and battery energy storage converters are proposed.

articleTitle: Empirical Research of Single Phase-to-Earth Faults in Distribution Network with Different Neutral Point Grounding Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For a long time, there has been no consensus on what grounding method should be used for the neutral point of the distribution network. Especially when a single phase-to-earth fault occurs in the distribution network, there is a great controversy over whether to use the neutral point to ground through the arc suppression coil or to use the neutral point to ground through a low resistance, which not only involves the reliability of power supply, but also involves personal safety issues. However, most of the fault handling devices can only obtain fault characteristic data through simulation or some line fault waveforms. And there is a lack of comparative research on single phase-to -earth fault characteristics under different neutral point grounding methods in real line conditions. In order to better analyze the characteristics of different neutral point grounding methods, a 10kV real distribution network empirical test network with switchable neutral point grounding methods was built, and the true-type test of single phase-to-earth cable arcing fault with 3 kinds of neutral grounding methods is carried out under almost the same environmental conditions and line conditions. Finally, recommendations based on true-type empirical test results are given.

articleTitle: Research on application scenarios and control strategies of large-scale energy storage in power flow control of new-type power system
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A control strategy of large-scale energy storage in power flow control is proposed aiming at the short time overload problem in power system during the peak load period, in case of elements failure, or caused by fluctuation of renewable power sources such as wind and solar. Firstly, the application scenarios of large-scale energy storage in power flow control is described. Secondly, an optimal control nodes selection method based on the comprehensive control sensitivity is proposed. Then, based on the principle of minimum unbalanced power, the charging and discharging power of each controllable node is determined by using the reverse and equivalent match method. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy are verified based on the improved IEEE RTS 24-Bus system.

articleTitle: Insulator instance segmentation based on deep learning network Mask RCNN
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of power supply line construction, stable power transmission provides the necessary living security for each family, but large-scale power grid maintenance has become a difficult problem for the relevant enterprise departments and an important direction of technological innovation. Transmission line inspection is an important responsibility of the power grid maintenance department. The traditional way is to manually rely on ground transportation or low-altitude manned flight for real-time monitoring. There are great challenges in labor intensity and operating conditions. Modern power grid inspection appears to be based on unmanned aerial vehicles, robots, but relatively backward, low precision recognition algorithm restricts the development of the field. This paper is based on the high-precision instance segmentation algorithm Mask RCNN to realize the identification and image segmentation of power grid insulators, and provide data sources for further image post-processing. The main idea of this paper is to analyze the working background of power inspection at this stage, analyze the development history of target detection field and explain the innovation module and development process of Mask RCNN, and finally verify the feasibility of insulator detection by building a real scene.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Flow Analysis Method with Carbon-Negative Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The scale of biomass power generation industry in China is expanding. Biogas power generation technology in the distribution network is an important part of biomass power generation. In the current carbon emission flow analysis theory, carbon emission generating units and zero-carbon generating units are often discussed. Based on the analysis method of carbon emission flow, this paper further analyzes the carbon reduction benefits of negative carbon sources such as biogas power generation. This paper establishes the carbon emission flow calculation method of biogas generating units, and verifies the feasibility of the method through the example.

articleTitle: An Improved Fuzzy Neural Network Method for SOC Estimation of Lithium-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the application of lithium-ion battery more and more widely, the research on the estimation of the state of charge (SOC) of lithium ion battery has become a hot topic, which can effectively ensure the safety and stability of lithium ion battery. In this paper, an improved fuzzy neural network (IFNN) is proposed for SOC estimation. Compared with traditional methods, IFNN does not need to establish a specific lithium-ion battery model, but only needs data to obtain the complex nonlinear relationship of lithium-ion battery. In order to verify the effectiveness of IFNN, 18650-20R lithium ion battery is selected as the experimental object of this paper. The research results show that IFNN is used for SOC estimation, the mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) are both at a very low level, and the final estimation error is less than 1%, which indicates that IFNN has a good estimation performance.

articleTitle: A primary and secondary equipment integrated intelligent distribution system breaker to better locate and isolate faults
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As electrification deepens and the society relies more and more on electricity, dependability and safety standard of the power distribution system becomes higher and higher. What’s more, to minimize carbon emission, high percentage of renewable energy resources penetration is becoming a reality, which further complicates the distribution system. Because of equipment failure, animal intrusion and other causes, power system faults are inevitable. Fault section identification, location and isolation is a critical mission in distribution system operation [1]. As the distribution system develops and evolves, two main ways to accomplish this goal were established in distribution system: a) Substation overcurrent relay detects the fault and the corresponding substation breaker isolates the fault Then trial-and-error method is used to identify and isolate the fault section; b) Distributed sensors are deployed in the distribution system. Distribution system automation software in the operation center then collects fault information sent from all the distributed sensors. Operation stuff make a judgement on the fault section and fault isolation is done on a remote control or manual operation fashion.These methods leave a lot of room for improvements, which will be elaborated in the paper. A primary and secondary equipment integrated intelligent distribution system breaker is proposed, depending on which the shortcomings of the aforementioned methods can be overcome. This integrated breaker acquires and analyzes traveling wave signals and fundamental frequency signals, and then locate and isolate faults based on fault analysis results under various scenarios, including renewable energy resources integration. With this breaker, fault location accuracy and fault isolation selectivity and speed can be improved, which helps with distribution system reliability, safety, and economic operation.

Author Keywords: primary and secondary equipment integrated distribution breaker

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Current Distribution Characteristics of Multi-column Parallel Zinc Oxide Resistors
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to enhance the energy absorption capacity and reduce residual voltage, multi-column parallel structure has been widely adopted in AC Ultra-high voltage and DC High voltage arresters. Under impulse currents, the current distribution characteristics of multi-column ZnO resistors directly affect the energy absorption capacity of arresters. In this paper, impulse current tests were carried out for 4-column parallel ZnO resistors, and the effects of impulse current amplitude, waveform and temperature on the current distribution characteristics of multi-column parallel ZnO resistors were studied. The results show that the non-uniformity of impulse shunting increases with the increase of the temperature difference between the ZnO resistor columns, and decreases with the increase of the impulse current frequency.

articleTitle: Research on model predictive control of large energy storage inverter based on MMC topology
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) and Model predictive control (MPC) are all central issues recently. But the high computing capacity, high switching frequency, and weighting factors of the cost function are difficult to tune appropriately limite the application in industry. To solve these issues, this paper proposes a method of switch state optimization and integrated Control method which Contains capacitor voltage balancing and circulating current suppression. Combinations of switching state can be reduced from the traditional $C_{2N}^N$ to between 1 and N by proposed optimization, and reducing the switching frequency effectively. The three control targets proposing of AC side current tracking, capacitor voltage balancing and circulating current suppression is as follow: The input number of sub-modular of the upper and lower bridge is based on the AC side current predictive control module firstly, capacitor voltage balancing and circulation suppression use an integrated control method to avoid the problem of the three control targets scale factors. Compared to the traditional model predictive control methods, the proposed method has less switch states calculation, low switching frequency and better output preformence without tuning weighting factors of cost function. An MMC system has been developed in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Single phase grounding fault detection and section location method based on non power frequency signal injection
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of detection and location of existing distribution automation terminals under the condition of high resistance ground fault in resonant grounded distribution network, this paper proposes a single-phase ground fault detection and section location method based on non power frequency signal injection. Based on the permanent grounding fault of distribution network, firstly, the active flexible grounding device is used to inject the small signal of non power frequency characteristic current into the neutral point of distribution network, and the non power frequency current amplitude is extracted through the detection of distribution automation terminal on the fault feeder. According to the difference of non power frequency characteristic current amplitude between normal and fault areas, a fault location criterion based on the ratio of section current to threshold amplitude is proposed to realize the accurate location of fault areas. The influence of injection signal parameters on ground fault detection and location methods is further analyzed, and the injection size and optimal frequency band of non power frequency signal are selected. The simulation results show that this method has strong resistance to high resistance and high accuracy, and can realize the accurate location of fault section under a wide range of grounding resistance.

articleTitle: Construction Method of Digital Twin Model for Distribution Automation Terminal
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the core unit of distribution automation system, the stable operation of distribution automation terminal plays an important role in distribution network. In this context, the five-layer architecture of the digital twin of distribution automation terminal and the technical path are proposed, and then the key problems in the modeling process are analyzed, the key problems in the modeling process are analyzed, the cyber physical system (CPS) and IEC 61850 modeling methods are used to construct the digital thread layer model and digital modeling layer model, and then the foundation is laid for advanced applications of distribution automation such as health assessment, fault diagnosis and intelligent operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: A Novel Longitudinal Differential Protection Method for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Low-voltage DC power distribution system has obvious advantages in distributed power supply grid connection, power supply quality and power dispatch management, which is an important way to transform the traditional power system to low-carbon and environment-friendly power system. It has become a research hotspot in the field of electric energy internet today. Low-voltage DC system makes fault identification a difficult problem due to the rapid development of faults and numerous distributed energy sources. In this paper, we propose a longitudinal directional differential protection method based on variable slope multi-stage delay, which solves the problem of traditional differential protection scheme insensitive to high transition resistance and improves the selectivity of protection.

articleTitle: Research on DVR Compensation Limit Considering the Influence of Power Distribution System Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: There is compensation limit for the series-and -shunt connected dynamic voltage restorer (DVR), which cannot fully compensate all voltage sag cases. To deeply discuss this problem, this paper establishes a voltage divider model for a voltage sag for 10kV power distribution system, and the Thevenin equivalent circuit and mathematical expression of the model are derived and analyzed before and after voltage sag. The relationship between DVR compensation capacity and power distribution system parameters is shown, and the principle for voltage sag compensation is revealed through the volt-ampere characteristic curve. It is pointed out that whether the sag voltage can be fully compensated by DVR or not depends on the intersection between source volt-ampere characteristic curve and load rated power curve. Then the maximum output power of equivalent source and corresponding DVR compensation limit are derived by mathematical methods. Finally, the correctness of the above theory is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Integrated energy system planning of airport terminal building using distributed robust optimization method
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the uncertainty of passenger flow and meteorology, the cooling, heating, power load and new energy power output in the comprehensive energy system of the airport terminal are random, so it is difficult to predict their random distribution characteristics and parameters. Therefore, a distributed robust optimization method is used to solve the optimal planning problem of its integrated energy system. An optimization planning model of airport terminal integrated energy system with CVaR constraints is established, and the model is transformed into a distributed robust optimization model by referring to the robust idea, which is further transformed into a deterministic semi-definite programming by the Lagrangian duality principle. The simulation results show that compared with CVaR, the investment cost increases after considering the distributed robust optimization; with the increase of the range of the uncertainty set, the total cost of the system increases; Using different confidence levels will have different emphasis on the economy and low carbon benefits of the planning scheme, and provide reference for decision makers with different preferences.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Distribution Network Operation Strategy and Power Distribution in Distributed Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study the operation strategy and daily power distribution of distributed energy system distribution network, this paper puts forward the operation strategy of distributed energy system distribution network, determines 12 operation modes based on preferential electric-hydrogen conversion, and establishes the mathematical model of each module of distributed energy system. Set the operation strategy based on the top and bottom grid simulation platform control logic of the distributed energy system, studies the typical daily load and a family day light intensity on the basis of the distributed energy system of distribution network operation condition, and analyzes the variety electric power distribution and the running status of each module, for the distributed energy system provides a model based on distribution network operation.

articleTitle: Optimization Based Distribution Network Fault Location Method Using PMU Information
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an important part of the construction of smart grids, distribution network fault location technology has received widespread attention to improve the level of grid automation. However, the complex structure and poor measurement conditions of distribution network have seriously restricted its application. By applying the synchronous vector information of Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU), this article proposes an optimization-based method to determine the fault location for distribution networks and realizes the fault location of various types. In this method, the voltage and current synchronous vector information provided by the PMU constitutes the optimization objective functions based on the voltage-current relationship. By solving these functions, the fault section and the accurate fault location can be obtained. In addition, the effectiveness of the proposed method when PMU information is missing is also discussed. The simulation results of PSCAD software show that the method is effective for various fault types in distribution network with distributed generation, and is still possible to provide effective fault section and accurate fault location in case of information loss.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Planning Method in Distribution Network Side Considering Distributed Generation Access
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The State issued the Implementation Plan for Solving the Problem of Abandoning Water, Wind and Photovoltaic Power, which shows that the State attaches great importance to the utilization rate of renewable energy. In order to solve the problem of abandoning wind and photovoltaic power, the consumption of new energy can be carried out from the demand side response and the planning and allocation of energy storage capacity. The two factors influence each other, so the planning of energy storage capacity is very important. Starting from the distribution network side, on the basis of distributed generation with wind and photovoltaic power, and considering the demand side response, capacity planning of energy storage system is carried out. Firstly, the wind and photovoltaic power generation model and load model are established, then the demand side response cost and wind and photovoltaic power abandonment cost are quantified, and the operation cost model of distribution network is established, with the minimum operation cost of distribution network as the planning objective. Finally, the particle swarm optimization algorithm mentioned in the above chapter is used to solve the model, and the planned capacity of energy storage system is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Ride-Through Control of Power Conversion System in Energy Storage Converter Under Unbalanced Grid Voltage Fault Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at when there is an imbalance in the grid voltage, which will cause the problem of the energy storage system output active power fluctuation even caused the failure condition, this research presents a fault ride-through control strategy of the active reactive power fluctuation suppression based on the instantaneous power theory and weighted thoughts. This paper's recommended control strategy does not require phase-locking of the grid voltage, and it also does not need to separate control of the positive and negative sequence currents, completing a stable output to the output power. The simulation experiment results has verified the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: A study on the characteristics of transient active power output in a doubly-fed wind field
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The transient behavior of active power in a doubly-fed wind field after symmetrical fault during fault crossing is studied. Firstly, by analyzing the mathematical model of doubly-fed fan, the stand-alone short-circuit current is derived during fault ride-through, considering phase angle jump and phase-locked loop. Then, using the network structure of the wind farm, the interaction and acting factors of the active power of multi-wind turbines are analyzed, and the interaction law between wind turbines in the transient process is explored. Finally, the correctness of the analysis results is verified on the matlab/simulink platform, and the reactive power transient characteristics of the wind farm during fault crossing are accurately described, which provides a theoretical basis for the research and application of the transient characteristics and active output of the large-scale doubly-fed wind field composed of multi- machine parallel connection.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Chance-constrained Optimization Method for an Active Distribution Network Considering DG Actively Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The high proportion of Distributed generation (DG) connecting to the grid changes the operation characteristics of distribution network, and the traditional deterministic reactive power optimization method is difficult to adapt to the challenge brought by the uncertainty of DG operation. Therefore, a reactive power opportunity constraint optimization method for active distribution network taking into account the active regulation cost of DG is proposed. Constructed by power flow equations are linearized, and DG reactive active regulation of reactive power optimization model of mixed integer second order cone. Based on the reactive power of the traditional on-load voltage regulating and parallel compensation, the reactive power regulation means is expanded, considering DG adjustment cost and the number of traditional reactive power regulation constraints. Scene cut method is used to simplify the solving process, The optimal network loss and the minimum adjustment cost are realized. An example shows that compared with the traditional deterministic reactive power optimization method, the proposed method has higher robustness in dealing with the reactive power regulation problem caused by the uncertainty of DG operation.

articleTitle: A DFIG Harmonic Suppression Method Based on Resonance Control in DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: DC distribution network provides favorable conditions for large-scale access of distributed clean power, improves energy efficiency and reduces carbon emissions. Aiming at the harmonic problem caused by a low-cost topology doubly fed induction generator with uncontrolled rectifier bridge on the stator side in direct current distribution network, this paper analyzes the generation mechanism of harmonic current on the stator side of the topology, and then proposes a harmonic suppression method based on resonance control, so that the rotor side converter can suppress the harmonic current without affecting the fundamental control strategy of doubly fed induction generator, the maximum power point tracking algorithm can still be used. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by both simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: A study of Hybrid reactive Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The demands of power grid are not only increasing for active power, but also reactive power which related to the stability, economy, and reliability of power grid operation. As the installed capacity of the power grid increasing, the demands for large-capacity reactive power compensation equipment are also increased. At present, SVC and STATCOM are the two of the most widely used around world compensation equipment based on power electronic device. A combination of SVC and STATCOM would create a brand new kind of reactive compensation technology. Firstly, this paper introduce the structure of SVC and STATCOM, and the working principle of them. Secondly, the Hybrid compensation equipment is discussed. Thirdly, a detailed was designed control system for the hybrid compensation. Fourthly, a detailed compare for different reactive compensation is shown to find the difference of these schemes. The VI characteristic curve of reactive power compensation equipment can also see the difference of the three compensation scheme, SVC has better performance of over load, and STATCOM has better performance at the under load point. Finally, a simplified case study has been discussed. It could be found from the comparison and analysis of different devices in different aspects that the hybrid reactive power compensation device has good performance and a wide application scenario in the future large-capacity reactive power compensation market

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Ventilation and Heat Dissipation of 12kV Ring Main Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Condensation in high voltage switch cabinet will lead to serious internal insulation failure. In this paper, the switch cabinet condensation prevention technology is summarized and based on the 12kV ring main unit, the temperature and air flow distribution in the switch cabinet are simulated. The results show that the hottest place in the cabinet is the busbar in contact box, the temperature of the cabinet is higher when the contact box is closed and the highest temperature is at the busbar of the contact box. Sealing the contact box and installing heater in the cabinet can effectively raise the temperature of the cable chamber in the cabinet, and inhibit the formation of condensation. This study has reference value and guiding significance for the prevention and control of condensation in switch cabinet.

articleTitle: Research on User Loss Contribution Calculation of High-Loss Distribution Area Based on Transfer Entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the line loss management of low voltage distribution table area, it is difficult for power company to manage line loss because of the abnormal behavior of users and the behavior of stealing power. In this paper, the contribution of user loss is calculated by transfer entropy algorithm for users in high-loss area. Copula entropy is used for nonparametric estimation to improve computational performance. After ranking the loss contribution degree of users, targeted measures should be taken to rectify the loss contribution degree of users of different degrees. This method can effectively improve the efficiency of line loss management and reduce the overall line loss rate of the distribution area.

articleTitle: Real-time Simulation of Large-scale Wind Farm Based on Improved Transmission Line Decoupling Model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study the impact of large-scale wind farms on the security and stability of power grids, efficient simulation of large-scale wind farms becomes very important. In this paper, a transmission line decoupling method is proposed and a power equivalent model is built. An equivalent system of a large-scale wind farm was modeled with the proposed equivalent model and a permanent magnet synchronous generator based wind turbine. To validate the proposed method and model, the equivalent system is implemented with CloudPSS platform. The accuracy of the power equivalent model is verified by comparing with electromagnetic transient simulation results between the proposed model and a conventional wind farm model. Moreover, the power equivalent model greatly improves the simulation efficiency of the large-scale wind farm and makes it meet the real-time simulation requirements. In the case study, the large-scale wind farm equivalent model is added to a distribution network and a real-time simulation is performed. The real-time capability and correctness of the model are verified by comparing with the results between real-time and offline simulations. The model proposed in this paper can also be used for renewable energy stability analysis and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Power Grid Disaster Prevention and Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The impact of natural disasters on power equipment has the characteristics of strong suddenness, wide range and great damage. In recent years, the cases of large-scale failures of power transmission and transformation equipment due to natural disasters have increased, resulting in huge safety and economic losses caused by equipment damage or power outages. Machine learning (ML) is a research hotspot in various fields at present, and the integration of ML makes the power grid prevention and control work more intelligent. This paper first introduces the traditional theory and cutting-edge directions of ML, and then introduces the algorithm principles by taking CNN and LSTM as examples. Starting from the important work of power grid disaster prevention and control, the application of ML in disaster monitoring and early warning, grid fault prediction and location, and emergency response scheduling decision is discussed.

articleTitle: Distributed Multi-node Slicing Model and Application Analysis for Power Information Collection Scene
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the proposal of the goal of "carbon peaking and carbon neutralization", blockchain technology has played an important role in the new power system under the dual carbon goal. Aiming at the data security problem in the current power consumption information collection scenario, a distributed multi node slicing model based on blockchain is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the traditional power information acquisition system is introduced. Secondly, the feasibility and advantages and disadvantages of the integration of traditional power information acquisition system and blockchain system are compared and analyzed. Then, aiming at the problems of stealing, tampering and destruction in the process of data transmission and storage in the power information collection business, an example and application analysis are carried out. The results show that this model improves the security and reliability of power information data, and ensures that the data is not tampered and damaged. Finally, the full text is summarized, and the prospect of power consumption information acquisition scene under the double carbon goal in the future is prospected.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Low Frequency Control Strategy of MMC Driven Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has large voltage fluctuation of sub module capacitor under low-frequency working conditions, which limits its application range. This paper improves the control strategy of modular multilevel controller under low-frequency working conditions, supplemented by the necessary sub module hardware matching selection method, which can further reduce the circulating current and improve the system performance. The effectiveness of the control strategy and selection method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow of Distribution Network Considering Comprehensive Flexibility Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with independent scheduling, electro-thermal coupling scheduling can effectively reduce operating costs and improve renewable energy consumption. Based on the unified energy path theory, the heating network is analyzed and modeled. Based on the conservation of momentum, mass and energy, the water path model and heat path model of the heating network are constructed. Derive the water equations of the heating network as well as the equations of the heat circuits. Establish an optimal scheduling model for electrothermal coupling multi-energy flow system, using the unified energy flow method to calculate the heating network can be unified with the power system in multiple time scales. The results show that the optimal scheduling model established in this paper can improve the scheduling flexibility and solve accuracy.

articleTitle: Mitigation of High Frequency Oscillation in Converter Connected to Weak Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High penetration of power electronic equipment in distribution system lifts a new stability concern, converter-driven stability. High frequency oscillation occurs when a converter is connected to a weak AC distribution network, this research discusses the principle of oscillation and mitigation method. The small-signal model of PLL reveals the interaction between converter and network, and finds the oscillation component feedback path in controller. A supplementary damping control is proposed to increase system damping through outer reactive power controller, and a virtual impedance compensation is suggested in inner current controller to promote the robustness of feedforward voltage. Simulation of a grid-connected converter system validates the oscillation principle and demonstrates the effectiveness of proposed mitigation methods.

articleTitle: Reactive power and voltage optimization model of distribution network based on source-load interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy power generation and energy storage technology, emerging power sources and loads such as wind turbines, photovoltaic generator sets and electric vehicles have been accessed to the distribution network in large quantities, making it more difficult to manage the voltage in the distribution network. In this paper, the uncertainties faced by the distribution network in the new energy environment are analyzed. A new control method for regulating flexible load power, distributed energy storage charge and discharge power and distributed power reactive power output has been added. And a multi-objective opportunity constraint programming model for reactive voltage with the goal of minimizing line loss and voltage deviation is established for distribution network.

articleTitle: An Operation Mode of Shared Energy Storage for Improving Rural Power Grid Voltage
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The problem of low voltage has long plagued the power supply of remote rural power grid in China. One of the effective means to improve the terminal voltage and ensure the safety of electricity is to configure energy storage at the end of rural power grid users. Due to the high investment in energy storage equipment, income and cost are difficult to coordinate, this paper proposes a shared energy storage operation mode to improve the voltage of rural power grid. Considering the power flow constraints, terminal voltage security constraints of rural power grid, the charging and discharging power constraints, and state of charge constraints of shared energy storage, the optimal operation model of shared energy storage is constructed to maximize benefits of energy storage operators. The decision variables are the active power and reactive power output by the energy storage system, and the multidimensional dynamic programming algorithm is applied. Finally, through the example analysis, it is verified that considering the auxiliary service of voltage regulation can achieve higher economic benefits, and effectively improve voltage quality of end users of rural power grid.

articleTitle: Routing Planning Strategy of Energy Router Based Power Distribution Systems Considering Transmission Line Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy internet is a new generation of integrated energy system with electric power as its hub and platform. Energy router is the basic equipment of future energy internet, so it is very important to study routing planning strategies. Existing studies only propose planning schemes with the objective of minimizing power losses, but a single planning objective cannot meet the needs of the continuously developing distribution network. Transmission lines in distribution network may occur fault due to internal and external factors of power system. In order to improve the reliability of power supply in distribution network, this paper proposes a multipath routing planning strategy which considers the conversion losses of energy router, transmission losses of transmission line and transmission line fault rate. The routing planning strategy proposed in this paper adopts multiple paths to transmit power, which can effectively reduce the power transmission losses between energy routers, prevent power transmission congestion in transmission lines, and adaptively allocate the transmission power of different paths, thus improving the reliability of power supply in distribution network. The effectiveness of the proposed routing planning strategy is verified by simulation, and compared with conventional multipath routing planning strategy, the superiority of the proposed strategy is verified.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Treatment of a Newly Put into Operation 220kV Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In view of the abnormal problem of the insulating oil chromatography data of a newly put into operation 220kV transformer, two methods of insulating oil chromatography test and high-voltage electrical test were used to analyze the fault, and the main transformer fault was located at the position of the bushing joint lead position, determine the main transformer for installation process quality problems to produce magnetic flux leakage, leading to thermal cracking occur insulating oil overheating. According to the inspection results of the disassembly of the transformer returned to the factory, it was determined that the cause of the fault was the wrong assembly of the medium voltage B-phase first-end terminal and the bushing, resulting in local overheating, which confirmed the accuracy of the theoretical and experimental analysis, and effectively avoided the transformer failure caused by the expansion of the transformer. It also provides analysis and handling experience for fault diagnosis and defect handling after abnormal chromatography data of transformer insulating oil.

articleTitle: Simulation of wide range on-load voltage regulation technology in distribution network low voltage management
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wide range on-load regulation is a key technology for low-voltage management in low-voltage distribution networks. For the influence factors such as low voltage of upper-level lines, long supply radius that cannot be shortened and unavoidable seasonal load fluctuations, setting wide range on-load regulating transformers can effectively cope with them. Using PSCAD simulation software to build a 10KV distribution network line model, we tested the impact of line supply radius and load changes on the voltage of low-voltage customers, and achieved the treatment effect by adjusting the transformer ratio to raise the outlet voltage of the distribution transformer of the line with low voltage phenomenon. The test results show that the low-voltage user voltage is affected by the length of 380V line more than the length of the upper 10KV line, only need to adjust the voltage once to +2.5% file to meet the load growth to 110% of the apparent power of the transformer without the phenomenon of low voltage. When each branch line year-on-year increase to 100% of the transformer output of the apparent power, only the first two lines do not need to be adjusted to 5% gear. Based on the above simulation test content, the governance strategy for the supply radius and different load conditions is discussed, which provides a reference for the application of wide range on-load regulating transformer in the distribution network low voltage governance.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Method for Green Development Capability of Distribution Transformer Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the national goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” and corresponding policy requirements, green supply chain management has become an increasingly important means of reducing carbon emissions. As an important part of green supply chain, the evaluation of green development ability of green suppliers has become an important link. Aiming at the balanced development between enterprise business activities and green and low-carbon, this paper tentatively puts forward a set of evaluation index system of green development capability of distribution transformer suppliers, calculates the index score by using the efficacy coefficient method, and obtains the evaluation level of green development capability of suppliers. The evaluation method has certain application value for the selection of green distribution transformer suppliers and the improvement of their own green development ability.

articleTitle: Analytical Method for Reliability Evaluation of Distribution System Considering Multiple Faults
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the disturbance of extreme events, multiple components of the distribution system will fail simultaneously. However, most evaluation of multiple faults impacts is based on the Monte Carlo simulation method, which takes a long time to calculate. This paper presents three analytical methods for evaluating the reliability of distribution system under multiple faults from the perspectives of customers, components and system. The customer and component perspectives are at the micro level, and the system perspective is at the macro level. The evaluation results of the two levels are slightly different. This paper analyzes the differences between the three methods. The concept of effective failure probability is proposed to prevent the repeated calculation of the impact of simultaneous failure of multiple components on the same load. Finally, the proposed methods are verified on a modified IEEE 37-node feeder test system.

articleTitle: Power Supply Restoration of Active Distribution Systems considering Distributed Renewable Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing maturity of renewable energy (e.g., wind energy, solar energy) power generation technology, distributed power generation based on renewable energy receiving increasing attention. However, the penetration of DGs increases the fault levels of the power distribution system, and hence increases the operational risks to power supply reliability and security. This paper presented a power supply restoration solution of active distribution systems considering distributed renewable generation. The proposed solution is assessed through simulation experiments based on the case study of a 53-bus test network for a range of operational scenarios and the numerical results demonstrated the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Impedance Analysis of PMSG Considering Influence of Machine Side Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the installed proportion of the permanent magnet synchronous generators(PMSG), the phenomenon of oscillation caused by PMSG wind farms occurs frequently. The impedance modeling to analyze the dynamic characteristics of PMSG need to be studied as the basis of stability analysis. This paper presents an impedance modeling of PMSG under synchronous reference (dq) frame considering the dynamic characteristics of DC machine Side. Then the effect of factors on impedance characteristics are analyzed. Finally, the impedance scanning is carried out in Matlab, and the validity of the impedance modeling proposed in this paper get verified.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on the Condensation of Characteristics of 12kV Ring Main Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Ring main unit is widely used in power distribution system, but the condensation of ring main unit will cause the failure of switchgear and harm the safety of power system. According to statistics, flashover accidents caused by condensation account for a large proportion of the accidents occurring in the switchgear. In this paper, the relationship between the top ventilation grille, the structure of the contact box, the heater position and working current and condensation was experimentally studied by using a 12kV ring main unit. The results show that the humidity of the busbar room decreases when the ventilation grid exists, but it has little influence on the temperature in the cabinet. The outlet of the busbar of the contact box is blocked, which can effectively reduce the airflow flow in the cabinet and help to reduce the humidity in the switchgear. After sealing the outlet of busbar, the humidity in the cabinet can be reduced by 20%. The dehumidification effect is better when the heater works close to the side wall. The higher the working current, the better the condensation inhibition in the switch cabinet.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Topology Analysis Method for Large-scale Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing number of distribution grid equipment, the scale of distribution grids becomes larger and larger, and the structure becomes more and more complex. Efficiently storing, managing and analyzing massive distribution grid topological data is the key to improving the digitization and intelligence level of grids. Aiming at constructing a large-scale distribution grid topology analysis platform, firstly, the graph model representation and construction method of grid data is designed, and a grid topology data storage method based on the distributed graph database is proposed. Then, optimizing the storage structure and using a hot cache policy accelerates the topology analysis speed of large-scale grid graph data; The unified graph model representation for grid historical data improves topology analysis capability and data utilization rate. Finally, a topology analysis platform for large-scale data is built to support applications in distribution grids. The experiment results show that compared with the traditional method, the proposed grid topology analysis platform can significantly improve the performance of grid data query and topology analysis, and provide technical support for the intelligent operation of distribution grids.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Substation Power Supply Scheme based on LCC and Power Quality
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper purposes substation power supply scheme evaluation method based on LCC idea. First, life-cycle cost of power supply scheme is decomposed, and LCC model is established. Then, multi-factor evaluation index framework is established from four aspects: LCC, power quality, power supply reliability and adaptability. Entropy Method is used to determine the index weight, relative closeness sort is the optimal selected basis. Final, an example is used for comparison and selection. The results show that the evaluation model is feasible and practical, and has reference value for the selection of substation power supply scheme.

articleTitle: Three-phase dynamic voltage restorer based on self-tuning fuzzy proportional resonance control
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage sag is one of the most frequent power quality problems in the power system. Dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) is one of the most common methods to solve voltage sag problem. In view of the problems of traditional PI feedback control for dynamic voltage restorer, such as large static error, poor load adaptability and insufficient compensation for nonlinear load, a scheme of fuzzy control for proportional resonance (PR) control parameters of dynamic voltage restorer was proposed. The scheme is simulated on Matlab/Simulink platform, and the results show that the scheme has obvious advantages of excellent dynamic performance, simple control and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Regional Generalized Load Forecasting Considering Source-load Coupling Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With increasing renewable power generation integrated into distributed power networks, regional generalized load forecasting considering source-load coupling characteristics plays an important role in power system planning and scheduling. In view of the uncertainty and correlation of distributed renewable power generation, a practical approach of generating generalized load scenarios considering correlation is proposed in this paper. The generalized load model between wind power, solar power and load is established through different copula functions. The probability sampling of the model is performed and pieced together into time series scenarios, and finally probabilities of several typical load scenarios are obtained by scenario tree. Case studies are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Fast Frequency Regulation Strategy for Renewable Energy Penetrated Power Systems Using Transient Voltage Signals (CICED 2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional frequency regulation scheme utilizes the frequency signals to adjust the output active power of each generator. However, due to the large inertia constant of power systems, the system frequency may not respond fast enough to reflect the load change.
