To overcome it, this paper proposes a method to calculate the load fluctuations of the renewable energy penetrated power system utilizing the transient voltage information. Based on the obtained change in load, the corresponding frequency regulation strategy is designed to enhance the system frequency stability. The proposed method can perceive the load variations quicker than traditional approaches, enabling faster frequency support from renewable energy. Simulation results have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method, which can not only shorten the frequency recovery time, but also enhance the steady-state frequency value.

articleTitle: Research on HPFC Coordination Control Strategy with PST and UPFC
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the high cost of traditional UPFC and the inability of phase shifting transformer (PST) to continuously regulate power flow, a hybrid HPFC topology consisting of PST and UPFC sharing the same primary excitation winding was proposed. HPFC has both advantages and can achieve accurate control of tidal flow in a large range. Based on introducing HPFC structure and principle of adjustment trend, put forward an effective HPFC control strategy, namely through the expected power control PST tap cutting and comprehensive compensation voltage prediction method combined with a closed-loop UPFC control the output voltage of the way the trend of the system adjustment, the method can effectively decrease the voltage overshoot, speed up the adjustment Finally, in MATLAB/SIMULINK, the model of double-loop power transmission system and double-end power supply system is built to verify its power flow regulation ability. The simulation results prove the feasibility of the proposed control strategy and the precision power flow regulation ability of HPFC, which indicates that HPFC has a good application prospect.

articleTitle: Robust Planning of Distributed Generations Incorporating Hosting Capability and Network Power Loss
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To reasonably absorb large-scale renewable distributed generations (DGs), and avoid negative effects caused by excessive network loss, this paper proposes a multi-objective robust planning method DGs incorporating hosting capability and power loss. First, a multi-objective planning model of distributed power was constructed to maximize the hosting capacity and minimize power loss on the basis of robust interval modeling, and satisfying the safe and stable operation of the distribution network. DGs planning scheme and network reconfiguration scheme could be obtained. Secondly, in order to solve the multi-objective planning efficiently, a method based on the Big-M method and second-order cone relaxation was proposed, and then the Mosek solver was used to solve the transformed second order cone programming. Finally, the simulation results of the IEEE-33 node power distribution system was used to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Virtual Carrier Phase Shift Pulse Width Modulation Strategy for Asymmetrical Cascaded Multilevel Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Conventional cascaded H-bridge power amplifier (CHB-PA) with N H-bridge power modules (HBPMs) could create 2N+1 level for output voltage at most and the output voltage level directly affects the sinusoidal characteristic and fidelity performance of power amplifier. With the same number of cascaded HBPMs, this paper proposes an asymmetrical cascaded multilevel power amplifier (ACM-PA) in which the voltage of one HBPM is one-third of the voltage of the other HBPMs, reducing the withstand voltage level of the HBPM. A virtual carrier phase shift pulse width modulation (VCPS-PWM) strategy is also proposed for ACM-PA to increase the output voltage level up to 6N-3 with the HBPM number as the same as conventional CHB-PA. Comparative simulation and experimental results are included to validate that the proposed ACM-PA and VCPS-PWM could obviously increase the output voltage level and decrease the total harmonic distortion (THD) of load current, improving the fidelity performance of power amplifier.

Author Keywords: virtual carrier phase shift pulse width modulation (VCPS-PWM)

articleTitle: Ground fault identification method of distribution network in forest and pastoral areas based on arc characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The early stage of distribution network faults in forest and pastoral areas is often accompanied by arc phenomenon, which causes system circuit oscillation and arc overvoltage. Under the long-term action of fault arc, the temperature of transmission and distribution equipment rises rapidly, producing high-temperature melt, igniting the equipment itself and the surrounding combustibles cause electrical fire accidents in vicious forest and pastoral areas, which seriously threaten the safety of people's lives, property and equipment. In this paper, through the analysis of the characteristics of arc ground faults, a distribution network identification method using arc characteristics is proposed to realize the rapid identification of arc ground faults, and the eigenvalues of the distribution network harmonic content under random distribution are described by normalization. The reliability and safety of the algorithm are verified by PSCAD simulation examples, and the arc ground fault can be accurately identified, which has important guiding significance for the prevention of electrical fires in forest and pastoral areas.

Author Keywords: Electric fire in forest and pastoral area

articleTitle: Generalized Load Modeling of Variable Speed Pumped-storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The variable speed pumped storage unit (VSPSU) is an effective equipment to improve the new energy consumption capacity of the power system. In order to explore the influence of VSPSU grid connection on the load characteristics of distribution station, this paper constructs the dynamic load model of VSPSU. Firstly, the electromechanical transient time scale dynamic model of VSPSU under power generation and pumping conditions is established. Secondly, the dynamic behavior of the unit under power decoupling control and the ability to maintain power grid frequency stability are analyzed. Thirdly, the external characteristics of power voltage disturbance are studied for different load levels, and the effectiveness of the generalized load model of VSPSU is verified by identifying key parameters.

articleTitle: Flexible Power Generation Output with Optimization of District Heating Circulating Water Pump Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Currently improving the power output flexibility of the existing conventional generation units has been deemed as the most effective way to enhance the power system flexibility. Optimization of the auxiliary equipment of the unit such as pumps and fans is rarely studied for its influence on the flexible power generation output capability. Flexible power output capability of one example cogeneration unit in a power plant is analyzed based on built-up models of 620MW cogeneration unit using Ebsilon software. The flexible power output capability achieved and its economic benefit effect on the unit is studied in detail for the different circulation water pump operation modes. Peaking electricity cost is defined for comparing the opportunity cost incurred for realizing the flexible power output capability under different operation mode. Two district heating circulating water pump modes are considered. Under motor-driven operation mode, the district heating circulating water pumps can consume 8.715MW more electric power, which implies a same amount of flexible power output capability can be achieved. The calculated peaking electricity cost is 0.2499 Yuan/kW.h for achieving this flexible power output capability. It should be noted that the peaking electricity cost is decreased with increasing of the district heating circulating water flow, which implies that the power output flexibility should be better used when significant flexible power output capability is expected for high district heating load.

articleTitle: Study on System Architecture and Implementation Plan of Substation Remote Control System Based on Centralized Control Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the system architecture of the new generation substation centralized control mode is taken as the starting point. In addition, with the substation secondary system data, the data interaction and interface technology of substation remote control system based on centralized control mode are studied. The basic principles of the project implementation plan are proposed in this paper, which provides reference for the grid company in the construction and management of the new generation independent and controllable substation.

articleTitle: Temperature on Performance Correction Curve For Overall Gas-Steam Power Plants Plotting
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The performance correction curves of gas turbine, waste heat boiler and steam turbine in gas-steam combined cycle power plants are often reflected in engineering documents, but the overall performance correction curves of gas-steam combined cycle power plants are not in the documents mentioned. Based on the performance correction curves of gas turbine, waste heat boiler and steam turbine, the correction relationship between atmospheric temperature and the overall performance of gas-steam combined cycle power plant is calculated according to the principle of energy and mass conservation. The specific calculation process is shown in the TABLE in the text. The calculation process can provide ideas and references for the drawing of the overall performance correction curves of the gas - steam combined cycle power plant with other parameters such as atmospheric pressure, atmospheric humidity, fuel temperature, frequency, etc. in the gas-steam combined cycle power plant.

articleTitle: Research on Self Synchronization Method of Line Differential Protection Based on 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the high cost of laying optical fiber in distribution network, optical fiber differential protection has been unable to be widely used in distribution network. With the rapid development of 5G communication, this problem is expected to be solved, because 5G communication has the characteristics of high reliability and low time delay, which provides a new possibility for differential protection of distribution network. This paper presents a self synchronization scheme based on zero crossing of waveform before fault. The zero crossing point of voltage waveform before fault is found by searching forward from the peak point of fault current, and the zero crossing point is used as synchronization time point at both ends, so as to realize accurate self synchronization of sampling at both ends. When the 5G optical fiber system is used, it can realize accurate synchronization without relying on the dedicated optical fiber system. The measured synchronous accuracy is not more than 22μs, The reliability, rapidity, sensitivity and selectivity of relay protection are greatly improved. This scheme is suitable for the longitudinal differential protection of distribution network lines and other differential protection without accurate timing or interruption. It has a broad market prospect and has great promotion value.

articleTitle: Grounding Safety Design Method of Urban Transmission Steel Tube Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The grounding designs of urban transmission steel pipe towers in densely populated areas rarely considers the step voltage and contact voltage indexes, which has potential safety hazard. This paper calculates the maximum allowable value of each safety index of tower grounding device under the condition of power frequency short circuit and lightning strike, and calculates the actual value of safety index of grounding device under typical design by grounding simulation software. Through comparison, it is found that the over-standard power frequency step voltage is a key problem in the safety of grounding devices. The spiral grounding module is proposed to replace part of the vertical grounding electrode to balance the step voltage, and the structural parameters are optimized. The design method of 220kV urban transmission steel pipe tower linear radiation grounding device combined with spiral grounding module and the safe grounding design scheme of transmission steel pipe tower are given, which provides a reference for the safe design of transmission tower grounding.

articleTitle: Fixed-Point Based Hybrid Decomposed Method for Energy Flow Calculation in Heat and Electricity Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Energy flow calculation (EFC) is the most fundamental issue in steady-state analysis of heat and electricity integrated energy systems (HE-IESs). However, the independent operation of subsystems and the unknown coupling variables in HE-IES models significantly increase the computational challenge in EFC. To handle the above problems, a fixed-point principle based hybrid decomposed method (FPHDM) is developed for energy flow analysis in HE-IESs with multiple coupling units located in electricity and heat slack nodes. The computation mechanisms enable subsystem operators to calculate the multi-energy flow profiles individually and the entire EFC can be implemented in an alternate iterative way with limited information exchange. Moreover, an iterative format for heat power output of the coupling unit at heat slack node is derived to guarantee convergence. Case studies conducted on a HE-EES verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method as well as its advantages over the current decomposed method in terms of calculation efficiency.

Author Keywords: heat and electricity integrated energy system

articleTitle: A Rapid Identification Method based on the sliding half-wave RMS value of Biological Electric Shock
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The existing residual current protection device uses the residual current fundamental wave amplitude as the action criterion, and there are problems of refuse and misoperation. For this reason, this paper proposes a rapid identification method based on the sliding half-wave RMS value of biological electric shock. This method uses the wavelet domain threshold filtering algorithm to filter the total residual current, and then uses the sliding window to subtract the two complete cycles of the total residual current from the biological electric shock current equipotentially to obtain the biological electric shock current, through the half-wave effective value This method has a small amount of calculation, and the recognition accuracy rate reaches 99.38%. It can quickly identify the electric shock of biological and realize electric shock protection, which is of great significance to ensure the safety and reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Research on PV Low Voltage Ride-Through Control Based on RT-LAB Hardware-in-the-Loop
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a key indicator of whether the photovoltaic power generation system is friendly to the grid, low voltage ride-through is related to the safe and stable operation of the grid. In order to further enhance the low voltage ride-through capability of photovoltaic power generation systems, a low voltage ride through strategy based on RT-LAB hardware-in-the-loop is proposed in this paper. First of all, in view of the problem of disconnection of units caused by the rise of DC side busbar voltage caused by the sudden drop of grid voltage, the correlation coefficient of reducing MPPT operation is introduced, which effectively suppresses the rise of DC side voltage. Then, the underlying control mechanism of photovoltaic inverters is explored. On this basis, the control loop and operating mode of the inverter during the fault are reshaped to limit the overcurrent of the power electronic device. Finally, it is verified on the RT-LAB hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform, and the results show that the strategy works well under different drop depths. Both have good dynamic reactive power support ability, and have better voltage regulation and voltage regulation ability.

articleTitle: Single-end fault location technique for DC distribution lines based on network topology and measured traveling waves
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the flexible DC distribution network without DC circuit breaker, due to the poor ability of power electronic components to withstand fault current, it is required to quickly detect the fault, lock the converter and turn off the fault current, which leads to the limited data left for fault location. The root cause of the fault is the addition of a fault branch in the system, which causes the change of network topology and the change of electrical quantity. This paper uses the measured traveling wave to identify the topological difference between the normal network and the post fault network, extracts the reflected wave head only from the fault point, and determines the fault location according to the time of the reflected wave head. Simulation results show that the proposed method is feasible and has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Study the Effect of SiO2 Addtive on the Microstructure and Current Carrying Performance of ZnO Varistors
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the effects of different SiCh content doping on the microstructure and comprehensive electrical properties of ZnO varistors, especially on the current carrying capability, were investigated. The results show that the comprehensive electrical properties are better when the SiCh content is 1.0 mol%, with a voltage gradient of 301.03 V/mm, a leakage current of 1.24 µA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, a nonlinear coefficient of 55.10, a residual voltage ratio of 1.77, a 42 mm sample in diameter can pass an 350 A 2 ms square impulse for 18 times, a current carrying capability of 25.3 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and an energy The energy absorption capacity of 238.4 J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The relationship between the microstructure and macroscopic electrical properties of ZnO varistor under different SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doping was explored by measuring the phase composition, microstructure, grain boundary parameters and impedance spectrum of ZnO varistor samples. An appropriate amount of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doping can improve the distribution of the bismuth rich phase and spinel phase at the grain boundary, which is conducive to a more uniform current distribution under impulses, but excessive SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> doping makes the local intergranular phase converge, the crystal phase structure is more unstable, which seriously affects the charge transmission under current impulses and worsens the current distribution.

articleTitle: The Availability of Public Charging Piles and the Development of Electric Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electric cars can significantly reduce the oil carbon emissions. Promote the development of the electric car market has become the auto industry the focus of attention. But, the lack of public charging infrastructure has become the main obstacle to hinder the further electric car sales growth. This article uses panel data regression analysis to estimate the availability of public charging pile for electric car sales.

articleTitle: Analysis of the fault characteristics of DC microgrid and research on the parameter selection of current-limiting reactor
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes and deduces fault voltage, current characteristics and response curves based on the topology and grounding method of DC microgrid. The constraints on the selection of the reactor were given considering factors such as equipment safety and protection cooperation in the event of a fault after analyzing and comparing the short-circuit conditions before and after loading reactor. The short-circuit conditions before and after loading reactor were analyzed and compared, and the constraints on the selection of the reactor were given considering factors such as equipment safety and protection cooperation in the event of a fault. A case simulation model of a DC micro-grid in a park was built and the typical fault points were selected for the two cases of adding or not adding a current-limiting reactor. It shows that adding a reactor can effectively reduce the short-circuit current and prolong the fault response time, which is conducive to fault monitoring and judgment and verifies that the fault characteristic analysis is correct. The reactor parameters obtained according to the reactor selection conditions proposed in this paper can meet the engineering requirements and can be used for practical engineering selection reference.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of 10kV Insulator and Metal Binding Wire Form on Partial Discharge in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to master the degradation mechanism of typical equipment in 10kV distribution network, this paper takes the porcelain insulators and overhead conductor of the distribution network as the research object and studies the influence of insulators, binding wires and conductor of distribution network on partial discharge through simulation and test. Master the main factors affecting the change of electric field intensity, which can provide support for the discharge detection and potential risk identification near the insulator in the future.

articleTitle: Single-phase grounding fault location based on Synchrosqueezing S-transform (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The transformation of urban cable feeders increases the number of mixed feeders in the distribution network, which make the randomness of the fault characteristics increases when a single-phase grounding fault occurs. The fault characteristics of the low current grounding system weaker and the influence of noise more and more obvious. In this paper, by analyzing the distributed zero-sequence network in the distribution, which occurs a single-phase grounding fault, the difference in the zero-sequence current amplitude between the fault section and the healthy section is obtained. In order to increases the fault characteristics, the synchrosqueezing S-transform is used to squeeze and reconstruct the zero-sequence current of the sections. Then locating the fault section by the reconstruction signal of the sections with more obvious energy characteristics. The method in this paper is verified by simulation and field data. The results show that this method can locate the fault section under the conditions of high resistance, any compensation degree, strong noise and reverse polarity of transformer accurately. This method has certain reliability.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization design of virtual synchronous generator for power system transient stability improvement
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the popularization of new energy power generation and the rapid development of electronic and electronic technology, more and more powerful electronic devices are connected to the power system. Due to the characteristics of low damping and low inertia presented by electronic and electronic devices, the power system lacks voltage and frequency support, which affects the stability of the power system. Therefore, some scholars put forward the concept of the virtual synchronous generator (VSG). By simulating the rotor motion process of traditional synchronous generators, the power electronic devices have certain damping and inertia, to ensure the stability of the power system. Since power electronic devices have the advantage of flexible parameter adjustment, this paper combines the particle swarm multi-objective optimization algorithm to optimize the moment of inertia and damping coefficient of the virtual synchronous generator when and after the fault, to obtain the maximum critical clearing angle (CCA) and The maximum critical clearing time (CCT) is used as the standard to improve the transient stability of the system, and the correctness of the method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics of Partial Discharge from Typical Defects of HV Cables
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the main equipment for power transmission in the distribution network, the insulation performance of the XLPE cable directly determines the stability and reliability of the testing of the power grid system. Based on the online partial discharge monitoring, cable defects can be effectively found, which is of great significance to ensure the safe operation of the distribution network. In this paper, by artificially producing different types of cable defect segments, and by means of long-term withstand voltage operation in the laboratory, partial discharge signals at different locations are collected, and the pulse amplitude and phase spectrum of cables with typical defects during long-term withstand voltage operation are analyzed. The study indicate that cables of the same defect type have time-invariant characteristics and change regularly with the propagation distance; the gap between cables of different defect types is huge. This paper has guiding significance for the identification of cable defect types, and provides corresponding consultation for the condition monitoring of industrial field cables.

articleTitle: Dynamic prediction of ice disaster in Hunan power grid in the late January of 2022 using a high resolution regional climate model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The normal supply of electric energy is the premise to ensure the normal progress of human production and life. Under the background of global warming, the scope and frequency of grid icing tend to increase, and have brought great losses to people's production and life. Longer prediction time limit helps the power grid to carry out the deployment of ice melting devices, tower reinforcement and other work, and finally helps the power grid to get a stronger ability to prevent and control icing. In this study, a dynamic prediction system using WRF model with a resolution of 30 km and CFS model with a resolution of 100 km are set up to conduct long-term icing perdition in Hunan province. This prediction system shows good performance both for temperature and precipitation. Also, the prediction system is able to predict the icing process in the late January of 2022 ahead 2-3weeks. Results also show that the WRF model with a resolution of 30 km shows a better performance than that in CFS model with a resolution of 100km, which shows the advantage of dynamic downscaling method in icing perdition.

articleTitle: Research on Low Temperature Stability and Measuring Accuracy of SF6 Gas Density Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas density sensor can monitor the density change of the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas in an electrical power equipment. The stable of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas density sensor is of great significance for ensuring the security of power grid. According to statistics, the low temperature level of most SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas density sensors installed in the power grid does not exceed -40°C, while the lowest temperature in some parts of China is lower than -50°C. This research investigated the working stability of two types of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> sensors in the temperature range from 20°C to -50°C from the aspects of basic function performance and mearing accuracy, and give suggestion for developing SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas density sensor with higher low temperature level.

articleTitle: Research and application of intelligent condenser for transmission and distribution boxes
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the 1970s, German-style and American transmission and distribution cabinets (boxes) took the lead in research and application, and subsequent applications were popularized in countries around the world [ 1 ]. Transmission and distribution box, ring network cabinet, distribution cabinet, cable T connection cabinet, box change and other distribution facilities, equipment in the long-term operation will be affected by various factors such as the external environment, cabinet (box) many accessories, so that the internal and external gas is difficult to circulate convection ventilation, there is a non-convection "temperature difference effect", especially in the winter humidity sharp increase to form "condensation ice", the current industry a number of colleges and universities have carried out transmission and distribution cabinet (box) anti-condensation research and application, is still in the preliminary stage." This paper studies and designs the condenser [2], chip MCU dual-frequency control, NTC negative temperature coefficient thermal resistance, temperature and humidity, intelligent adjustment of temperature and humidity, fixed-point condensation water exclusion, which can effectively prevent the occurrence of "wet flash" failure [3] .

articleTitle: Power supply unit optimization division method considering load spatial distribution clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Scientific division of power supply unit is a key problem in grid planning of distribution networks. Traditional methods are difficult to deal with the massive spatial distribution information of loads. In this paper, a clustering power supply unit optimization division method considering load distribution is proposed. Firstly, a load sample set is constructed based on the spatial coordinates of the loads and the load size in the power grid. Define the cohesion and separation to quantify the tightness of the load distribution within the power supply unit and the clarity of the boundaries between the power supply units, and propose the objective function. The clustering algorithm is used to obtain the initial division scheme of the power supply unit. Further consider the technical guidelines to define the constraints, including the maximum power supply radius, power consumption capacity and capacity-load ratio, and adjust the initial division scheme to make the load distribution within the power supply unit as close as possible while the boundaries between the power supply units as clear as possible. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a practical example of a power grid.

articleTitle: Low Carbon Economic Dispatch Method of Power System Based on Wind Power and Electric Vehicle Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reducing carbon emissions is an important goal of environmental protection, and the high penetration of wind power contributes to energy conservation and emission reduction. With the rapid development of electric vehicles, it has become a new research direction to incorporate them into the flexible resources to participate in low-carbon economic scheduling. Firstly, this paper studies the impact of wind power and electric vehicle synergy on carbon emissions, and gives the calculation method of carbon emissions per unit electricity; Then, considering energy storage, a low-carbon economic dispatch model is established to minimize fuel cost and carbon emissions. The simulation results in IEEE 30 bus system show that the proposed model and algorithm can improve the utilization rate of wind power, and the effect of energy saving and emission reduction is remarkable.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Diagnosis of Substation Maintenance Events based on Text Data
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Substation maintenance events are usually generated by input of text data that describes power equipment defects. As the professional knowledge and maintenance experience are difficult to achieve completely for maintainers, it is prone to deviation or inconsistency in understanding of the description text. To provide intelligent methods for correct understanding and processing of new maintenance events, this paper proposes an intelligent diagnosis and processing method based on the historical maintenance event text data. Firstly, event level classification model and historical information retrieval model are presented based on natural-language processing model BERT. Then, the intelligent diagnosis mode is analyzed, that is, the user can select two modes of "1 Event Level Classification" and "2 Historical Event Retrieval" after inputting new event text. After that, the interactive interface is designed based on Flask. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the application of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Value Set Approximation for Robust Stability Analysis of Time Delayed Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In power system, the existence of time delay will seriously affect the control performance and stability, or even instability. Therefore, a robust stability analysis method of power system considering uncertain time delays based on value set approach is proposed in this paper. The value set approach can analyze the stability of arbitrary multi-dimensional uncertain space by using the two-dimensional value set plot of characteristic function. In this paper, Taylor transformation is used to eliminate the transcendental terms introduced by time delays in characteristic function. Then, Bernstein coefficients is used to quickly approximate the value set of characteristic function. In this way, the value set approach based stability analysis method is extended from the traditional delay-free system to the time delayed system. The validity and accuracy of the proposed method is verified in a four-machine two-area system.

articleTitle: Fracture Analysis and Suggestions of Steel Core in Tension Clamp on 220 kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Tension clamps are common components in overhead transmission lines. It not only has to undertake the function of conducting electricity, but also bear all the tension of the wire. It is necessary to ensure that the tension clamp has sufficient gripping capacity. This is of great significance for the safe stress and reliable power supply of transmission lines.This paper aims at the fracture defect of the steel core in the tension clamp of a 220kV line. Anatomical analysis, component analysis, mechanical property analysis and other tests were carried out. At the same time, the effects of different crimping processes on the crimping quality were compared. The reasons for the fracture of the steel core in the tension clamp are analyzed. Relevant recommended measures are put forward.

articleTitle: Influence of Feeder Links on Total Supply Capability of the Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With economic growth and technological development, it is necessary to research the structure of the distribution network to satisfy increasing electricity demand. Feeder links are the key component of the modern distribution network, which is of great significance to the total supply capability (TSC). In this paper, the influence rules of feeder links on TSC are revealed. Firstly, the indices describing the position, scale, and equilibrium degree of feeder links are defined. Secondly, the influence rules of feeder geometrical distribution and feeder link scale on TSC are revealed, the TSC will remain unchanged after reaching a certain value. Thirdly, based on the rules we discovered, the relationship between the value of TSC and different construction orders is revealed, there always exists an optimal construction order of feeder links which can ensure the value of TSC as high as possible in each planning stage. This paper reveals the relationship between the TSC and the topology of a distribution network, which lays a theoretical foundation for the TSC-based distribution network planning method.

articleTitle: An effective power flow calculation method after line-off based on breaking function
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Quickly finding the voltage value of each node is the basis for judging the voltage exceedance degree when the power system is opened and broken. In this paper, a fast calculation method of line opening voltage based on breaking function is proposed. Firstly, a reference variable is introduced on the admittance of the broken line, and a nonlinear opening function about the reference variable is constructed, so that the voltage are functions about the correlative reference variables after the line is opened. Then, by using the Taylor series expansion, the voltage of each node before the opening is taken as the original value of the Taylor series, and the first, second and third derivatives about the voltage regarding the reference variables are taken as the right term. The voltage of the system each node is calculated after the line is opened or broken. Finally, the feasibility of the suggested method is certified in IEEE 14-node system.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Soil Recovery Characteristics under Continuous Lightning Impact
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to research on the phenomenon of lightning, lightning usually consists of multiple strikes. Under multi-pulse current, soil properties are not only related to breakdown properties, but also to electrical parameter recovery. Different regions and different seasons have different soil moisture content, and the impact of lightning strikes on grounding resistance is very different. In this paper, a continuous impact test platform is constructed to conduct continuous impact tests on typical grounding bodies. The discharge characteristics of soils with different water contents under continuous impulse current are studied. According to the experimental results, the correction method of soil resistivity under continuous impulse current is discussed. Then, the simulation model of the grounding device under continuous lightning strike is built with ATP-EMTP software as the simulation platform.

articleTitle: Thermal Power Plant Reliability Assessment Method Considering Auxiliary System and Main Wiring with Intelligent Terminals
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Greater demands of reliability are being placed on thermal power plants by growing promotion of intelligent devices and high-rate renewable energy resources. The auxiliary equipment and main wiring topology of power plants are all affected, while the overall studies are few. To overcome the shortcomings of existing research, this paper proposes a comprehensive reliability assessment methodology of thermal power plant with consideration of both auxiliary system and main wiring in power plants. Firstly, the structure of power plant auxiliary system is established. Then, the main wiring with intelligent terminals is analyzed. Moreover, an overall reliability evaluation procedure is given based on Monte Carlo method and minimum cut set method. Finally, a typical 2*600MW thermal power plant is modified to calculate the reliability indices and compare the importance of these two parts. In the future, with the development of new power systems, the reliability of information system and intelligent terminals should be focused more.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy of Distributed Energy Storage Units in Islanded operation of Low-voltage Distribution-Station Area
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distributed energy storage units with droop control strategy are expected to be the emergency power supply when there conies a power outage in the low voltage station area. However, due to the resistive nature of network lines, accurate active power sharing is hard to be realized, which may put threat on safe operation of the energy storage units. To this regard, a coordinated control strategy is proposed to ensure the active power sharing performance and SoC equalization when the initial SoCs of energy battery units are distinct. An equalizing active power is created which can be adaptively changed according to the global SoC information and is also the key for SoC equalization and accurate active power sharing. The consensus averaging algorithm is employed to estimate the average SoC and average equalizing power. Finally, simulation results based on MATLAB/Simulink are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed coordinated control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on the excitation inrush suppression strategy of phase-selective switching converter with closing resis-tor switch considering dispersion
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A detailed analysis of the excitation inrush current bias phenomenon in the event is carried out in the context of a certain time when charging of a converter is carried out in an ultra-high voltage DC project of the Southern China Power Grid to obtain the cause of the event, which is confirmed by RTDS tests. By analysing the relationship between the moment of closing of different auxiliary contacts and the intermittent angle of the excitation inrush current, the shortest input time at which the closing resistance can play a role in weakening the excitation inrush current is proposed at different moments of closing. Finally, considering the discrete nature of circuit breaker closing, the proposed closing resistor best access time and the best closing angle, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation tests.

articleTitle: Simulation test study on high resistance grounding fault of broken line under sandy soil conditions in forest and pastoral areas
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The cable runs through the forest and is deeply buried underground. The operation environment is very complex. If the cable fails to be quickly diagnosed and checked after failure, it will seriously interfere with the safety of distribution network operation in forest and pastoral areas. The existing research results mainly focus on the qualitative theoretical analysis of cable disconnection fault, and lack of fault mechanism research and experimental verification. A hybrid line composed of 5.5km overhead line and 5.5km cable was built in the 10kV distribution network prototype laboratory to simulate the process of high resistance grounding fault and arcing combustion in the real forest and pastoral area distribution network after cable disconnection in contact with sandy ground, and the change of ground transition resistance after high resistance grounding fault was mainly studied. The research results reveal that the initial stage of grounding fault is intermittent arc high resistance grounding fault, then develops into stable arc high resistance grounding fault, and finally becomes permanent small resistance grounding fault. The research results of this paper provide guidance for the detection and protection of cable line fault in distribution network in forestry and pastoral areas.

Author Keywords: Distribution network in forestry and pastoral areas

articleTitle: Research on Influences of Distributed Photovoltaic Generation on Distribution Network Voltage Quality Based on Electromagnetic Transient Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, the distributed photovoltaic (PV) generation has gradually developed on a large scale in the distribution network (DN), and its volatility along with randomness have brought a certain impact on the power quality, especially the voltage quality of the DN. In this paper, the voltage quality of the DN connected with distributed PV generation is studied by means of electromagnetic transient simulation and hardware-in-the-loop simulation. The performances and influencing factors of voltage quality indicators such as voltage deviation and voltage sag are analyzed.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Auto-reclosing Method Based on Distributed Monitoring Terminals with 5G
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of the modern city, there are a large number of overhead and cable hybrid lines in the urban power grid. Most cable faults are permanent faults, the auto-reclosing function of hybrid lines is usually off in order to avoid the secondary reclosing onto the system. This paper presents an intelligent auto-reclosing method based on distributed monitoring terminal with 5th-Generation mobile network(5G) which is suitable for the accurate fault location of hybrid line. The system is composed of distributed monitoring terminals with 5G and intelligent reclosing device. The monitoring terminal is directly installed on the transmission line, while the intelligent auto-reclosing device is in the substation. The current data collected by the monitoring terminal is sent to the intelligent auto-reclosing device through SG. The intelligent auto-reclosing device identifies the fault section and sends out the blocking auto-reclosing signal. With amount of simulation test and site operation, the method proposed in this paper can accurately locate the fault section of hybrid line and make the application of intelligent auto-reclosing of hybrid line possible, which effectively improves the power supply reliability of hybrid line.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Technology Scheme of Auxiliary Control System for Intelligent Transformation of 500kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the construction of intelligent transformation auxiliary control system in Changsha 500kV Dinggong substation, this paper expounds the principle and key technology about the power Internet of things technology. And the system structure, implementation scheme and risk control in the transformation process are introduced, which can be used as a reference for system design, commissioning and operation maintenance of relevant substations.

articleTitle: Designof DC/DC Converter with GaN HEMT for Flexible DC System of Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The flexible DC system of the distribution grid is the rapid development direction of the flexible DC technology, and the DC/DC converter is the key equipment in the flexible DC system, which can realize the energy interaction between the electric vehicle and the distribution grid. In this paper, a GaN HEMT-based LLC resonant converter is designed, which has the characteristics of high frequency and high efficiency, and can realize the miniaturization of power electronic equipment A 375V/48V/lkW experimental prototype was established. The prototype verifies the feasibility and superiority of the converter.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of Power Electronization Degree for Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a method based on flexibility degree is proposed to measure the power electronization degree of distribution networks. Firstly, the concept of flexibility degree is proposed as the relative measurement of multi-direction continuous flexible control capability of power flow for distribution networks after adopting flexible power electronic devices. Secondly, a specific calculation method of flexibility degree is presented, which takes the proportion of the flexible area to the whole distribution network as the main factor and the flexible control quantity of power flow as the secondary factor. Finally, the above concept and calculation method are verified on the extended IEEE RBTS-BUS4 test system. The effects of soft open point (SOP) on flexibility degree are found, which show that the flexible area is determined by SOP sites, the number of SOPs and the number of SOP terminals, while the flexible control quantity of power flow is determined by the capacities of SOPs accessed to feeders. Further, the configuration principles of SOP are summarized. This paper proposes a measurement index of power electronization degree for distribution networks for the first time and provides a new index to measure the SOP effects.

articleTitle: Characteristics, Technologies and Applications of Energy Internet Digital Twins
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Digital revolution and energy revolution drive the Chinese power system upgrading to the Energy Internet (EI). Digital twins (DT) build a real-time and complete mapping digital image through intelligent perception and real-time connection of physical system, driving efficient collaboration and intelligent linkage of multiple elements in the physical world, it is one of the key supporting technologies of EI. This paper summarizes the characteristics of EI and Energy Internet digital twins (EIDT), proposes the key technologies of EIDT applied in El, and analyzes the specific application scenarios.

articleTitle: Cooperative optimal control of microgrid group with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the energy management problem in the operation of microgrid with distributed generation, taking the grid connected microgrid including photoelectric, wind power, energy storage system and controllable generator units as the research object, this paper constructs the collaborative optimization control model of microgrid group under the networking mode, and comprehensively considers the output and safety constraints of distributed generation, proposes a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on genetic algorithm, Taking the operation cost and environmental cost as the optimization objectives, the optimal solution of the model is solved and analyzed in an example. The results show that the optimization algorithm can significantly improve the peak valley difference characteristics of distribution network load curve. Compared with the separate transaction strategy of microgrid, the economic benefits of microgrid have been improved and the environmental losses have been reduced under the collaborative control mode.

articleTitle: Analysis and design SCADA alarm management system strategy based on jitter characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The alarm management system often has the problem of "flood" alarm for a period of time. A large number of flooding alarm will cause a crisis of trust between human and machine and reduce the availability of the system. The article first investigates the problem of unbalanced alarm distribution in the actual application of the alarm system. In order to adjust the probability density of different alarms, it is necessary to introduce the concept of alarm chatter rate that characterizes the arrival density of alarms. Then, the description principles and methods of the characteristics of alarm redundancy chatter are given. An alarm chatter rate characterization algorithm combining attenuation factor and natural alarm arrival rate is proposed. Finally, the concrete realization of the compression strategy based on this feature processing is given. Comparing and analyzing in actual test, this method can effectively reduce the number of redundant alarms and improve the efficiency of human-machine information interaction expression.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic Characteristics of a Locomotive Transformer by Different Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An analysis of electromagnetic characteristics of a locomotive transformer by a different methods is presented in this paper.The transformer has such a geometry with split windings in the secondary. That is, the primary winding has two branches connected in parallel and three secondary windings with no connection. A 3-D magnetic field is first analyzed by finite element method (FEM) and then an inductance matrix (IM) for magnetic coupling among the multi-branches of the transformer windings are calculated, and then an analysis is done by solving equations. Moreover a simulation model and circuit equations are respectively established to determinate the steady-state characteristics of the transformer. All the results are well verified by the tests or some rating parameters.

articleTitle: A Regional Load Balancing Method Based on the Average Value of Peak Load Rates for Associated Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development and agglomeration of urban industries, the identity and diversity of the load characteristics among various industry areas are more obvious. As the power supply center of the area, the daily load characteristics of the transformer substations have obvious similarity and diversity. Reasonable utilization of the daily load characteristics, such as load high-low difference and peak-valley complementarity, is of great benefit to power grid dispatching department to select the optimal load transfer path of heavy-load transformer and achieve the load balancing among the transformers for a region. Hence, this paper proposes a regional load balancing method considering the average value of the peak load rate of the associated transformers after load transfer. Firstly, according to the daily load prediction curves of the transformers and their feeders in the next week, the heavy-load transformers and the alternative load transfer lines are identified. Secondly, taking the maximum peak load rate and average peak load rate of the associated transformer as the dual indexes, the optimal transfer paths of heavy-load transformers are selected accurately and a comprehensive load balance scheme is formed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in an example.

articleTitle: Research on Overcurrent Suppression Structure for Flexible DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of flexible DC transmission systems, DC distribution systems applying modular multi-level converter (MMC) are gradually becoming a new trend in the development of future distribution networks. But the fault problem of this system is also more serious. Firstly, the transient characteristics of a bipolar short-circuit fault occurring in the DC line of a double-ended flexible DC distribution system are analyzed, followed by a new distribution structure that can effectively suppress the overcurrent, which can effectively suppress the current growth rate of the MMC bridge arm and facilitate the DC circuit breaker to cut off the fault current, and finally, based on the double-ended flexible DC distribution system built in PSCAD/EMTDC, the proposed structure is verified to be validity.

articleTitle: A New Scheme of Bus Arc Protection Based On Zoning
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the principle of arc protection and combined with the application of the fast busbar protection in a country in Southeast Asia, an extensible busbar protection system is proposed, which transmits arc sampling through SMV and tripping signal through GOOSE. The SMV/GOOSE transmission network was constructed by the arc protection device and the arc acquisition unit. The working principle of arc protection system was analyzed by describing the wiring structure of the system. The protection devices were connected through adaptive goose, which greatly improved the scalability of the system. The engineering application proved the rapidity and rationality of the protection scheme.

articleTitle: Continuous Temperature Change Annealing Effect on Thermal-Electrical Properties of XLPE from High-Voltage Cables
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The high voltage cables which reached the designed service years attracted much attention. Two retired 110 kV XLPE cables and a spare cable were selected, and the insulation XLPE was peeled. They were heat-treated at 90, 95, 100, 105, 110, and 115 °C by two inversely step heat-treatment processes. Then, the differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), and DC conduction current were measured. The results show that all the heat treatments did not result in further damage to the molecular structure. The step-heating process brought better results, the thermal and electrical properties were improved with a higher melting point, crystallinity, and a lower electrical conductivity when the heat treatment temperature was below 105 °C. However, the higher temperatures of 110 and 115 °C brought negative effects on the thermal-electrical performance. Finally, it is found that thermal-electrical properties for XLPE from the 30-year service cables could be enhanced if the heat treatments were given at proper temperatures.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Characteristic of Different Defects at Generator Stator End-winding (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Partial Discharge (PD) monitoring is one of the main methods to evaluate the insulation condition of generator stators to avoid insulation failure. Difference of PD characteristics of different defect types at the generator stator end-winding is be analyzed in this paper, which can provide a basis for PD pattern recognition. Three typical artificial defects were created on generator stator end-winding samples, including end-winding contamination, corona at the junction of the grading paint, and defect in slot exit. High voltage testing is carried out on these three defect models to obtain the PD phase characteristic maps of different kinds of defects at the stator end-winding. The results show that the PD characteristic of different types of defect show obvious differences, among which the discharge of end-winding contamination is the smallest, the PD characteristic pattern of defect at the junction of the grading paint is wing-shaped, the discharge amount of the slot exit defect is the largest, and the PD patterns show layered characteristics. By analyzing the characteristics of the Phase Resolved Partial Discharge (PRPD) patterns of three different defects, it is expected to serve as a basis for the PD pattern recognition at the stator end-winding and ensure the safe operation of the generator set.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Wildfire Detection Using Landsat-8 Imagery and Multi-scale U2-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: There are more than 70,000 wildfires in China every year. Wildfires cause air insulation to drop, causing trips and blackouts on important transmission lines such as UHV. The UHV Changnan Line was tripped three times due to wildfires, and the blackouts lasted for up to 72 hours. The wildfires have seriously threatened the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Remote sensing monitoring technology can detect wildfires early, effectively reducing the number of wildfire trips. In view of the difficulty of early detection of small-area wildfires, this paper uses the deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) to monitor the wildfire area of Landsat-8 OLI images with a spatial resolution of 30 meters. We propose powerful network architecture, named multi-scale U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Net, for transmission line wildfire detection (WFD). The multi-scale U<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-Net is a two-level nested U-structure and allows the network to go deeper. It adopts the multi-scale image pyramid (MIP) and ReSidual U-blocks (RSUs), which achieved higher overall accuracy for WFD than traditional algorithms. And it also allows the network to be trained from scratch and achieve competitive results. Experimental results on Landsat-8 images show that the network is competitive both quantitatively and qualitatively, preserving the edge structures of wildfire regions. Compared with existing state-of-the-art networks, our proposed algorithm achieves better final results.

articleTitle: Differential Waveform-Based Power Disturbance Detection Method Using Singular Value Range and Adaptive Threshold
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Extracting useful information about condition of system and equipment based on power disturbance data is significant to ensure the efficiency and safety of them. However, sensitive and reliable disturbance detection is fundamental for the proactive application of disturbance data. Existing detection methods generally applies to specific disturbances, such as power quality disturbances and fault disturbances, which are pertinent but lack of universality and adaptability. A generic high-sensitivity power disturbance detection method based on the singular value distribution law of differential waveform is proposed. The singular value range (SVR) is used to distinguish disturbance from normal waveform. According to the historical SVR sequence reference value and variance variation of differential data, the threshold is adaptively calculated to enhance the universality and detect disturbances. The proposed method is tested through a large number of simulation data and field-measured data, which verifies its high detection sensitivity for various disturbances and effective performances on weak and complex disturbances under ambient noise.

articleTitle: Research on Settlement Risk Control of electricity Sales Company Base on the integration of Margin System and Business Process
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the gradual deepening of the power market construction, market risk exposure has become more and more obvious. How to ensure the smooth operation of the power market and reduce market operation risks has become an important goal of power market operators. In the first half of 2021, the supply and demand situation will reverse, which will have a certain impact on market prices. During the first trial settlement of electricity spot electricity in Guangdong Province, the electricity sales company suffered a large area of losses, which has a great influence on public opinion. In order to ensure the healthy development of the electricity market and prevent the risk of arrears of electricity bills, combined with the actual operation of the Yunnan electricity market, based on the workflow technology, a risk prevention and control mechanism that deeply integrates the margin system and the transaction settlement business is designed to help users, electricity sales companies, and power grid companies. Identify and prevent risks in the process of wholesale and retail settlement. By building a "pre-warning + process tracking" power retail package control system and a daily mark-to-market prevention and control mechanism for power market settlement risks that integrates the margin system, Yunnan's power retail market has been stable and healthy.

articleTitle: Scene design and key technology of online steady state adaptive cruise power flow automatic generation and check
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper mainly describes the application scenario and method of adaptive cruise power flow technology in the new power grid dispatching system under the condition of carbon peak and carbon neutralization, including a online operation limit calculation method based on transmission ratio algorithm, and a nonlinear double interior point method related to power flow automatic generation. Finally, taking the AC/DC interconnection data of China Electric Power Research Institute 36 nodes system and the AC power grid data of a city in Southwest China as examples, the application of technical method proposed in this paper is verified and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on Active Distribution Network Peak Shaving System Considering Distributed Power Access
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of social economy, the forms of electricity consumption on the distribution network side are becoming more and more diverse.Aiming at the impact of peak load on the power grid, a peak shaving control strategy with hybrid energy storage and photovoltaic power generation is proposed.First, the mathematical models of flywheel energy storage, lithium iron phosphate energy storage and photovoltaic power generation systems are introduced.Secondly, the charge-discharge control, hybrid energy storage coordination control and other strategies are respectively studied on the subsystem model.Finally, based on the photovoltaic power generation under different lighting environments, the simulation of the hybrid energy storage participating in the peak shaving system is carried out respectively.The simulation results show the effectiveness of the control strategy, which provides a good solution for active distribution grid-side peak regulation applications, while reducing the impact of peak negative on the power grid, it can prolong the service life of lithium battery and reduce the power cost of owners.

articleTitle: A requirement analysis for the study of torsional vibration on the doubly-fed wind turbine shaft system
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wind farms and wind turbines used in foreign double-fed systems have experienced shaft torsional vibration accidents in recent years, but the cause is not yet known. Due to this, a refined model is required for torsional vibration research in doubly-fed wind turbines, which includes a description of the vibration mechanisms, the electrical coupling between the wind turbine's control system and the external wind system, and the impact of the parameters of the control system on torsional vibration of shafts. In this study, the main factors contributing to the torsional vibration module of a doubly-fed wind turbine are examined, as well as the appropriate suppression measures. These findings can be used to assess the risk of torsional vibration as well as promote the integration of wind power and power grids by providing basic theoretical support for preventing wind power shaft torsional vibration accidents.

articleTitle: Study on Irradiation Crosslinking of Silicone Rubber with Different Vulcanizing Agent Content
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, methyl vinyl silicone rubber was prepared by high-energy electron beam irradiation. The effects of irradiation dose on the properties and structure of silicone rubber were studied, and the performance differences of vulcanizing agent content under different irradiation doses were analyzed. The experimental results show that electron beam irradiation can promote the crosslinking of methyl vinyl silicone rubber. With the increase of absorbed dose, the tensile strength, shore hardness and crosslinking density of silicone rubber increase, and the breaking elongation first increases and then decreases. At the same time, the content of vulcanizing agent has no significant effect on the degree of irradiation crosslinking and shore hardness, but the silicone rubber without vulcanizing agent has excellent tensile strength, elongation at break and tear strength at the dose of 60-100kgy. Relevant data show that irradiation crosslinked silicone rubber material can improve the performance of silicone rubber, and the performance is significantly improved without vulcanizing agent in the electron beam irradiation system, which can provide guidance for the preparation and processing of silicone rubber.

articleTitle: Channel Assignment Algorithm for Time Slotted Channel Hopping in Electric IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electric Internet of Things (IoT) applications such as real-time monitoring, control, and cyber security, are widely used to promote transformations in electric power and energy systems, and Time Slotted Channel Hopping (TSCH) technology can be implemented in electric IoT to provide a more efficient and reliable network. This paper integrates TSCH into electric IoT applications with different data priorities, and proposes a channel assignment algorithm that protects the delivery rate of packets with higher priorities. The importance of links are first weighted by the accumulated weights of all packets passing through this link, and an interference conflict graph is then constructed based on the co-channel interference analysis. Finally, a maximum weight independent set-based method is proposed to iteratively assign links to the proper channels. Experimental results show that our proposed method can improve the stability of electric IoT network that use TSCH.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Segmentation Point for Distribution Network Line Loss Based on Depth-first Wolf Pack Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The existing theoretical calculation results of line loss are unable to carry out the overall linkage analysis of the distribution block, resulting in weak application to guide adjustment and transformation for the grid. Combining the structural characteristics and the operation status of urban distribution network, this paper proposes a method for obtaining optimal segment point for line loss based on the depth-first wolf pack search algorithm. The method aims at reducing line loss as optimization goal. By building a mathematical model of distribution network reconstruction and obtaining optimal switch status combination mode of grid line loss rate under the search framework based on wolf pack algorithm, it obtains the optimal switch configuration scheme with lowest line loss rate. This intelligent algorithm has a fast convergence speed, which is suitable for large urban power grids.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of New Energy Consumption Capacity Considering Network Vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the increase of new energy penetration rate leads to the increase of system vulnerability, and then limits the consumption of new energy, this paper first puts forward the consumption mechanism of new energy; Then, aiming at the uncertainty of new energy output, the joint probability density function of wind-photovoltaic output is established to represent it, and based on this, the new energy output value is obtained by sampling. Then, the short-circuit capacity ratio index of load node-system is put forward, and the influence of new energy access on system vulnerability is quantitatively analyzed. Finally, a multi-objective evaluation method is established to quantitatively analyze the new energy consumption capacity, aiming at the minimum abandonment rate of new energy and the overall vulnerability of the system. Simulation results based on IEEE 39-bus system show that the proposed method is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Research on State Evaluation Method of Electronic Transformer Based on Multi-parameter Transient Strong Electromagnetic Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electromagnetic compatibility environment of electronic transformer in substation is a parameter that the operation and maintenance personnel are concerned about while it’s difficult to be obtained. The research on state evaluation technology of the electromagnetic compatibility of electronic transformer can effectively prevent the electromagnetic compatibility faults and reduce the fault rate of electronic transformer. This paper proposes a method for evaluating the electromagnetic compatibility state of electronic transformer. Firstly, an evaluation index system is established. This index system covers two key sources of transient electromagnetic disturbance that affect electromagnetic compatibility state of electronic transformer, namely power port and signal port. The electromagnetic disturbance includes surge, electrical fast transient burst and damped oscillatory wave. Secondly, the weight of each factor is determined by the analytic hierarchy process method, and the membership function of each index is determined by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. This method makes up for the gap in the field of state evaluation of electromagnetic compatibility of electronic transformer, and gives early warning of electromagnetic compatibility faults and the evaluation results can guide the decision of electronic transformer in terms of operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Analysis on the cost of new energy power generation in Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power generation structure in Yunnan is dominated by hydropower, and the market-oriented electricity price level is relatively low. The cost analysis of new energy power generation is one of the important strategies to ensure the sustainable development of new energy in Yunnan. In this paper, on the basis of the classical calculation formula of electricity cost, tax factors are added, and the data of 19 newly invested wind farms and 9 PV power plants in Yunnan Province is used to calculate the cost to obtain the actual investment return of the project. And compared with the cost of new energy power generation in Guangdong and Guizhou to provide decision-making basis for the investment of new energy power generation projects in Yunnan Province.

articleTitle: Robust iterative fuzzy observer method for dynamic state sensing and harmonic estimation in power distribution grids
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The estimation of bus-voltage/branch-current and harmonics is an effective class of measures to monitor and improve the power quality of distribution grids. In this paper, we propose a robust iterative fuzzy observer method to estimate both voltage/current state variables and harmonic disturbances in distribution grids in the presence of uncertainties in the models used for design due to component aging or parameter drift. Overall, the observer is composed of a robust fuzzy nominal state observer and an iterative fuzzy harmonic observer, where the observer parameters are designed using a fuzzy method based on parallel distribution compensation. It should be noted that the online iterative termination condition of the fuzzy harmonic observer is determined based on the Total Harmonic Distortion of the output tracking error, in order to take into account both the online estimation speed and the estimation accuracy. Finally, a numerical simulation is given to verify the validity of these obtained conclusions.

articleTitle: Research on flexible loop closing device for medium voltage distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The loop closing current problem caused by voltage amplitude and phase angle difference affects the safe and stable operation of distribution network. Several possible voltage regulating devices are analyzed in this paper to realize flexible loop closing operation, which are devices based on voltage source converter, controlled phase shifting transformer and SEN transformer. The voltage regulation characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of these devices are analyzed, and an improved SEN transformer scheme is proposed based on the controlled phase shifting transformer and SEN transformer.
