The fast voltage regulation and power flow control function are realized through the thyristor voltage regulation circuit, which is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: New Energy Security Scheduling Method Considering Static Security Boundary Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The access of large-scale wind power brings severe challenges to the optimal scheduling of power system. The traditional wind power system scheduling method highly depends on the accurate wind power probability distribution or the establishment of high-precision wind power prediction interval. When dealing with the uncertainty of wind power exceeding the expected value, there may be problems of correcting dispatching and abandoning wind power. In order to promote the absorption of wind power, the concept of security region theory is introduced to analyze the relationship among the security region, static safety distance and wind power output uncertainty. On this basis, a security optimal dispatch model with static safety distance as constraint is proposed. The simulation results of IEEE 39 bus system show that the proposed model has certain robustness and strong operability with the actual situation of low wind power prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Consumption and Economic Analysis Considering The Short-circuit Ratio Lifting Capacity of Condenser
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the weak support of renewable energy power generation equipment, the voltage support capacity after connecting to the power grid is difficult to meet the needs of safe operation of the power grid. Especially when large-scale renewable energy units, DC transmission and other power equipment are connected to the power system, the problem of transient overvoltage has become the main factor restricting the transmission of renewable energy. By configuring the condenser, the power grid voltage support strength can be effectively improved and the output limit of renewable energy can be improved. However, in the actual production and operation of power grid, there is not only a lack of quantitative analysis and research on improving the transmission capacity of renewable energy, but also a lack of technical and economic analysis methods for the configuration of condenser. Therefore, based on the quantitative evaluation of MRSCR on the power grid voltage support strength, through the joint calculation of PSD-BPA software and production simulation model, this study quantitatively analyzes the impact on the renewable energy consumption capacity after the distributed dimmer is connected to the system, and quantitatively evaluates the technical economy of configuring the dimmer in the renewable energy collection station by constructing the technical economy model of the dimmer. The results show that the condenser can not only improve the transmission capacity of renewable energy, but also have good economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design of Parallel Protection Air Gap of 35 kV Transmission Line Arresters
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The 35 kV power transmission line is not equipped with lightning conductor, resulting in the frequency of lightning strike line and the current generated by lightning strike lines are much larger than those with 110 kV voltage level and above. As the current carrying capacity of the arrester of 35 kV line is insufficient, the arrester is frequently damaged due to lightning strikes. To improve the performance of arrester, this paper proposes a parallel protection air gap of 35 kV line arrester. The structure and distance parameters of protection air gap were obtained by the volt-ampere characteristic curve of zinc oxide (ZnO) resistance and air gap discharge test. When the amplitude of lightning current is lower than the protective action threshold, the voltage of arrester is lower than the parallel gap discharge voltage, and lightning current flows through ZnO resistance. When the lightning current amplitude is higher than the protection action threshold, the voltage of the arrester breaks down the parallel air gap, preventing the arrester from being damaged by lightning. The impulse discharge test and field application of 35 kV line arrester show that the parallel air gap can reduce the lightning damage probability of 35 kV line arrester.

articleTitle: Study on Paths and Potentialities of Carbon Emission Reduction of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the background of low-carbon economy, the electric power industry, as an important field of energy consumption, has great potential of carbon emission reduction. As the main carrier of power transmission, the power grid plays an important role in the low-carbon development of the power industry. The paths of low-carbon development of the power grid are sorted out in detail from three aspects: the power generation side, the grid side and the power consumption side. And a set of more comprehensive grid carbon emission analysis indicators are selected from the above three aspects. An improved super-efficiency data envelopment analysis (SE-DEA) method is proposed to quantitatively analyze the low-carbon Potentialities. The applicability and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by the example analysis of power grid in different regions.

articleTitle: Identification of household variation relation in low voltage distribution network based on trend similarity and distance measure (CICED 2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The complex structure of low-voltage distribution network and many renovation projects lead to errors in the relationship between household and transformer. Traditional identification methods are heavy and inefficient, so this paper proposes a method based on trend similarity and distance measure. Using Pearson correlation coefficient and discrete Fréchet distance, the identification algorithm of household variable relationship in low voltage distribution network is constructed. The results of an example show that the proposed algorithm has high recall and precision.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Metro Stray Current on Transformer DC Magnetic Bias
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the operation of urban rail transit, the stray current of the subway is generated and flows into the earth, resulting in different ground potentials of each substation, which causes the DC magnetic bias of the transformer. Firstly, this paper establishes the stray current distribution model of dual-terminal power supply mode of subway, and simulates the dynamic change of stray current by adjusting the change of subway position. Then, the COMSOL software is used to build the coupling model between the subway operation line and the urban AC grid, and the ground potential distribution characteristics during the subway operation are simulated and studied. Finally, based on the neutral grounding voltage obtained by simulation and the topology of urban power grid, the variation law of DC magnetic bias single current in each substation is analyzed. The research shows that when the local railway locomotive runs in the middle of the line, the leakage of the stray current of the subway is the most serious, which will produce greater induction potential, and the influence on the substations in different locations is intensified, which makes the magnetic bias current of each substation increase.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle-temperature control load-energy storage joint frequency modulation strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: the proportion of flexible loads electric vehicles (EVs), temperature control loads (TCLs) and energy storage system (ESS) in microgrid has increased year by year. These resources aggregate to form a polymer with large regulation capacity, fast response speed and good regulation characteristics, which can respond well to the frequency change of microgrid. Therefore, this paper proposes the joint frequency modulation (FM) strategy of EV, TCL and ESS of isolated island microgrid. Firstly, this paper establishes the state matrix of EVs and TCLs participating in the FM of isolated island microgrid. According to the state matrix, the active output model of EVs and TCLs and the primary frequency modulation (PFM) response model of ESS are established; Then, considering the advantages of ESS in FM speed, which can be used to provide virtual inertial response, considering the expectations of EV users for power and TCL users for temperature, the FM response priority of EVs and TCKs is divided, and the joint frequency modulation strategy of EV, TCL and ESS is proposed; Secondly, aiming at minimizing the frequency deviation, reinforcement learning agent is used to optimize the response active power; Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy under various working conditions is verified on the MATLAB / Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Research on cascading fault early warning model of low voltage distribution network based on the brittleness theory of complex system
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to realize the accurate automatic operation and maintenance detection of distribution network, the brittleness theory of complex system was introduced into the cascading fault early warning of low-voltage distribution network, and the cascading fault early warning model of low-voltage distribution network based on the brittleness theory of complex system was constructed. In this study, we analyzed the brittleness of low-voltage distribution network, and used brittleness degree and brittleness factor to identify the brittleness event and brittleness factor which cause the fault in the brittle event. By introducing consequence severity and uncertain factors, an improved fault brittleness prediction entropy function was proposed to calculate the brittleness grade. Finally, according to the logical relationship of the early warning model, a cascading fault early warning model of low-voltage distribution network based on the brittleness theory of complex system was constructed, and the specific process of the model was introduced in detail. Besides, by using the IEEE39 node system, an example was analyzed to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Backup Protection for Tie Lines in a Petal Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The structure of petal-shaped distribution network is more complicated. Between substation and switch station, switch station and switch station are connected by the tie line. The tie line is one of the components that most easily to have a failure. Therefore, the fault characteristics and protection configuration of the tie line need to be studied deeply. A new backup protection scheme is proposed to determine the fault position of the tie line by using the variation of active power of the tie line. PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software is used to establish a power grid model to verify the effect of protection. The results show that the proposed scheme can significantly shorten the time of fault removal compared with the traditional scheme, with higher reliability.

articleTitle: Hierarchical energy management and coordinated control of active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an important part of power supply system, active distribution network plays an important role in the stable operation of power supply system. As the effective consumption of intermittent energy structure, hierarchical energy management and coordinated management of active distribution network is one of the core tasks of the whole active distribution network. Based on the discussion of hierarchical energy management and coordination control framework of active distribution network, this paper analyzes the information interaction and global optimization of active distribution network, in order to provide reference for relevant practitioners.

articleTitle: Research and application of low NOx combustion technology for gas turbine of 200MW combined cycle unit
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As clean and efficient energy power generation equipment, gas turbine can guarantee the security and stability of regional power grid based on energy saving and emission reduction. However, due to its own design and operation factors, combustion shock and NOx emission rise inevitably occur. This article summarizes the mechanism of low NOx combustion technology and low NOx burner, denigration, traditional combustion adjustment technology, automatic combustion adjustment technology abroad, and based on low NOx combustion technology progress, mainly introduced the independent implementation sc1eme of automatic combustion adjustment system, research content and debug application situation, and puts forward the direction of the further optimization. This paper can provide reference for gas turbine related low NOx combustion transformation and optimization operation.

articleTitle: Impact of Electric Heating Technology on Power Grid of City
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electric heating is an important way of power energy alternative which can contributes to the achievement of the peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality. It has several advantages such as equipment investment saving, controllability of temperature in the room, less direct air pollution. In recent years, electric heating equipments are used in some Northern China cites in large scale, for its great contribution to the energy saving, emission reduction and qualified heating to citizens. The widespread application of electric heating technology will impose a greater impact on wind power accommodation, the planning, construction, and operation of grid, and contribute to optimization of grid operation. This article first introduces the classification of electric heating technology, summarizes its application, and studies its impact on the power grid from multiple perspectives.

articleTitle: The Online Calibration System for Transformers Based on Hybrid Convolution Window Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the problems that cannot be solved by electronic voltage transformer online calibration, This paper designs a live calibration system with simple operation, high accuracy and flexibility. The use of a standard voltage transformer and a diamond-shaped automatic lifting device to obtain the primary voltage signal, And the voltage is divided by the voltage divider composed of SF6 cylindrical capacitor and precision NPO capacitor to complete the verification, The influences of overvoltage, gas leakage and temperature on the measurement accuracy of standard voltage transformers are analyzed, and it is judged whether they meet the requirements of system accuracy. A four-spectrum line interpolation algorithm based on trapezoidal self-convolution window is designed. This algorithm not only has better side lobe characteristics, but also has better main lobe characteristics than classic triangular windows. The four-spectrum line interpolation algorithm based on the trapezoidal self-convolution window greatly improves the accuracy of data processing. This paper uses the cooperation of virtual instrument LabVIEW and PC to realize the four-spectrum interpolation algorithm of trapezoidal self-convolution window. It is easy to operate, shortens the verification cycle, saves development costs, and has good human-computer interaction and scalability.

articleTitle: Control flow integrity check based on LBR register in power 5G environment
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a control flow integrity checking method based on the LBR register: through an analysis of the static target program loaded binary modules, gain function attributes such as borders and build the initial transfer of legal control flow boundary, real-time maintenance when combined with the dynamic execution of the program flow of control transfer record, build a complete profile control flow transfer security; Get the call location of /bin/sh or system() in the program to build an internal monitor for control-flow integrity checks. In the process of program execution, on the one hand, the control flow transfer outside the outline is judged as the abnormal control flow transfer with attack threat; On the other hand, abnormal transitions across the contour are picked up by an internal detector. In this method, by identifying abnormal control flow transitions, attacks are initially detected before the attack code is executed, while some attacks that bypass the coarse-grained verification of security profile are captured by the refined internal detector of control flow integrity. This method reduces the cost of control flow integrity check by using the safety profile analysis of coarse-grained check. In addition, a fine-grained shell internal detector is inserted into the contour to improve the safety performance of the system and achieve a good balance between performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Feed-in Tariffs Mechanism of Thermal Power and Renewable Energy Generation in New Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In September 2020, China has made a commitment to achieving "peak carbon dioxide emissions" before 2030 and "carbon neutrality" before 2060 at the General Assembly of the United Nations. Then, at the Climate Ambition Summit, President Xi of China pointed out the important responsibility and mission of the power industry to serve "peak carbon dioxide emissions and carbon neutrality". The key question such as what kind of power system to build and what kind of main energy will be chosen to build the power system were proposed. For the new power system, there will be new changes in the links of "source, network, charge, storage". Renewable energy is required to be developed on a large scale and connected in a high proportion. Coal-fired power will gradually evolve from the main power source to the regulated and guaranteed power source. This role change will inevitably lead to the change in power cost, which urgently requires the "feed-in tariff" mechanism to play the role of signal and resource allocation. Encourage and guide renewable energy power generation and flexible adjustment of resources that can provide price mechanism guarantee for energy transformation and development and efficient support for new power system construction.

articleTitle: Research on Regulation Characteristic Analysis Method of Temperature-controlled Load Cluster Based on Soft Actor-Critic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Temperature-controlled loads have great potential to provide power system with power regulation service. It is difficult to estimate the regulation characteristic of air conditioning load clusters. This paper considers the feasibility of measurement, and puts forward a data-driven regulation characteristics analysis method of temperature-controlled load clusters based on gate power and cluster sampling information, which provides a highly practical cluster dispatching parameters for power system dispatching centers. This paper designs a multi-objective reward function which considers the benefits of the cluster, dispatch demand, response performance and so on. Through Soft Actor-Critic Algorithm (SAC) algorithm, the training of neural network for dispatch parameter analysis is realized. Through the analysis of simulation results, the proposed method greatly reduces the scale of data collection, reduces the measurement sensitivity of the device and, obtains high stability. The multi-objective reconciliation of response randomness, control accuracy and aggregator income is realized, which provides technical support for residential users to actively participate in system regulation.

articleTitle: Study on CF3I Decomposition Product after Arc Interruption in 12kV Ring Main Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: SF6 has been widely used in power equipment, however, it has strong greenhouse effect and many countries have made limitations to its use. CF3I is a potential SF6 substitute gas, but there are few studies on the arc interruption decomposition products of CF3I gas. In this paper, the performance of CF3I under different current is experimentally studied by using a 12kV ring main unit. GC-MS method was used to study the decomposition products of CF3I. The results show that the main products of CF3I gas after arc burning are perfluorinated hydrocarbons, including CF4 and C2F6. The solid products are iodine and carbon. After successful arc interruption, CF3I gases decompose in a very small proportion, however, about 96% of CF3I gas is decomposed into CF4 after the failure of interruption. Therefore, on the premise of taking appropriate measures to eliminate solid products in time and ensure the success of arc interruption, The decomposition of CF3I will not affect its application as potential insulating and arc interruption medium in electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis of frequent switching of AC filters in multi-terminal DC transmission project
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The AC filter is an important part of the reactive power control function design of the DC power transmission project. The ± 500kV Luquan converter station is a rectifier station in the Lu-Gao-Zhao multi-terminal DC transmission project. During its operation, there is an abnormal phenomenon of frequent switching of the AC filter. This paper analyzes the abnormal phenomenon and proposes optimization measures. It is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of conventional and multi-terminal DC transmission projects.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation of Shared Energy Storage Considering Carbon Emission Cost of Different Users
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the strategic goal of carbon peaking and carbon neutralization, with the widespread application of distributed energy such as photovoltaic, the demand for energy storage systems has also increased sharply, and the installation of photovoltaic and energy storage by users will inevitably affect carbon emissions. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimal allocation model of shared energy storage considering the carbon emission cost of different users. The upper layer takes the minimum annual total cost of multiple users as the objective function, including the annual electricity charge, basic electricity charge, photovoltaic and energy storage investment operation and maintenance cost, and carbon emission cost of the user, and optimizes the shared energy storage capacity and power expected to be installed by users. In the lower layer, the daily charge and discharge power of shared energy storage is optimized with the minimum daily operation scheduling cost as the objective function. Then, a benefit allocation method based on the relationship between the cost of energy storage installed by users alone and the total cost of multiple users is proposed. Finally, the superiority of the proposed method is verified through the optimization calculation of an example and the comparison with the user’s individual configuration of energy storage.

articleTitle: Study on Influencing Factors of High-current Impulse Tolerance of 10kV Distribution Arrester
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to clarify the cause of the failure of the 4/10μs high current impulse withstand of the 10kV distribution arrester, and verify the equivalence of different types of high- current impulse withstand test samples, and improve the quality of the arrester connected to the grid. This paper takes the porcelain-housed and polymer-housed arrester for 10kV power distribution system as the research object, and uses the test method to study the high-current impulse withstand capability of the whole arrester with different structures, its core element resistor piece, and the dielectrically prorated section. Comparing the difference in high current impulse withstand capability between distribution arresters of different structures and different samples of the same arrester. The factors affecting the high current impulse withstand capability of 10kV distribution arresters are analyzed, so as to provide technical support for optimizing the selection of arrester high current impulse test samples and for grid users to choose arresters with excellent performance.

articleTitle: Lithium Bttery Cntrol Bsed on the Joint EKF and VFFRLS Agorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The large-scale investment in battery storage power station has improved the grid’s ability to consume new energy resources. The safety and cycle life of the battery inside the energy storage power station are also more important. Since the existence of multiple chemical reactions inside the battery brings great difficulties to the battery state estimation, the battery management technology must be paid attention to. For the rapid charging and discharging of the battery, this paper proposes to improve the battery model based on the establishment of the battery equivalent model, and then add the extended Kalman filter method and variable forgetting factor recursive least square to optimize the model to realize the accurate control of the operating voltage and provide a theoretical basis for the state estimation of the battery. Finally, the feasibility of the strategy is verified by matlab simulation.

Author Keywords: variable forgetting factor recursive least square

articleTitle: Response analysis of ±500kV three-terminal conventional DC transmission system to AC system fault
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The stability of the DC transmission system is of great significance to the safe operation of regional large power grids and the reliability of power supply. With the commissioning of the ± 500kV Lu-Gao-Zhao three-terminal conventional DC transmission project, the power grids of Yunnan, Guizhou, and Guangdong provinces have become increasingly close. The failure of one station will have an impact on the power grids of the three provinces. This paper analyzes the response of the DC system when the AC system on the rectifier side fails, and analyzes the impact on the DC system when the AC single-phase grounding fault occurs on the rectifier side in engineering practice. It is found that when only AC single-phase fault occurs at Luquan Station, It will also have a greater impact on the DC transmission system, and at the same time, according to the analysis, corresponding improvement and pre-control measures are proposed.

articleTitle: Study on Ice-melting Temperature Rise of Overhead Insulated Conductor and Connector in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The ice-melting temperature rise test was carried out on typical insulated conductors and their connectors widely used in 10 kV distribution overhead lines. The through-current tests were carried out on two insulated conductors with different cross-sections when they were not covered with ice or covered with ice. And the temperature difference between the core wire and the insulating layer of the insulated conductor was analyzed. The temperature of 4 kinds of insulated wires and two kinds of connectors under rated current-carrying and over-rated current operation was also recorded through the test. Through the comparison of test temperature, various influences of the thermal effect of the current conductor on the conductor under normal and overload conditions are analyzed, which provides theoretical guidance for the ice-melting work of overhead insulated transmission lines.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of energy storage in airport multi energy system with variable energy efficiencies
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The airport multi-energy system (MES) operates economically, reliably and efficiently on the premise of ensuring the comfort of passengers. Configuring energy storage equipment in the airport MES can further improve the economy and reliability. Considering the variability of energy efficiency of MES equipments, an optimal allocation model of energy storage in airport multi energy system with variable energy efficiency is proposed. The objective function of the model is that the annual total cost of airport MES is the lowest, which includes the annual investment cost of energy storage, equipment maintenance cost, energy purchase cost and carbon emission cost. The variability of energy efficiency specifically refers to that the energy efficiency is not a constant marked on the nameplate, but changes with the change of part load ratio. The constraint of energy storage operation, the nonlinear relationship between energy efficiency and part load ratio make it difficult to directly solve the model, which is addressed by the big M method and the piecewise linear method respectively. The simulation results of an example show that,

articleTitle: Flexible grounding current compensation method for distribution network based on three-phase four-leg inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem of ground fault current compensation for different grounding methods of neutral point in distribution network, this paper proposes a flexible grounding current compensation method based on three-phase four-leg inverter full-control circuit device. When the distribution network fails, the three-phase four-leg inverter is used to precisely control the three-phase four-leg inverter to inject compensation current into the secondary winding of the grounding transformer, and then pass through the grounding transformer once. The winding injects the compensation current into the non-faulted phase and the ground to achieve full compensation of the ground fault current. Modeling and simulation using PSCAD/EMTDC, different grounding methods of the neutral point are tested, the results show that the proposed method can effectively control the asymmetric voltage in the distribution network, and can be applied to different neutral point grounding methods of the power network. And can implement online switching function.

articleTitle: Research on multi-demand response resources involved in spinning reserve optimization for new power system
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the future, the new power system dominated by high proportion of new energy will pose a new flexibility challenge to China's traditional reserve ancillary services market. In addition to power generation resources, user-side demand response resources can also provide reserve services. In the market environment, with the development of new market subject load aggregators, more small and medium-sized users' demand response resources can participate in system operation more effectively through the agent of load aggregators, especially in the spinning reserve market, and give full play to the value of demand response resources to improve system flexibility and economy. Based on the new model of small and medium users' demand response resource load aggregators participating in the spinning reserve market, and the generator set outage failure and the uncertainty when demand response resource provides reserve, This paper introduced the expected energy not supplied (EENS) reliability index ,and established the optimization model of multiple rotating reserve resources. On the premise of satisfying certain reliability, the model can minimize the reserve ancillary services market purchase cost and expected loss of low power. The example of IEEE30 node system shows that the model effectively coordinates the economy and reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Model predictive control of modular multilevel converter based on equivalent current decomposition model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to its unique topology, modular multilevel converter (MMC) is very suitable for AC/AC conversion applications in distribution network and has broad development prospects. Aiming at the problems of multivariable coupling and multi-objective accurate control of single-phase direct AC/AC-MMC, a model predictive control (MPC) strategy based on current decomposition model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, according to the relationship between bridge arm electrical quantity and input and output, the equivalent current decomposition model of decoupling input circuit, output circuit and circulating circuit is derived. Then, the evaluation function with the output current, input current, circulating current and submodule (SM) capacitor voltage as the rolling optimization objective is established, the rolling optimization process of MPC is carried out according to the equivalent current model and simplified by selecting the optimal bridge arm levels, so as to realize the multi-objective accurate and fast control of AC/AC-MMC. Finally, the proposed MPC control strategy is simulated and compared with the traditional MPC control strategy and PI control strategy to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Research on the calculation method of the protection setting value setting of the distribution network based on the wave recording
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the acquisition and analysis of the wave recording data of the distribution network, the characteristic value of the wave recording is extracted to form the characteristic database of the distribution network feeder waveform, and the fault type of the distribution network is identified. The coefficient and the maximum value of the three-phase short-circuit current are calculated to obtain the quick-break protection setting value. The over-current protection setting value is obtained by the calculation of the adjacent coefficient and the over-current start but not the maximum value of the fault recording file. This setting method is not affected by the new energy station. The impact of grid structure changes caused by access, saves time and effort, is easy to implement, and realizes automatic tuning of distribution network settings.

articleTitle: Influence of Fillers on the Electrical Tracking Behavior of Polyamide Insulating Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Thermoplastics, such as polyamide, can be utilized as insulation materials in a variety of high voltage applications due to their eco-friendly, low-energy cost, recyclable and rapid processing, as well as their superior mechanical and electrical properties when compared to conventional thermosetting epoxy. According to the IEEE standard for air switchgear, the insulating material must exhibit excellent tracking and erosion properties. Few studies have been conducted on the inclined plane test (IPT) for thermoplastics. In this paper, a simple and environmentally friendly strategy is proposed to improve the erosion resistance of glass fiber reinforced polyamide. The results suggest that inorganic fillers can improve polyamide’s tracking properties. The superior performance of hybrid filled composites may depend upon enhanced thermal stability and heat conduction properties. Composite materials are capable of passing the 2.5 kV inclined plane test and meeting IEEE criteria if they contain a minimum of 30% BN fillers.

articleTitle: Industrial Gas Turbine Hot Section Components Localized Repair Technology and Application
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To ensure the safety and stable operation of regional power grid and form the localized repair service capability of industrial gas turbine, Huarui has successfully established a set of systematic repair technology for gas turbine hot section components through the transfer, digestion and absorption of foreign repair technology and talent training. This paper introduces the technical process of localized repair of industrial gas turbine hot section components, non-OEM maintenance process standard, post-maintenance inspection and determination ability of thermal barrier coating, and the application of localized repair of gas turbine components.

articleTitle: Study on Cable Hole Sealing Device for Distribution Box
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the problems of plugging structure easy to fall off and hardening cracking caused by traditional plugging methods such as cement plugging for distribution box cable holes are analyzed. A new hole plugging device based on cam linkage mechanism is designed by using Archimedes spiral approximation principle and gas pump push rod as power source, which realizes good tightness and sealing of the plugging device. Through the pressure and temperature analysis of the ideal gas at the tight position of the sealing device, the applicability of the sealing device in the gas-liquid pipeline is proved, which has important reference value for improving the service life of the gas pipeline.

articleTitle: A consistency index analysis and calculation method for multi-measurement data
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: multi-source data fusion is the background of the data processing in the future, for multi-source data analysis and processing, the current lack of quantifiable than consistency check method, need through the compare of multi-source data analysis, the correctness of the data to cany out the lean check, to the running state of field sampling equipment for evaluation of different dimensions.This paper proposes a consistency index analysis of multi-measurement data, which provides a new method for multi-source data comparison. The main idea is to obtain the total data consistency index through index and weighting based on the two-part analysis of the deviation index of comprehensive measurement data and the similarity index of comprehensive measurement data change trend. This method quantifies the consistency of multi-source data and provides a new evaluation method for the real-time running status of equipment through multi-source data verification, which improves the reliability of power grid operation.

articleTitle: Generation and grid coordination planning considering net load peak and valley
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the new power system with renewable energy as the main body, wind power and photovoltaic have the characteristics of volatility, uncertainty, and poor predictability. To improve the penetration rate of renewable energy, sufficient flexible and adjustable power is vital to absorb large-scale renewable energy sources, especially wind power. Therefore, it is necessary to consider a reasonable proportion of wind power, flexible and adjustable power sources and ordinary conventional coal-fired power sources in the power grid coordination planning. In the paper, the K-Means clustering method is proposed to sample the load and wind speed values at different times of a typical day from the actual data. A mathematical model for coordinated planning of dynamic power grids with coal-fired power generation is then built up. The goal of this model is to make optimal investment in candidate generating units and candidate lines under the premise of satisfying the constraints of safe operation of the power grid, so as to ensure that the total present value of investment cost and operating cost is the smallest during the planning period. At the same time, the simplified unit combination model is used to simulate the dispatching operation of various types of units in the typical intraday power system, so as to illustrate the flexible adjustment effect of gas-fired generating units on wind power and load fluctuations. The established mathematical model is a mixed integer linear programming model, and the model is solved by using GAMS software to realize programming. The IEEE-30 node case verifies the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multiple Remote Check Technology of Substation Telecontrol Forwarding Data (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the standardized interaction mechanism between the checking master station of substation telecontrol forwarding data and the dispatching master station, the substation telecontrol is deeply studied, and a multiple remote check scheme of substation telecontrol forwarding data, which realizes the consistency check of the forwarding data between the dispatching master station and the substation telecontrol, the consistency check of the forwarding data between double substation telecontrols, and the consistency automatic check of the forwarding data under the mode of multi dispatching master stations and multi substation telecontrols.

articleTitle: Study on Low Voltage Precise Load Shedding Measures in Receiving-side Power Grid Considering Source-Grid-Load Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increase of load, the risk of voltage stability problem in power grid will increase, especially in the power grid with high proportion of power receiving in central and eastern China. Low voltage load shedding is an effective control measure to solve the problem of power system voltage stability, and how to take a more reasonable and effective load shedding strategy to reduce the adverse impact of load shedding always is the key focus of the power industry. The reactive power operation characteristics of each link of Source-Grid-Load will have a significant impact on the effectiveness of low-voltage load shedding measures. The reactive power regulation capacity of renewable energy source is also a resource worthy of utilization. The precise load shedding scheme can quickly and accurately control the interruptible load as planned, with fast response speed and less impact on the scope of power failure, which can meet the dual requirements of power grid security and high-quality service. Therefore, taking full account of the reactive power operation characteristics of each link of the source network load and taking the low-voltage accurate load shedding measures coordinated by the Source-Grid-Load is an important direction to improve the voltage stability level and reduce the loss of power failure. Combined with the voltage stability problem of Jiangsu power grid, specific solutions are proposed, and the accuracy and effectiveness of the measures was verified by the calculation example.

articleTitle: Multistep Incentive Pricing Decisions for Electricity Retailers to Promote Clean Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of power market reform, power retailers, as agents of many power users with flexible resources, can integrate these large numbers of adjustable loads, and guide users to increase response power by formulating reasonable price incentives. Then, considering the various characteristics of the marginal cost of power users participating in demand response, a stepped incentive pricing model for power retailers to sell electricity in the day-ahead market is designed according to the nonlinear pricing theory. In this paper, the objective function is to maximize the profit of electricity retailers from purchasing and selling electricity, and considering the constraints of incentive compatibility and personal rationality in the mechanism design, a step-wise incentive pricing decision model for electricity retailers is established. This model realizes the optimal purchase and sale strategy of the electricity retailer. The research in this paper shows that when electricity retailers use stepwise price incentives to encourage users to participate in demand response, they can fully invoke user demand response enthusiasm than do not provide any demand response incentives or motivate users at a constant price.

articleTitle: Market-based Coordinated Operation between Aggregators and Microgrids using Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Local electricity market (LEM) has provided an effective solution to the coordination of demand-side resources (DSRs). However, network constraints violations and imbalanced budget problem hinder the application of LEM. To this end, this paper proposes a novel market based coordinated management approach. Firstly, flexible demand aggregators are modeled based on virtual battery model to facilitate the use of small-scale DSRs. Secondly, to deal with the extra expense of LEM caused by network losses, an improved pricing mechanism considering fair loss allocation is proposed. Thirdly, to realize distributed trading decision making while satisfying the network constraints, a multi-agent safe reinforcement learning method is adopted. Case studies under real-world settings validate the effectiveness of the proposed method for the safe and economic coordination of DSRs.

articleTitle: Fault phase selection method of distribution network based on wavelet singular entropy and DBN
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The selection of distribution network faults is of great significance to accurately identify the fault location, quickly restore power and improve the reliability of power supply. This paper mainly studies the fault phase selection method of distribution network based on wavelet singular entropy and deep belief network (DBN). Firstly, the basic principles of wavelet singular entropy and DBN are analyzed, and on this basis, the DBN model of distribution network fault phase selection is proposed. Firstly, the transient fault current data of the distribution network is processed to obtain the wavelet singular entropy of the three phases, which is used as the input of the fault phase selection model; then the DBN network is improved, and an artificial neural network (ANN) is introduced to make it a fault Select the phase classifier, and specify the output label; finally, use Simulink to build a simulation model of the IEEE33 node distribution network system, obtain a large amount of data of various fault types, generate a training sample library and a test sample library, and analyze the neural network. The adjustment of the structure and the training of the parameters complete the construction of the DBN model for the fault phase selection of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Low-voltage Distribution Network Operation Control Architecture based on Cloud-edge-end Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Low-voltage distribution network is the "last 100 meters" connecting users, which is crucial to ensure quality and reliable power supply. Combined with the development trend of low-voltage distribution network, this paper designs the operation control architecture of low-voltage distribution network based on cloud edge-end collaboration, describes the core elements and main functions under this architecture, and analyzes the key technologies involved in cloud edge-end collaboration. Combined with the typical application scenarios of low-voltage distribution network status holographic perception, low-voltage distribution network active emergency repair, energy autonomy and power quality optimization in stations, and orderly charging of electric vehicles, the specific implementation methods are introduced. The conclusion of this paper will provide useful reference for the operation control of distribution network under the background of new power system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Economic Dispatching of Island Operation Multi-energy Complementary Multi-energy System for Park
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Carbon peak and carbon neutrality goals will further accelerate the energy system revolution, promote economic comprehensive green and low-carbon transformation, and promote the diversification of energy utilization structure. A dynamic economic dispatching strategy of island operation multi-energy complementary multi-energy system for park is presented in this paper. Firstly, on the basis of collecting energy supply and demand data from park, the multi-type energy conversion equipment model and energy storage model are established respectively according to the geographical resource endowment. Then, the dynamic economic dispatching model is established by taking the operation cost of multi-energy system as the objective function and considering the multi-type safe operation constraints. Finally, an example is given to verify the rationality and validity of the proposed model and method for dynamic economic dispatching. The proposed model and method can realize optimal operation management of energy in park and provide reference for economic dispatching of multi-energy system in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research on application mode of HYBRID microgrid AC-DC microgrid in large industrial enterprise Park based on energy Router
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: AC-DC hybrid microgrid has advantages of both AC/DC power supply and consumption system, and can meet the access of a variety of distributed power sources, energy storage units and loads. This study focuses on the application mode of ac-DC hybrid microgrid based on energy router.In terms of application mode research of hybrid microgrid with multi-port energy router, topology and coordination control of hybrid microgrid are studied and simulated in detail for typical application scenarios of large industrial enterprise parks.For large industrial enterprise parks, the hybrid microgrid topology of optical storage industrial enterprise parks is constructed to realize the common DC access of distributed power supply, electric vehicles and energy storage.The coordinated control strategy of energy router to controllable resources in the park under multi-mode grid connection is developed.Through the simulation experiment built in DIgSILENT/PowerFactory software, it is verified that the proposed scheme can significantly reduce the loss of industrial enterprise park and reduce the impact on distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Analysis and Isolation Technology of Flexible DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The fault isolation technology of the flexible DC distribution network is the key technology to ensure the reliable power supply of the DC system. However, the characteristics of the rapid current rise and the large overcurrent amplitude of the fault on the DC system side put forward extremely stringent requirements for the isolation technology. This paper studies the mechanism of typical DC short-circuit fault based on MMC system firstly. With the aid of the above findings, an improved MMC topology combined with current limiting device is proposed, and the value calculation of current limiting resistance is explained in detail. Finally, this paper carried out simulation tests to verify the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis and proposed fault current limiting technique based on the Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Programming optimization model of PV-BESS in tegrated system considering transferable demand response
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Adding energy storage equipment to photovoltaic power generation on the user side to form an integrated system with photovoltaic and energy storage can promote the local consumption of photovoltaic. If the electric load participates in the demand response, the load characteristics can be improved. Therefore, in the day ahead optimization of the integrated system with photovoltaic and energy storage, an energy management strategy considering the response of time-of-use price and transferable load demand is proposed to reduce the power consumption cost of users. Then, the programming optimization model of an integrated system with photovoltaic and energy storage is constructed. Firstly, taking the minimum total equivalent annual cost as the objective function, the optimal configuration capacity of photovoltaic and energy storage equipment of the system is determined; Then the power of each piece of equipment is determined with the goal of minimizing the operation cost of the system in one day. The simulation results verify the rationality of the energy management strategy and the model of integrated system with photovoltaic and energy storage.

Author Keywords: integrated system with photovoltaic and energ y storage

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Model of Switchgear Transient Temperature Rise Based on Runge-Kutta Method
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss a fault diagnosis model for the transient temperature rise of the switchgear, which can provide an early warning function and issue an alarm before the temperature of the switchgear conductors exceeds the safe range, thereby further improving the security and intelligence of the power grid. Firstly, the reason for the temperature rise of the switchgear is analyzed under the condition of considering the long-term working system in the thermal calculation of electrical engineering, and a real-time transient thermal circuit model is established. Then measure the physical resistance value of the switchgear circuit, and at the same time measure the heat dissipation area of the heating position through solidworks software, obtain the relationship between the heat dissipation coefficient and the temperature rise through the empirical formula of the heat dissipation coefficient, and lit the curve of the heat dissipation coefficient changing with the temperature rise. Collect the temperature rise test data, use the Runge-Kutta method to solve the differential equation, calculate the temperature change of each conductor under the transient current, and then use the relative temperature difference method as the grade criterion for overheating faults. By building a high-current temperature rise test platform for switchgear, and comparing the calculation results with the test results, it can be seen that the model has high real-time calculation accuracy for conductor temperature, and can provide theoretical support for online monitoring of switchgear operating status and fault early warning. Save time and cost for actual engineering research and development, and shorten the research and development cycle.

articleTitle: Research on application mode of hybrid microgrid based on Energy Router for small remote residential community
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The high proportion of access distributed energy is the future development trend of the new type of power system, the micro grid is play distributed energy efficiency of the effective ways, it is of great social and economic significance, the community is one of the important application in the field of micro grid scenario, small, remote communities, this paper constructed the "source - net - storage - lotus" coordinated control of micro hybrid network architecture. In order to optimize the economic benefit of micro-grid operation and minimize the peak-valley difference between power supply and demand, a mathematical model of day-ahead optimal scheduling of hybrid micro-grid under the guidance of tOU price and compensation incentive is constructed. The hybrid microgrid of landscape storage community with the participation of flexible load is studied to evaluate the mechanism and effectiveness of the microgrid in making up for the limitation of flat peak and valley suppression ability of small capacity energy storage device, adjusting the peak-valley difference of load consumption and improving the operation economy of the microgrid.

articleTitle: Research on hybrid microgrid Networking mode based on energy Router
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: AC-DC hybrid microgrid has the advantages of ac/DC power supply and consumption system. It has flexible operation mode, higher compatibility and expansibility, and can meet the access of various distributed power sources, energy storage units and loads. Meanwhile, it can reduce the energy loss caused by multistage power conversion in a single power supply and consumption mode.Energy router technology not only changes the networking pattern of traditional hybrid microgrid, but also provides the possibility of intelligent scheduling of multi-energy complementary system and independent consumption of clean energy.This study focuses on the networking mode of ac-DC hybrid microgrid based on energy router.In terms of the research on the networking mode of hybrid microgrid with multi-port energy router, based on the typical AC-DC coupling hybrid microgrid structure, this study proposed the topology structure of ac-DC hybrid microgrid based on energy router, namely the networking mode, in order to reduce the system cost and reduce the input amount of power to power converter. Then, the main units of the micro-grid — energy router, distributed photovoltaic, wind power and energy storage are analyzed one by one.Finally, the effectiveness of this networking mode in smoothing fluctuations, power reciprocity and reducing impact on distribution network is simulated and analyzed to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed DC hybrid microgrid networking mode.

articleTitle: Review on power supply mode of multi-station fusion energy station
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increase in the land expropriation costs and installation costs in the metropolis, the expansion of the urban power grid becomes a challenge. The new installation of the substation in the city meets many issues, such as environmental protection, high-cost land price, and other social factors. In order to solve these issues, the multi-station fusion energy station has become a prospective solution in recent years. This paper conducts a comprehensive review of the topology selection and power supply modes for multi-station fusion energy stations. Firstly, the characteristics of the power supply modes and their related topologies are analyzed. Then, the selection methods of topologies in different fusion scenarios are summarized. Based on the analysis, the suggestions of the fusion scheme and power supply mode selection are proposed according to the resource conditions of different substations.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of Energy Management for Ubiquitous Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large-scale photovoltaic construction and access in the county and the lack of control of existing distributed energy, this paper puts forward the construction and operation control method of ubiquitous microgrid, extracts a three-level and two-stage coordination and interaction system supported by county level core area, coordination control unit and multi type microgrid, and the related key technologies are studied and applied. Combined with the actual situation of a county in Zhejiang Province, the construction of the actual system is carried out, the construction of the green power ubiquitous microgrid energy management system is completed, and the problems such as the division of coordination control unit, the cluster dispatching of distributed energy, the analysis of microgrid characteristics and the mutual assistance between microgrids are explored, which effectively improves the elastic space of active distribution network and increases the control ability of power grid dispatching on distributed energy.

articleTitle: Coordinated Suppression Strategy for Continuous Commutation Failure of UHV Hybrid Cascaded DC Based on Forced Excitation of Synchronous Condenser
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The DC transmission system with hybrid cascade at the receiving end has the following two advantages: advantages of conventional DC as well as flexible DC transmission, and is a more downy and economic transmission mode. However, when the receiver of the system fails, such as an AC fault problem, the LCC at the inverter side still has the risk of commutation failure. And when the fault severity is high, this is the stage where DC continuous commutation faults occur frequently, and special attention is needed. By suppressing the incidence of dc continuous commutation faults, the instantaneous state stability of the system after AC faults is guaranteed or even increased, this paper designs a coordinated control strategy combining the strong excitation characteristics of synchronous condenser and the reactive power regulation ability of MMC, which provides reactive power compensation for the system after fault, so as to re-duce the reactive power introduced by the DC system from the receiving end of the power grid and achieve the purpose of stabilizing the receiving end AC bus voltage. Relevant models are establish in PSCAD / EMTDC and simulation verification is carried out. The results show that this strategy can fully exert reactive power compensation ability of MMC itself and the reactive power compensation ability of synchronous condenser under transient excitation control, inhibit the continuous commutation failure of DC, and improve the transient characteristics of the system after fault. Through the coordinated control between the two, it ensures that MMC does not affect its normal operation while providing reactive power compensation, and avoids the damage to its service life caused by the long duration of continuous excitation operation of synchronous condenser.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimization Model for Power Distribution Considering Multiple Stakeholders
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The participation of demand response in power system regulation is an effective supplement to generation side regulation. In order to fully tap the potential of demand side resource regulation, a bi-level optimization model of distribution system is designed considering the interaction and transaction mode among the power grid, distribution system operator (DSO) and load aggregator (LA), and the role and transaction object in the response of each subject are clarified. The upper level considers the coordination and interaction of the internal source, load, storage and LA of DSO, and optimizes the dispatching of the distribution system with the goal of maximizing the profit of DSO; The lower level aims at maximizing LA’s profit of aggregating inverter air conditioners and electric vehicles. Based on the actual operating characteristics of inverter air conditioners and electric vehicles, the demand response model is constructed to fully tap its regulation potential and formulate load regulation strategies. In terms of model solving, the bi-level optimization problem is transformed into an easy to solve linear programming problem through KKT condition and big M method. The example results show that this bi-level model can fully tap the regulation potential of LA, reduce the purchase of electricity from the main network, and improve the income of DSO and LA.

articleTitle: Open-circuit fault diagnosis of wind power converter based on LMD energy entropy and location analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of wind power converters, Aiming at single open circuit and double open circuit faults of grid-side converter (GSC) IGBT modules of permanent magnet synchronous generators (PMSG) wind turbines, an open-circuit fault diagnosis method for wind power converters based on local mean decomposition (LMD) energy entropy and localization analysis is proposed. First, the three-phase output current of the GSC is collected as the original signal, and is decomposed into multi-layer product function (PF) components by LMD, and the energy entropy of the PF component in each state is obtained. Secondly, according to the three-phase current sequence, the positioning parameters are added to determine the upper and lower bridge arms. Finally, the eigenvectors of energy entropy and localization parameters are fused and input into the Stacked Sparse Autoencoder (SSAE) network for training and fault identification. The simulation and experimental results show that the fusion of energy entropy and location analysis makes the fault features more obvious, which can effectively improve the fault diagnosis accuracy compared with other feature extraction algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-period load modeling and regulation potential assessment method for electric bus based on data and model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-period load modeling and regulation potential assessment method for electric bus (EB) based on data and model. Firstly, the load characteristics of EB are analyzed, and the basis for period division is proposed. Then, the shape parameter and physical parameter of the fitting function are determined based on the historical data and physical model through the curve fitting technology, and on this basis, the multi-period load analytical model of EB is established. Finally, according to the judgment conditions of up-regulation and down-regulation, the changes in the number of EB that can participate in the regulation in each period are analyzed, and then the analytical evaluation model of the multi-period regulation potential is obtained. Finally, a numerical example is verified based on the historical data of the actual EB in a certain place. The results show that the method proposed in this paper has strong applicability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Energy System Considering Electricity, Heat and Natural Gas Energy Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the integrated energy system considering electricity, heat and natural gas energy network is taken as the research object. Firstly, the multi-heterogeneous sub-network model of integrated energy system including natural gas network, electric network and heat network is established based on information of geographic topological structure. Secondly, the typical coupling device model of integrated energy system including electric boiler, combined heating and power system, supplementary combustion biomass boiler and solar collector are established. Then, based on the maximization of economic and environmental benefits, the multi-objective operation optimization model is established. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and method on the operation optimization of integrated energy system is verified by an example analysis. The proposed optimization scheduling strategy can provide reference for multi-objective operation optimization of integrated energy system, and provide theoretical guidance for optimize operation, comprehensive scheduling, and planning and design of integrated energy system, optimal allocation of multi-types of resources, and multi-energy cooperation and mutual benefit.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation about characteristic deterioration of Porcelain-housed Surge Arrester with Long service life for 500kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, there have been cases of old arresters exploding under overvoltage in the power systems, and it is urgent to investigate the performance degradation of the arresters which have serviced long time. This paper takes the two-phase arresters A and C as the research object which serviced 22 years on the line side of Puti Station, and sets a arrester with same type that have been serviced for 3 years as the control group, and compares the electrical performance of the new and old arresters horizontally through the test method. Comparing the data of the A and C two-phase arresters in this test with the initial test data and the data during the maintenance test in 2017, the performance degradation of the arresters were analyzed. Disassemble the A and C two-phase arresters to verify the performance degradation and energy tolerance of the resistors which are the core element of the arresters. The test found that the electrical performance of the 22-year-old arrester has shown an obvious aging trend, but the performance of the resistors are still good, meet the standard requirements, and the resistors can be used for a long time according to the Arrhenius' law. The aging performance of the arrester is the result of the combined effect of multiple factors such as service time, the frequency of overvoltage resistance, sealing performance, etc. The aging of sealing performance is the main reason for shortening the life of the arrester. If considering the sealing performance of the arrester is not deteriorated, the porcelain-housed arrester for 500kV power station can meet the total safe operation time of 30 years required by the State Grid's bidding requirements. In the routine operation and maintenance test of the substation, attention should be paid to the changes of parameters such as the reference voltage and leakage current of the arrester. When the DC reference voltage drops by more than 4% and the leakage current exceeds 40μA, it means that the operation of the arrester has a potential safety hazard, and it will be struck by a large overvoltage again. The risk of breakdown and damage is extremely high. Consider replacing the arrester for safety reasons.

articleTitle: A data cleaning method based on spatiotemporal inverse distance weight interpolation for meteorological data in power system
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The scale of modern power grids is huge and the structure is complex, and most of the power equipment is directly exposed to the external environment. In recent years, the problems of global warming and environmental damage have become increasingly prominent. The impact of disasters on the safe and stable operation of power grids has become increasingly prominent. In order to deal with the impact of meteorological disasters on the power grid and reduce the losses caused by meteorological disasters to the power system, it is necessary to build a micrometeorological monitoring station for the power grid, and use the meteorological monitoring data for disaster early warning analysis. However, existing meteorological monitoring stations have a series of data quality problems due to the particularity of their own spatial locations, and there are a lot of dirty data in the original data, which seriously affects the accuracy of subsequent data analysis. To this end, this paper proposes a power meteorological data cleaning method based on spatiotemporal inverse distance weight interpolation. Experiments show that this method can remove most of the dirty data in the original power meteorological data, thereby effectively improving the prediction accuracy of power grid meteorological disasters. Safe and stable operation is of great significance

articleTitle: Data-Driven short-term prediction for top oil temperature of Residential Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Focusing on the background that the state promotes the development of electric distribution network towards digitalization and intellectualization, this paper presents a model for predicting transformer oil temperature by using the electrical data collected by TTU without input parameters, and KS test is used to analysis the sensitivity relationship between predicted oil temperature and the TTU collected data. A comparative analysis of the multi-parameter sensitivity of the factors affecting the oil temperature rise of oil-immersed distribution transformers is carried out by using KS test.The LSTM algorithm is used to overcome the timeliness of the missing information of the GRNN algorithm in predicting the oil temperature, to solve the defect of data processing without timeliness information in the top oil temperature prediction of the oil immersed electric distribution transformer, and to analyze the internal thermal effect of the oil immersed transformer. The heating and heat dissipation mechanism of the transformer is described. The top oil temperature of the transformer is used to replace the hot spot temperature of the transformer to reflect the overall insulation of the transformer.

articleTitle: Topological Identification of Distribution Network Based on μPMU Voltage Phase Data
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The structure of distribution network becomes more and more complex. In order to ensure the safety and stable operation of the system, it is necessary to obtain the current network structure in real time. In order to meet the requirement that the distribution network topology recognition must be fast and accurate, a distribution network topology recognition method based on micro-synchronous Phaser Measurement Unit (μPMU) is proposed. Firstly, the topology identification criterion is constructed by using the voltage and phase data before and after the topology change. Then, a topology recognition algorithm based on phase difference is proposed to analyze the difference between the voltage phase and the actual phase under different topology conditions, and the topology corresponding to the minimum difference is selected as the actual topology to realize the correct recognition of the distribution network. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the correctness of the proposed method, and the influencing factors of topology recognition are analyzed. The results show that the criterion is correct and reliable, and the proposed topology recognition algorithm has high recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: A Practical Approach for Short-Circuit Current Calculation in IIDG-Integrated Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With an ever-increasing number of inverter interface distributed generations (IIDGs) plugged into the distribution grids, the short-circuit characteristics within the distribution network have dramatically changed. It is, therefore, necessary to perform certain verifications or recalibrations to existing relay settings. The existing short-circuit current calculation methods considering IIDG require iterative solutions, which are incompatible with the non-iterative algorithms embedded in traditional relay setting calculation software. This conflict can give rise to major difficulties in practical industrial applications. Besides, iterative methods may encounter the problem of slow convergence or even no convergence. To break down these barriers, this work proposes a novel approach based on IIDG’s point of common coupling (PCC) voltage estimation to calculate IIDG-integrated short-circuit current within engineering permissible error range from the perspective of industrial application. The introduced method first constructs an IIDG equivalent model considering inverters' control strategy. To facilitate the IIDG model's embedment in relay setting calculation software meanwhile remaining its consistency with traditional synchronous machine's fault equivalent model, branches including IIDG are transformed into equivalent series connection form of constant voltage sources and impedances. The analytical expression of the impedance is also ascertained. Utilizing the equivalent model, a non-iterative short-circuit current calculation is conducted, demonstrating better performance in computation efficiency and convergence speed and its compatibility with existing methods in relay setting calculation software. Finally, a simulation is performed on the IEEE 33-bus system to illustrate the superiority of the proposed method

articleTitle: Research on unbalanced capital settlement system in foreign power market
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper preliminarily studies the unbalanced capital settlement system of foreign mature power market. In view of the unbalanced funds faced by the construction and promotion of China's spot market, the typical foreign power markets of Britain, northern Europe, PJM and Australia are selected to study, summarize and compare the generation, settlement, allocation and treatment mechanisms of their unbalanced funds. Three differences of unbalanced capital mechanism between China's current power market and foreign typical power market are analyzed.
