This paper summarizes the Enlightenment of the unbalanced funds in foreign power market on the construction of China's power market in five aspects, and puts forward five suggestions on the unbalanced funds treatment mode and mechanism to adapt to the development of China's power market based on the actual situation of China and the above experience of the unbalanced funds treatment in foreign mature power market. It provides a useful reference for China to further accelerate the construction of the spot market and better connect with the medium and long-term market.

articleTitle: New feeder load forecasting method and its application for New Distribution Grid based on "component - supply area" spatial relationship
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The formulation of new distribution grid planning scheme needs to be based on the electrical calculation of power flow and short-circuit current of planning year, and the load forecasting of electrical components in the unit of feeder is the input condition of the calculation above. A grid planning load mapping method based on spatial membership relationship of "component — supply area" is proposed. Electrical load is mapped to spatial load in current year, and spatial predicted load is mapped back to electrical predicted load in planning year. The "two-way mapping" is used to indirectly realize the micro electrical load forecasting with line as the unit by using the mature space load forecasting method. This method has been applied to the planning project of "online power grid" of 10kV distribution grid in Lunan District, Tangshan and achieved good results. This method not only solves the problem that it is difficult to predict the feeder electrical load in the planning year, but also meets the refinement requirements of "online power grid" electrical calculation, and has strong practical feasibility.

articleTitle: Multi-level Day-ahead Energy Dispatching Method Based on Improving New Energy Consumption Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the energy management problem of high permeability uncertain energy and load connected to distribution network, this paper proposes a multi-level grid dispatching method. Firstly, considering the time and space difference of different distributed generation, the owner of the same distributed generation is divided into one area. On this basis, a distributed energy scheduling mechanism based on local renewable energy consumption and global coordination and optimization of regional distribution network and active distribution network is proposed. Then, the uncertain output models of wind power and photovoltaic are established. Then, the day-ahead optimization models of regional distribution network and active distribution network are established respectively. In the day-ahead optimization model of regional distribution network, considering the uncertainty of renewable energy and electric vehicle load, as well as the effective utilization rate of renewable energy, a multi-objective optimization model aiming at minimizing the operating cost of regional distribution network and maximizing the consumption of renewable energy is established. In the day-ahead optimization model of active distribution network, the minimum voltage deviation and network loss are respectively taken as the objectives, a multi-objective optimization model of active distribution network is established. Finally, an improved 33-bus system is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on day-ahead quotation strategy for cascade hydropower plants considering output coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the high proportion hydropower power market, establishing a reasonable and effective day ahead quotation strategy of hydropower plants is of great significance to ensure the effective participation of hydropower in the market and promote the consumption of hydropower. Firstly, considering the uncertainty of the clearing price of the system on the operation day, based on the identification of historical similar days, the probability prediction method of the day-ahead clearing price is established by using Gaussian process regression. Then, combined with the inherent cost characteristics of hydropower, an analytical calculation method for the day-ahead segmented capacity quotation of the cascade upstream hydropower station is constructed, and the output coupling model between the cascade upstream and downstream hydropower stations is established. Therefore, the biding strategy of downstream power station is obtained based on the output coupling relationship. Finally, the simulation analysis of the day-ahead segmented capacity declaration of cascade hydropower plants verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed bidding strategy of cascade hydropower plants. The simulation results show that the proposed method can provide a reasonable auxiliary decision-making reference for hydropower plants to bid in the day-ahead market.

articleTitle: Fusion Model for Recognition of Single-Phase-to-Ground Fault Caused by Insulation Deterioration in Medium-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Single-phase-to-ground fault caused by insulation deterioration is one of the main fault forms of medium-voltage distribution network, which seriously affects the reliability of power supply. Rapid and accurate identification of insulation deterioration types can improve the efficiency of fault inspection, and is of great significance to prevent further expansion of faults. In this paper, nine waveform features are extracted from the time domain and frequency domain of the single-phase grounding fault waveform data. MANOVA and Pearson correlation coefficients were used to analyze their effectiveness in identifying insulation deterioration types. Furthermore, based on extreme learning machine and support vector machine, the identification models of single-phase grounding fault caused by insulation deterioration are established respectively. On this basis, based on Dempster-Shafer evidence theory, the results of the two recognition models were fused and the comprehensive recognition model was established. Using the obtained field data for verification, it is proved that the integrated model has a good recognition effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of Heating Supply Types of Steam Turbine in Nuclear Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the current characteristics of steam turbines of nuclear power plants in our country, three solutions for heating supply of nuclear power plants are proposed. There are three heating supply methods for steam turbines in nuclear power plants, including extraction steam heating supply, low-pressure cylinder cut-to-cylinder heating supply, and drainage heating supply. Further, a comprehensive comparison and analysis of these three heating supply methods are carried out from the aspects of technical principle, heating energy utilization economy, and comprehensive comparison of heating methods. According to the results of comparative analysis, the technical solution that the steam turbine of the current nuclear power plant in the country should be selected for the heating supply. The calculation and analysis of the heating energy utilization economy of the steam turbine of the nuclear power plant can be used as the original technical basis for the selection of the heating mode of the steam turbine of the nuclear power plant.

articleTitle: The Adaptability Analysis of the Traditional Protections in Offshore Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As one of the most potential renewable energy systems, the offshore wind power has broad research prospects in the world. To ensure the safe operation of the grid, it is very important to study the adaptability of protection of the offshore wind power system. For this reason, in this article, the topology of offshore wind power system is introduced firstly. On this basis, the control strategy and the fault characteristics of the system are analyzed. Second, the protection principles of directional relay, phase selection relay, distance protection and pilot protection are deduced, and the adaptability of the above protections in offshore wind power system are analyzed according to combining the fault characteristics of the system and the protection principle. The PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results verify the effectiveness of the conclusion of the adaptability analysis, it can provide a theoretical basis for the construction of the protection scheme of offshore wind power system.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based photovoltaic subsidy trading mechanism design
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the large number of internal and external collaborators, complex business processes and long cycle chains, the domestic PV subsidy issuance process generally suffers from problems such as subsidy delinquency, settlement difficulties and low regulatory transparency, which cannot meet the business objectives of accurate fund disbursement, immediate business response and transparent subsidy issuance. Blockchain technology has become a new type of distributed bookkeeping and clearing application mode by virtue of its security, decentralization and difficulty in tampering. Scholars at home and abroad have also put forward architectural ideas for the application of blockchain technology in the energy sector. In this paper, we propose a blockchain-based PV subsidy transaction mechanism. In order to finally achieve consistency in the settlement results of metering data by multiple parties of subsidies, we study mechanisms such as PV power generation deposit method, PV subsidy metering data pre-settlement verification, and consensus on the consistency of subsidy amount, and form a decision on whether to submit a completed settlement transaction by endorsing the verification of the results of pre-settlement of metering data by power grids, power generation enterprises and governments. In order to verify the feasibility of the above technology, simulations are conducted for a network topology of 8 nodes for 3 types of subjects, which can support PV subsidy settlement nd PV subsidy business issuance.

articleTitle: Harmonic Elimination Method With Phase- Shifted Current Control in Three-Phase Multi-Drive System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Currently, many three-phase adjustable speed drivers still use diode rectifiers (DR) or semi-thyristor rectifiers (SCR) as front-end rectifiers, but this AC-DC rectification brings a large amount of harmonic current, which distorts the grid current. The existing harmonic elimination strategy is difficult to apply to the multi-drive system due to the high total cost and complexity, so this paper proposes a new method to reduce the harmonic current in the multi-drive system by combining phase-shifting current control and DC modulation, and analyzes the effect of unequal loads between parallel drivers, and uses the load adaptation scheme to ensure that the amplitude of the current drawn from the grid by each rectifier is equal, thereby enhancing the harmonic elimination effect of phase-shifting current control. Simulation and experimental results show the effectiveness of harmonic elimination in the three- phase multi-drive system.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Transformation Model of National Power Network to Integrated Energy Service Providers
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The proposal of "carbon peak" and "carbon neutral" goals has brought new opportunities and challenges to the energy industry. As a leading representative of the energy industry, State Grid is actively facing the new development situation and focusing on the construction of new energy .A new power system is the primary goal to complete the transformation from an electric energy supplier to an integrated energy service provider. This paper studies the advantages and disadvantages of the State Grid's comprehensive energy services, and puts forward the potential comprehensive energy service businesses, business models and related suggestions that can be developed to improve the profitability of State Grid and consolidate the advantages of grid companies in the integrated energy market.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Application Platform Construction for Regional Multi-energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the unavailability of a high-performance platform that facilitates access, control, and running of advanced applications such as dynamic planning and online dispatch of the regional multi-energy system digital twin, this paper uses the CloudPSS platform to design the software and hardware of a safety, facile, and scalable digital twin application platform, including the base layer, application layer, and business layer, while considering the needs of digital twin applications for communication efficiency and data security. The construction process of the digital twin application platform, which includes the functions of modeling, simulation, data interaction, and application integration, is described using the Hongfeng Lake regional multi-energy system in Guizhou, China as a case study. The constructed digital twin application platform’s architecture design scheme and specialized building experience can serve as a theoretical and practical guide for the broad implementation of digital twin technology.

articleTitle: New distribution network intelligent planning project auxiliary platform and synchronous implementation of multi person collaborative planning
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, the development and design of power grid project mid-platform is in full swing. After completion, it can provide enterprises with full caliber, full link and full coverage project integrated management and provide globally standardized and consistent data information. It can be predicted that it is imperative for various projects of provincial companies to be connected to the project mid-platform. The distribution network planning project needs planners to carry out a lot of detailed work from demand to formulation and improvement. The development of each link of these works should not be implemented in project mid-platform. Therefore, a new distribution network intelligent planning project auxiliary platform that can be connected to project mid-platform is developed. The platform can be used as an "input plug" to access the data mid-platform to obtain required input data, and can also be used as an "output plug" to output the prepared complete project to project mid-platform. It provides a solution for the similar business. In the aspect of source side change data capture in synchronous mode, it obtains the source side change data by creating a temporary table, which reduces the amount of transmitted data. In the aspect of data operation identification, the source uses the "combination coding" to update the data and the destination analyzes it by itself, so as to avoid the confusion of interpretation. In order to save the parsing time of a large number of similar statements, the storage procedures of various data operations are formulated in advance at the destination to realize the convenient writing of synchronous data.

articleTitle: Research and prospect of intelligent dispatching strategy of massive flexible resources for regional power grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Under the background of the new type power system in the future, the type and quantity of regulated and flexible resources in the regional power grid will increase rapidly, showing the characteristics of mass, heterogeneity, and wide area. However, centralized dispatching management or weakly centralized distributed management are difficult to take into account the safe, economical, flexible and free operation of the power grid. Therefore, it is urgent to propose a new dispatching architecture that adapts to the access of massive distributed flexible resources. For this reason, this paper first summarizes the centralized, distributed, layered and distributed scheduling architecture of the power grid, and the organization and operation mode of flexible resources, analyzing with "energy integrated prosumer→energy aggregator agents→distributed microgri→autonomous energy grid→energy self-organizing system" is the context of resource organization and management evolution law, summarizing the key technologies of flexible resource perception, prediction, and operation intelligent control based on deep reinforcement learning and other methods, and proposes a scheduling framework based on the coexistence of Internet thinking mode and scheduling platform management mode. Finally, we look forward to the future massive flexible resources to participate in regional power grid regulation, to meet the grid security, efficient and economical operation.

articleTitle: Power System Risk Assessment System considering Regional Power Market Transaction
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The comprehensive advancement of the new round of power system reform will have a lot of impact on the power system, mainly considering the impact of frequent regional power market transactions on power system risk assessment. Firstly, a demand response model of active load-rate closed-loop feedback is constructed. Secondly, under the condition of real-time electricity price fluctuation and different regional power market trading scenarios, a comprehensive risk assessment index system is constructed, and on this basis, a risk assessment process for adapting to the new power system reform is proposed. Finally, the Latin hypercube sampling method is used to conduct a risk assessment of the possible operating state of the power system. The simulation results of the actual case show that the new power constitution reform will increase the system operation risk, and the active load-electric price closed-loop feedback will improve the system's risk level, and verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Information Disclosure Mechanism and Practice under Electricity Market Regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electricity market is a market with serious asymmetric information. The basic principles of its operation are fairness, justice and openness. A reasonable, effective and transparent information disclosure is the basis of electricity market regulation and is conducive to discovering abnormal market behaviors and inefficiencies. Improving the electricity market information disclosure mechanism under the regulation of the electricity market will help provide sufficient information for market members, guide market members to bid rationally, and promote the optimal allocation of resources. Based on full reference to the information disclosure mechanism of domestic and foreign electricity markets, and based on the information disclosure method of the electricity market with the optimal allocation of information resources, the Yunnan electricity market information disclosure mechanism is established to gradually determine the scope and method of disclosure of information in the electricity market. With the gradual advancement of the spot market, the frequency of transactions will be higher and the transaction information will increase, and market entities will have higher requirements for information disclosure. It is necessary to establish a more adequate and reasonable information disclosure mechanism. Transparency of operations to meet the requirements of full competition in the market.

articleTitle: The method of improving the lightning resistance level of 10kV multi-circuit overhead line with parallel gap
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The method of single phase same line installation of parallel gaps on a can effectively improve the lightning resistance level of 10kV overhead distribution lines. However, current related research methods only involve the effect on the lightning withstands level of 10kV single-circuit overhead lines. There are still problems in the matching of the number of parallel gaps, installation positions and discharge voltage values in multi-circuit lines. In this paper, a 10kV double-circuit overhead line lightning overvoltage simulation calculation model is established by ATP-EMTP. For multi-circuit 10kV overhead lines, the configuration method of single-phase installation parallel gap is considered, and the calculation process of the line lightning resistance level under different parallel gap installation methods is obtained. Taking double-circuit line as an example, the optimal installation method of parallel gap is obtained under inductive lightning and when lightning strikes tower top. The results provide a reference for the application of lightning protection methods for 10kV multi-circuit overhead lines.

articleTitle: Research on Economie Dispatch Problem Based on Accelerated Dynamic Adjustment Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to save energy, reduce carbon and realize sustainable development, the economic dispatch problem with valve-point effects is studied in this paper. Firstly, summarize the solving methods of economic dispatch problem in the previous literature, and put forward the problems of the current solving methods. Then, an accelerated dynamic adjustment differential evolution algorithm is proposed. By introducing chaotic initialization operation, a nonlinear dynamic adjustment strategy of control parameters is formulated, and an accelerated convergence strategy is proposed to comprehensively improve the performance of the algorithm. Finally, the proposed method is verified by numerical simulation, and compared with other methods in terms of result accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Distributed Power Flow Calculation Considering Limiting Constraints of Photovoltaic Inverters
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In networked microgrids, each microgrid is usually managed by an independent operator, and it is difficult to adapt to the actual situation of data privacy protection and distributed management among microgrids by using the global power flow method, so distributed power flow should be used for analysis. Existing distributed power flow algorithms rarely solve the problem of non-smooth limits of distributed photovoltaic, and the non-smooth constraints such as limits will cause the microgrid power flow to not converge. This paper proposes a distributed power flow calculation method considering limiting constraints of photovoltaic inverters. Firstly, the non-smooth limits models for DG are established based on complementary constraints, and smoothed by Fischer-Burmeister (FB) function; then, according to the requirements of distributed management, the networked microgrids is partialized, and the boundary coordination equation of coordination side is established in the form of implicit function, which is solved by the Jacobian-Free Newton-GMRES (JFNG) algorithm, avoiding the explicit Jacobian matrix. Finally, an example is used to verify the accuracy of the proposed distributed algorithm and the effectiveness of the non-smooth characteristic processing method.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Tie Switch Between Distribution Lines Considering Multi-Criteria Matching of Net Load Curves
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The access of a high proportion of distributed photovoltaic has brought challenges to the economic and safe operation of distribution networks. Aiming at solving insufficient photovoltaic absorption and low equipment utilization efficiency of the distribution networks, an optimal configuration method of tie switch considering multi-criteria matching of distribution lines is proposed. Matching criteria of distribution lines are put forward according to net load curve correlation, net load magnitude and net load curve segmentation. A two-layer optimal configuration model of tie switch between matched distribution lines is established, the upper-level model takes the investment cost and network loss cost as objective functions, and the lower-level model takes the operating cost and degree of load balancing as objective functions. A hybrid algorithm combining improved genetic algorithm and second-order cone programming method is used to solve the problem. The simulation results show that the optimal configuration of tie switch based on the multi-criteria matching of distribution lines can improve the photovoltaic absorption and equipment utilization efficiency, and ensure the economic and safe operation of the distribution networks.

articleTitle: The Impact of Zero-sequence Current Transformer Measuring Accuracy on High-impedance Earth Fault Detection in Distribution Networks (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High-impedance earth faults in medium voltage distribution networks are very difficult to detect and isolate because of the negligible fault current. The reliability of high-impedance earth fault detection depends on the measuring accuracy of zero-sequence current transformers. There are many published studies in the field of earth fault detection in distribution networks, which lacks the research on engineering problems such as the influence of the measuring accuracy of the zero-sequence current transformer and its selection. This paper firstly analyzes the influence of zero-sequence current transformer measuring accuracy on detection. The paper then presents the measurement error test results on the common types of zero-sequence current transformers used in projects. Finally, combined with the measurement error test results, the paper proposes guidelines for the selection of the zero-sequence current transformer and the measures to be taken to improve its measurement accuracy. (Abstract)

articleTitle: An ADMM-based fully distributed robust state estimation algorithm for mixed-integer nonlinear programming
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: State estimation is the basis for the safe and reliable operation of power systems. On the one hand, the existence of bad data seriously affects the accuracy of the estimation results; on the other hand, the centralized state estimation calculation requires global grid information, which leaks information privacy and increases the communication burden. In this paper, a fully distributed robust state estimation algorithm based on the alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) with mixed-integers nonlinear programming (MINLP) is proposed to detect the measurement error and obtain the state estimation solution. In this algorithm, first, a large-scale system is decomposed into multiple small systems by the node replication method, and a robust state estimation independent model with MINLP is constructed in parallel for each small system by introducing consistent variables. In this algorithm, the system only needs to exchange boundary coupling node information with adjacent systems to update its consistency variables and Lagrange multiplier information, thus realizing the protection of information privacy. The calculation example verifies that the algorithm proposed in this paper can accurately and effectively detect the bad data in each system, and obtain the same solution as the centralized one.

articleTitle: Review on the Application of Power Flow Control Technology on the Practical Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Unified power flow controller (UPFC), static synchronous series compensator (SSSC) and phase shifting transformer (PST) can change line parameters and control power flow, which have been used in the practical power system. This paper aims to summarize and prospect the research about the application of these devices. Firstly, the basic principle and the structure of these power flow control equipment are analyzed, and their practical projects are introduced. Secondly, the research status of these devices is summarized from five aspects: control strategy, fault protection, locating and sizing, converter and measurement. Finally, the typical application scenarios of power flow control devices in power grids are forecasted, and the trend of future power flow control technology is prospected.

articleTitle: Partition load reduction algorithm based on Contribution coefficient and load importance
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to quickly and accurately evaluate the reliability of the planned power grid, an effective regional load reduction algorithm based on load contribution is proposed. Firstly, the breadth first algorithm(BFA) is used to calculate the effective load reduction area of the fault component, and the conventional load reduction calculation is transformed from the overall optimization of the whole network to small-scale local optimization in the effective area to reduce the calculation scale. Secondly, the DC power flow model is used to calculate the load contribution factor, and the load weight is calculated by combining the load importance. The significance of load weight means that it can not only clarify the utilization of load to power supply, but also take into account the importance of load itself. Then the AC power flow model is used to solve the optimal load reduction in the effective area of load reduction according to the order of load weight from big to small. Finally, the power flow of the network after load reduction is calculated again to verify whether each electrical index of the system exceeds the limit. The validity and rapidity of the model are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Demand response characteristics of photovoltaic users based on social evolutionary game
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the information interaction and policy learning characteristics of bounded rational users in the process of responding to electricity prices or incentive measures, this paper proposes a user demand response analysis model based on an evolutionary game model on social networks. First, considering that real economic people have information interaction and strategy learning and updating in decision-making, and the information interaction is a complex community system, the information interaction relationship between users is described by constructing a social network; secondly, according to the electricity price theory and The power supply and demand balance relationship, the response decision of a single user will affect the interests of other users, the game model is used to describe the decision-making process of group users; finally, considering the bounded rationality of users' processing of the acquired information, based on the evolution of social networks Game model to describe the user's response process to electricity prices and incentives. Simulations analyze the impact of different social network structures and electricity prices or incentives on user responses. The results show that the enhancement of the small world attribute of the user's social network will improve the user's response, and the increase of the price coefficient will reduce the user's willingness to use electricity.

articleTitle: Adjustment Method of Insulation Level Difference between 10kV Overhead Line and Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The single-phase installation method of 10kV overhead bare conductor with parallel gap can effectively improve the lightning resistance level of the line, but it further expands the difference in insulation level between the line and the equipment, and the power distribution equipment is more vulnerable to damage. It is not economically feasible to improve the insulation level of power distribution equipment and the current capacity of the zinc oxide arrester (MOA) at the front end of the equipment, this paper adopts the method of installing coupling ground wire at the end of 10kV line to solve this problem. The shunt principle of the coupled ground wire is studied, and it is considered that the number of poles and the grounding resistance of the poles are the main factors that affect the shunt effect. A 10kV overhead bare-conducting line overvoltage simulation model under the parallel gap single-phase installation mode is established. The calculation results show that in a typical configuration of 10kV overhead lines, when the induction point of the induced lightning is 4 base poles before the distribution transformer, the maximum overcurrent energy of MOA passing through high voltage side of distribution transformer exceeds the threshold of safe operation; at this time, the coupling ground wire is installed on the two base poles before the distribution transformer, and the poles and towers do not need to be grounded to limit the flow of the MOA on the high-voltage side, it can limit the overcurrent amplitude and thermal charge transfer value of MOA flowing through the high voltage side to below the safety threshold, the maximum reduction is 69.4% and 83.5%, respectively. The proposed method plays an important role in reducing the failure rate of power distribution equipment and maintaining the safe and stable operation of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimization of microgrid with electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: How to realize the coordinated operation of electric vehicles (EV) and microgrid is a research hotspot in the field of electric vehicles. In this paper, the architecture, operation mode, output characteristics and mathematical model of microgrid including EVs are analyzed, and the disorderly charging load model of EVs is established by using Monte Carlo method. Aiming at the optimization and coordination operation of EVs connected to microgrid, an objective function was established so as to minimize the comprehensive cost and peak-to-valley difference of microgrid. To solve the high-dimensional, nonlinear and multi-objective model, an improved PSO is used. Finally, by setting up two scenarios of disordered charging and coordinated optimized operation of electric vehicles, the output of each distributed generations, comprehensive operating cost and peak-to-valley difference in microgrid are compared. The result presents the scientificity and effectiveness of the techniques proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Harmonic Elimination Method of SCR Firing Angle Linear Distribution of Three-phase Multi- drive System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Adjustable speed drives (ASD) are widely used in three-phase multi-drives in the industry. For simplicity, in practice, the front-end rectifier still uses a low-cost, simple control structure diode rectifier (DR) or silicon-controlled rectifier (SCR). However, the non-linearity and time-varying nature of the rectifier will bring a lot of harmonic currents to the power grid, causing serious harmonic pollution. The harmonic problem in the multi-drive system must be solved. The existing harmonic elimination strategy is difficult to apply to the multi-drive system because of the high total cost and complexity. Therefore, this paper proposes a harmonic elimination strategy for the three-phase multi-drive system, so that the firing angle of the SCR drive unit is linear Distribute, control the phase shift of the SCR input current, and at the same time use DC modulation on the DC side to improve the controllability of the harmonic current, thereby reducing the harmonics appearing in the power grid. Simulation and experimental results prove the effectiveness of this scheme in harmonic elimination in a three-phase multi-drive system.

articleTitle: A CoAP-based Communication Mapping Method for Power Distribution Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> This paper studies a constrained application protocol (CoAP) mapping method based on EEC61850 for achieving the abstract communication service interface (ACSI) to solve the problems of weak monitoring, poor equipment interconnection, and difficult maintenance in the low-voltage power distribution Internet of Things (IoT). It can realize the interconnection, interoperability and access of large-scale sensing terminal equipment. The requirements of power consumption, transmission rate, device performance and deployment cost of terminal devices in consideration of the resource-constrained operation scenarios of distribution IoT devices are analyzed to determine the subset of ACSI services. In addition, the communication service method adopted when the system is designed is directly mapped, which not only accelerates the speed of information transmission, but also greatly simplifies the conversion time between IEC61850 and data. In this paper, based on the operation process of CoAP distributed Internet technology, a new data resource access form is developed, which can not only quickly convert SCL files into URIs, but also access the flies. Further, considering the coding efficiency and cost of the existing coding methods in IEC61850 and the Internet of Things, the operation mode of the ASN.1BER data runtime is made, so as to construct a separate CoAP data mapping method. Finally, we also conducted detailed tests to verify the characteristic of CoAP mapping with help of data test platform, proving the feasibility of this method from multiple perspectives.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Power Quality Based on IFAHP-CRITIC and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the uncertainty in the process of comprehensive evaluation of power quality, a power quality evaluation method based on IFAHP-CRITIC and TOPSIS method is proposed. Firstly, the power quality evaluation index is selected, and the subjective weight is determined by Intuitionistic fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (IFAHP). Secondly, the objective weight is determined by the Criteria Importance Through Intercriteria Correlation (CRITIC); then, in order to avoid using only IFAHP to make too many subjective factors and using only CRITIC to make the evaluation results lack of subjective factors, a subjective and objective combination weighting model using the least squares method is constructed, and the optimal combination weight method using the artificial bee colony algorithm is proposed. Finally, the relative closeness between each monitoring point and the ideal solution is solved by using Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS), so as to sort the power quality monitoring points and evaluate their power quality levels is determined. The example results show the effectiveness and correctness of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Configuration Technology of Secondary Equipment Configuration Test in Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of electric internet of things, substation focuses on building an intelligent system with intelligent information processing and convenient and flexible application. The secondary equipment is updated frequently, and the method of manual test configuration has been difficult to meet the work requirements. This paper presents an automatic configuration method of secondary equipment based on knowledge graph technology. Build the test knowledge graph of secondary equipment, and establish the knowledge association between intelligent electronic device (TED) file and test configuration, test equipment, configuration information point and information path. Based on the word2vec model, the word embedding vector of the secondary equipment test proprietary vocabulary is fused, and then the mapping relationship is deduced based on the information retrieval path and the text similarity of the configuration file. The experimental results show that the method of automatic configuration of secondary equipment test based on knowledge graph is scientific, effective, and has high accuracy, which is suitable for practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Practical calculation method of reliability and grid risk value of terminal station in transmission grid and its application
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Transmission grid has been playing a vital role in power system. If the 500kV newly built substation in future can be built in the form of terminal substation, it will greatly save investment and corridor resources. On the basis of meeting the security and stability of transmission grid, this paper calculates the reliability and grid risk value index, and gives the general calculation process. At the same time, zoning load reduction algorithm based on load importance is used. Combined with SHENZHEN 500kV HG substation, the calculation results of hub substation and terminal substation are compared. The example results show that the proposed algorithm is fast and effective, the required input parameters are easy to obtain, and has high practical value.

articleTitle: Research Status and Prospect of Integrated Energy Service Standardization in China
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Integrated energy services are an important measure to cope with the energy crisis in today's society, carry out multi-energy efficient utilization, and thus promote the continuous green transformation of energy. Its purpose is to provide users with energy solutions that meet the development direction of low-carbon energy and meet the actual needs of customers. In the face of the external situation such as the continuous deepening of energy transformation and the increasingly urgent demand for innovative development, it is imperative to carry out research on the standardization of integrated energy services. First of all, the development status of integrated energy services and related industry standard systems and the development of integrated energy service business in China are analyzed and investigated; Then, the current standards that are strongly related to integrated energy services and the standards with reference significance for the formulation of integrated energy service standards are statistically counted, and the distribution of standards is analyzed from the aspects of level, effective time, category, industry field, etc.; Finally, in view of the distribution of comprehensive energy service related standards, the demand for comprehensive energy service standards is analyzed and discussed, which provides a reference for the formulation and revision of comprehensive energy service standards in China.

articleTitle: Experimental research on disturbance waveform characteristics of secondary side signal port of electronic voltage transformer under the operation of GIS isolating switch (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electronic voltage transformer (EVT), which has been widely used in smart substations, exposes serious electromagnetic compatibility problems under the operation of the isolation switch, among which the fault of the collector is the most prominent. In order to analyze the reasons for the failure of the collector, this paper simulates and reproduces the IEC 62271-102-2018 busbar (pipe) section test circuit with very short opening and closing on the 220kV GIS real simulation test platform. And more than 200 times of isolation switch pull test and port disturbance waveform measurement were carried out for 5 EVTs. The applicability and difference between the measured waveform and IEC related standards were quantitatively evaluated from the perspective of waveform characteristic parameters, waveform correlation and normalized energy characteristics. The research results show that only the maximum amplitude and intensity of the measured disturbance waveform are higher than the IEC61000-4-18 fast damped oscillatory wave assessment requirements, and the rest of the characteristics have good similarity and equivalence with the standard waveform. The work done in this paper can provide the basis for the port protection and test assessment of EVT acquisition unit under strong transient electromagnetic disturbance.

articleTitle: Fault Simulation and Protection Test of Compressed Air Energy Storage Generating Set Based on RTDS(CICED 2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to meet the dynamic test requirements of large-capacity compressed air energy storage generator set protection before it is put into operation, this paper relies on RTDS real-time simulation software to establish a fault simulation and protection test platform for large-capacity compressed air energy storage generators. By analyzing the modeling principles and deficiencies of RTDS's own PDSM generator model, and combining the characteristics of unit excitation and stator winding interfaces, the PDSM generator model is externally modified to meet the test requirements of generator protection. On this basis, a test scheme for the relay protection of large-capacity compressed air energy storage generators is proposed, and the applicability and effectiveness of the test platform are verified by simulation. Furthermore, the limitations of the existing platform in the simulation of winding grounding and short-circuit faults are analyzed, and the future improvement direction is clarified.

Author Keywords: Compressed air energy storage power station

articleTitle: Research on Fault Location Algorithm for Line Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The algorithms of fault location by impedance, dual-end fault location and three-end fault location are introduced, and their application effects are analyzed and compared. Fault location by impedance, which uses voltage and current at one end of the line to calculate the impedance, may result in significant errors because the information of fault points can not be obtained and the influence of grounding resistance can not be overcomed. The dual-end fault location, which is implemented using longitudinal current differential protection, greatly improves the accuracy of fault location because it reduces the influence of unfavorable factors such as transition resistance compared with the fault location by impedance. However neither fault location by impedance nor dual -end fault location can realize fault location of T-connected lines. In this paper, a new method, three-end fault location, for identifying the fault point occurring at the crossover point is proposed, which is easy and accurate to calculate the voltage threshold of the crossover point, and then identify the fault branch and complete the accurate fault location. The simulation test shows that this method is not affected by transition resistance and can be applied to various operation modes. Morover, it can get accurate fault location on weak power side.

articleTitle: Research on the Market Consumption Mechanism of Renewable Energy in Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the context of the construction of a new power system, a large number of renewable energy projects have been put into operation.The full purchase mode of fixed electricity price is an effective incentive policy in the early stage of renewable energy development. However, as the scale of renewable energy sources increases, it becomes more difficult to raise subsidies. Active participation in the electricity market is a necessary choice for its larger-scale development.Based on the current situation and existing problems of renewable energy market consumption in Yunnan Province, this paper proposes two solutions for renewable energy market consumption.The first is the "electricity assessment" scheme, which is suitable for a large number of renewable energy to participate in market consumption in the future.The second is the" Spread Subsidy",which is simple and easy to implement under the current circumstances and can be used as a transitional plan.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Characteristics of CF3I Mixtures under Different Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: SF6 has strong greenhouse effect and many countries have enacted laws restricting the use of the gas. There have been several feasible alternatives to SF6. As an environmental friendly gas with excellent insulation characteristics, CF3I has the hope of replacing SF6 in medium and low voltage electrical equipment. In this paper, the influence of pressure and gap distance on the insulation strength of CF3I-N2 mixed gas was studied, and the results show that the insulation strength of CF3I-N2 mixture increases with the increase of CF3I mixture ratio. In slightly inhomogeneous electric field, the breakdown voltage of CF3I-N2 increases linearly with the increase of discharge gap, and the increase rate is proportional to the pressure. The breakdown voltage of CF3I-N2 gas mixture shows a trend of saturation with the gap in the extremely non-uniform electric field.

articleTitle: Research on Dispatch Instruction Voucher Storage Mechanism for Load Dispatch Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of multi-party interaction and data trust in load dispatching, this paper explores the credentialization technology of dispatching instruction in load dispatch and control scenarios. This paper designs a voucher storage mechanism of load dispatch instructions based on Blockchain, and analyzes the storage content and on-chain storage mode. It provides a solution for future massive load resource participation dispatch.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Isolated Operation Mode of DC Distribution System with Battery Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the application scenario of DC distribution system supplying for AC passive network using voltage source converter (VSC), the bidirectional DC-DC converters should be connected with the battery energy storage devices to maintain the DC voltage unchanged. Firstly, the small signal dynamic equation of VSC is established by treating the AC load as constant power model for modeling simplification. Secondly, the control strategies of DC voltage-controlled and power-controlled DC-DC converters are studied as well as the small signal models of the two types according to the voltage stability requirement of DC bus. Thirdly, taking the DC network system as the connection nodes, the integrated state space model of whole system is established. The influence of steady-state operating points, main circuit parameters and the control system parameters on the stability of the DC distribution system is studied. Finally, the correctness of modeling and conclusion are verified by the electromagnetic transient simulation models.

articleTitle: Research on Analysis Method of Influence Degree of Distribution Network Operation Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This article takes actual load-duration-curve as research object, that describes a distribution network device in one year working hours' efficiency, and analyzes the degree of power distribution capacity during the device evaluation period. When we need to evaluate and analyze the operation efficiency of the distribution network in a certain area, we need to analyze it according to the operation efficiency evaluation model, and then we will further analyze the weak links, such as which sub-items will affect the overall impact on the operational metrics, and finally we will be able to know these weaknesses that need to be solved first. This paper proposes a three-level analysis method for the influence degree of distribution network operation efficiency. The index model of the influence degree of single equipment, similar equipment at the same level, and system operation efficiency are built. The practicability and effectiveness of this method is verified through examples. The proposed method can make up for the shortcomings of the distribution network operation efficiency evaluation model in the analysis of weakness. The method can help to find the key factors affecting the distribution network operation efficiency more accurately, and the direction and measure of the distribution network optimization are further proposed.

articleTitle: Distributed Voltage Coordinated Control Method For Wind Farm Considering Unit Consistency
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The topology of doubly fed turbine has a great influence on the regulation and control of wind farm voltage. Therefore, a reactive power optimization method considering the voltage deviation at the generator terminal is proposed. Firstly, the influence of feeder voltage and reactive power distribution in the wind farm on the generator terminal voltage is analyzed, and a reactive power optimization model is established with the minimum deviation between the grid point voltage and the generator terminal voltage. Then, the reactive power and voltage control strategy of distributed wind power including control node selection, reactive power command calculation and reactive power distribution is proposed. Finally, a wind farm is simulated. The results show that the control method can enhance the stability of the grid voltage of wind power, and reduce the deviation of generator terminal voltage in wind farm and improve the reliability of wind power grid connection.

articleTitle: Post-disaster distribution network resilience improvement strategy based on optimal configuration of mobile energy storage
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution network is an important bridge to ensure the power consumption of power users. Therefore, the resilience of distribution network should be improved for small probability and large impact events caused by extreme disasters. This paper presents a resilience improvement strategy of distribution network based on movable energy storage equipment (MESS) configuration. Firstly, the distribution network resilience identification index is proposed to measure the resilience improvement effect of this method. Secondly, considering the importance of distribution networks in different regions, different configuration weights are established, and MESS is introduced to support the operation power of post disaster distribution network. Aiming at minimizing the cost of post disaster MESS configuration, operation and load shedding, and considering the constraints of distribution network operation and mess operation, a single-layer model of post disaster optimal dispatching operation of distribution network is formed. Finally, the IEEE-33 node standard test system is used for example analysis to verify the applicability of the proposed optimization strategy.

articleTitle: Nuclear magnetic resonance and infrared spectroscopy method for aging state of composite insulators
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Composite insulators are widely used in power systems; however, the aging caused by long time operation threatens the safety of the power system. In order to detect the aging level of composite insulators, nuclear magnetic resonance analysis method is used in this paper to extract the characteristic quantity representing the aging status of silicon rubber insulators from the low-field nuclear magnetic resonance signal. This characteristic quantity can be used to explain the aging mechanism of insulator. Meanwhile, the composite insulator samples were analyzed by infrared spectroscopy. Compared the result of nuclear magnetic resonance analysis and infrared spectroscopy analysis, it was shown that the NMR measurement result of the composite insulator was consistent with the absorption peak of the outer layers of ir spectrum, both results could reflect the aging level of the composite insulator in a certain extent. When the aging level of insulator becomes higher, the value T2 of NMR becomes smaller and the absorption value of ir spectrum becomes lower.

articleTitle: Study on Gas Production Characteristics of Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery Module under High and Low Temperature CO2
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The explosion catastrophes resulting from the lithium-ion battery thermal runaway gas production has severely suppressed the application and development of lithium-ion batteries energy storage systems in recent years. CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> has good insulation performance and deactivation performance and is suitable for gas explosion proof of electrical equipment The 2.56 kWh lithium iron phosphate battery module's (LIBM) thermal runaway gas generation characteristics are suppressed using low temperature carbon dioxide (L-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and high temperature carbon dioxide (H-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) by different injection modes in this work. With H-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> whole cabin jet, explosive gas concentration in LIBM decreases at a faster pace than with L-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> whole cabin jet, and the CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> concentration drops to below the explosion limit in just 6 min. When L-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is injected into the module, the LIBM explosive gas concentration declined more quickly than the H-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and the CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> concentration reached below the explosion limit in under 21min. The factors influencing the explosive gas drop rate are examined. H-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sublimates quickly onto dry ice under the whole cabin jet, and explosive gas may be diluted effectively, the influence of diluted gas is stronger than that of cooling inhibition. In the injection module, the cooling performance of L-T CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is better, and the gas production rate of lithium iron phosphate is slower. Compared to diluting gas, low temperature inhibition has a stronger affect. The findings indicate that lowering chemical processes within the battery and diluting the explosive gas concentration can both greatly speed up the explosive gas concentration decline. This information can be used to guide LIBM energy storage systems in preventing gas explosions.

articleTitle: Suppression of Waveform Oscillation by Circulating Current Suppression Control When Offshore Wind Farms Connected to Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the control oscillation and low frequency oscillation generated when the offshore wind farm and the modular multilevel converter system are connected to the grid are studied. Firstly, this paper describes the system topology diagram of the modular multilevel converter. Secondly, the paper analyzes the principle of the double-frequency circulating current. Then, based on the principle of suppression the double-frequency circulating current, the paper deduces the transfer function of the circulating current suppression, and finally gives the calculation method of the control parameters. Finally, this paper optimizes the circulating current suppression control by modifying the cutoff frequency, and suppresses the oscillation problem that occurs when the grid is connected.

articleTitle: Study on Technical and Economic Evaluation Model of Distribution Network Project
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper adopts comprehensive evaluation method, established a power distribution network technical economy investment model for the power distribution network. Based on the comprehensive benefit analysis of the power distribution network project, the index system of distribution network project is established from three dimensions: safety and reliability benefit, economic benefit and social benefit, combined with the actual operation of power grid companies to formulate corresponding evaluation standards.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Full-scale Transformer Water Fire Extinguishing System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Using the 110kV real transformer fire extinguishing test platform as the simulation model, the simulation calculation of the water spray and water mist fire extinguishing system for large-scale fires under the full scale of the transformer was carried out. The results showed that: when the fire extinguishing medium is pure water, neither of the two fire extinguishing methods can extinguish the fire, but only has a cooling effect, and the cooling effect of the water mist system is better than that of the water spray system; the flame shifts toward the firewall side, resulting in a significant increase in the temperature near the wall; the two extinguishing methods have obvious effects on reducing the concentrations of carbon monoxide and soot.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Mobile Test System for 10kV Distribution Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of difficulty in entering the testing equipment, repeated assembly, and low test efficiency in the handover test of distribution equipment, a set of intelligent mobile detection system for the handover test of 10kV distribution transformers and voltage transformers was designed. Firstly, the overall design of intelligent mobile detection technology including high and low voltage measurement module, power supply module, control switching module, sensor module and data storage module is proposed. Secondly, use switching control technology to develop a set of integrated automatic test control software to realize automatic measurement and data storage of test items. Finally, the prototype of the intelligent mobile detection system for 10kV power distribution equipment is realized and the application test of related test items is carried out. The results show that the system is accurate in test, high in intelligence and flexible in deployment, which can significantly improve the efficiency of on-site detection.

articleTitle: Filtering Method of Transformer Noise Acoustic Signal Based on WOA-VMD-FASTICA and Improved Mutual Fuzzy Entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since the traditional blind source separation method can not effectively filter out the instantaneous interference and the noise of the transformer cooling fan, the disadvantage of causing uncertainly in the correspondence between the separated signal and the source signal. This essay proposes a new whale optimization algorithm to optimize variational modal parameters combined with fast independent component analysis and an improved fuzzy entropy transformer noise sound signal filtering method. First and foremost, decompose the fault acoustic signal of the fault transformer decomposed into multiple sub-model components through whale-optimized variational modal parameters, to satisfy the positive definite condition of blind source separation for mixed signals. And besides, use the fast independent component analysis method to construct the source signal on the modal components. Finally, combined with the improved fuzzy entropy, the noise signal in the source signal is set to zero through the threshold criterion, filters out the instantaneous interference and fan noise, and the transformer acoustic signal is reconstructed, and the reconstructed sound signal is better-preserved transformer body acoustic signal Combined with the analysis of the acoustic signal data collected in the field, the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified.

articleTitle: Application of Passive IoT Technology in Digital Development of Distribution Network (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The integration of digital technology and power grid technology will facilitate the transformation and upgrade of the energy supply system and promote the high-quality development of the economy and society. Due to the limitations of power supply mode and communication distance, traditional communication technology seriously restricts the function of key information collecting and transmission in some power distribution network operation scenarios. Passive IoT technology combines Passive sensor IoT communication technology with cellular mobile communication network without the external power supply, and enables remote transmission of pre-stored identity, temperature, and humidity from sensors. It has two modes: label connection mode and limited sensor connection mode. It can be applied to the digital assets management of power distribution equipment and the operation status monitoring of distribution cables and other equipment to solve the shortage problem of power supply in the operation environment of power distribution equipment. The application design, which is based on the low-voltage distribution area and combined with Passive IoT technology, greatly enriches the ways of collecting the information from ends by the cloud center in the intelligent power distribution area system, addressing the weakness during the construction of digitalized and intelligent low-voltage power distribution system, and accelerate the digital transformation of power distribution equipment management.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of comprehensive reference current extraction strategy based on Goertzel-IIR filter
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The reference current detection algorithm is a key technology for active filter and reactive power compensation devices, as its extraction accuracy directly affects output current of this kind of equipment. Traditional harmonic detection algorithm based on instantaneous reactive power has the problems of complex coordinate transformation, slow response speed of low-pass filter and low extraction precision. To address these issues, the Goertzel-IIR filter is adopted and implanted into the SDFT by mathematical transformation, on the base of which the comprehensive extraction scheme of harmonic, reactive and unbalanced reference currents is proposed. Finally, the correctness of the proposed stability analysis is validated via simulation in MATLAB, the simulation results show that the reference current detection algorithm can extract the comprehensive current quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Sag Treatment Equipment Based on Fast Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In terms of power supply quality, the treatment of voltage sag has always been a thorny issue. The depth and duration of voltage sag are the two most important characteristics, with the latter being the most important factor affecting power supply quality. In this paper, a voltage sag treatment equipment (VSTE) based on fast vacuum circuit breaker (FVCB) is proposed, which can greatly shorten the voltage sag time. It consists of a fast fault detection device, a normal vacuum circuit breaker, a FVCB, and a shunt reactor. The equipment is mainly used in the cascade Busbar or feeder of the distribution network, and when a voltage sag fault occurs, it can achieve the upper Busbar voltage at the equipment installation to quickly maintain at 0.8~0.9 times of the rated value at the first half-wave. The working principle of the VSTE is mainly explained through simulation research in this study, and the significant effect of voltage sag treatment is verified through testing.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation of Human Resources in the Distribution Network Operation and Management Department
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper deeply discusses human resources issues faced by the distribution network operation and management department in the development process of distribution network. By establishing access standards, consolidating education and training, improving the assessment mechanism, giving full play to positive incentives, improving the security system, optimizing allocation of human resources, we can gather the strength of the employees, build an advanced team, stimulate the ability of the employees and improve the efficiency of enterprises.

articleTitle: Real-time Economic Dispatch of Microgrid Considering Battery Lifetime
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Renewable energy microgrids with storage systems is of great importance in tackling power supply problems in recent years. The lifetime loss of batteries is one of the toughest problems. To realize the economic dispatch of microgrids considering the lifetime of batteries, first, an optimization model including wind, solar, and battery storage devices is proposed. Then, the constraint of charging and discharging limits in different SOC levels is established to obtain the solution economical and beneficial to the battery lifetime. Finally, a linear programming algorithm is deployed to address the optimization problem in real time. The results indicate that the proposed method has excellent performance to optimize the system operation and obtain the dispatch more beneficial to the batteries.

articleTitle: Operational Risk Assessment of Integrated Energy System Considering Probabilistic Multi-Energy Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: During the development process of energy and electricity, the massive use of traditional fossil fuels has made the global environment and climate problems become increasingly serious, which promotes the development of integrated energy system. Due to the randomness of distributed generation output and load, the operation of integrated energy systems will face operational risks. In order to analyze operational risks, this paper establishes a risk assessment method for integrated energy systems based on probabilistic multi-energy flow. First, the source and load stochastic models of the integrated energy system are established. Then, a probabilistic multi-energy flow calculation method based on cumulant method is established, and random variable correlation is considered based on Cholesky decomposition and Nataf transformation. Finally, risk assessment indicators are established from the perspectives of operational safety and operational economy. The case study analysis shows that the method in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Characteristics of combustible gases during the thermal runaway of lithium-ion batteries in a large-scale cabin
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this study, a set of experiments were conducted in a large-scale battery cabin to investigate the characteristics of combustible gases during the thermal runaway of lithium-ion batteries caused by the external overheating. The composition and distribution of the gases were analyzed and discussed. Results showed that the spread rate of the gases was very fast and it took only 1 minute to fill the whole battery cabin. The hydrogen in the battery pack was detected earlier than the carbon monoxide. Although the former content was lower than the carbon monoxide, the propagation time reached the cabin roof was shorter due to a lower density of hydrogen. In contrast to the hydrogen and carbon monoxide, the carbon dioxide was suggested to be used as one of the characteristic gases for the thermal runaway monitoring and early warning. This was more advantages in cost and service life than the hydrogen.

articleTitle: Inspection Strategy of Power Distribution Station Considering Temporal and Spatial Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The patrol inspection of distribution network room is an important means to comprehensively find out the hidden dangers of equipment defects, provide the basis for test and inspection, and improve the operation level of distribution network. In view of the prominent problems of the wide range of distribution website rooms, large inspection workload and the lack of front-line operation and maintenance personnel, an inspection strategy of distribution website rooms considering temporal and spatial distribution is proposed. In this method, the coordinates of the station buildings within the operation and maintenance area are derived from the geographic information system (GIS) and preprocessed to form the data source file. Considering the characteristics of the actual application scenarios such as the carrying capacity of the operation and maintenance personnel, the importance and intelligence of the station buildings, and the length of the operation and maintenance cycle, K-means algorithm and genetic algorithm are used to cluster and optimize the preprocessed data, The length of periodic patrol inspection and the differentiated patrol inspection strategy of station building shall be considered. The example analysis shows that the proposed method can effectively optimize the inspection path, guide the operation and maintenance personnel to carry out the inspection work, and improve the inspection quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: Application Case Analysis of Online Monitoring System for Ring Main Unit Insulation Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper introduces the online monitoring system of ring main unit insulation failure, then explains the installation and practical application methods of the system, and analyzes the insulation failure detected by the online monitoring system. Finally, it is concluded that the insulation failure online monitoring system of ring main unit can monitor the internal insulation state of ring main unit timely through the analysis of the monitoring data. The online monitoring date conclud the characteristic gas concentration, temperature and humidity in the ring main unit. Once insulation failure occurs, the system could timely alarm and eliminate the major insulation accident in the early.

articleTitle: A Method of Distribution Network Protection and Application with Penetration of Renewable Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution network with embedded with renewable generation will cause the original relay protection failure. This paper mainly analyzes the impact of penetration of renewable generation on the distribution network, including the safety of power grid operation, line power flow, relay protection, scheduling and management. This paper proposes a protection control method for a distribution network with renewable generation, which can accurately determine the fault location, quickly remove the fault, solve problems such as communication interruption and switch refusal, and ensure the stable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Research on status evaluation of station control unit based on association rule mining Apriori algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the key terminal equipment of energy Internet construction, the station area station control unit is the core driving force to promote the intelligent and controllable development of the distribution Internet of things. Its operation status directly affects the reliability and security of the distribution network. In this paper, an Apriori algorithm based on data mining combined with fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is proposed for the single station control unit, and the corresponding state evaluation index is established, which can effectively quantify the real-time operation status of the station control unit. The results show that it can provide reliable data basis for the scientific judgment of distribution network operation risk.

articleTitle: Continuous-time Modeling Based Robust Unit Commitment Considering Interruptible Load
