publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the continuous-time model of interruptible load (IL) is established and integrated with the continuous-time robust unit commitment (RUC), to deal with the random fluctuation of wind power within scheduling intervals. With the continuous-time modeling method, the continuous trajectory of the interruptible load is described by cubic Bernstein polynomials and then integrated into continuous-time RUC model. The proposed model is solved by the C&CG algorithm. Simulation results in IEEE 14-bus system verify the effectiveness of the proposed model. The comparisons between the proposed model, continuous-time RUC without IL and discrete-time RUC with IL demonstrate better economic performance and higher robustness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Influence of large-scale distributed photovoltaic access on distribution automation and countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the construction of new power systems, large-scale distributed photovoltaics connected to the distribution network will become a trend. The large-scale development of distributed photovoltaics has gradually transformed the distribution network from passive to active distribution network. The power flow direction, voltage distribution, and line short-circuit current under fault conditions of the distribution network will all change, which will have a huge impact on the safety and reliability of distribution network operation. This paper analyzes the specific impact of distributed photovoltaic access on short-circuit current by studying the characteristics of distributed photovoltaic power generation, the characteristics of large-scale distributed photovoltaic access to line short-circuit current, and the distribution automation configuration strategy. At the same time, on the basis of the existing Hunan 10KV distribution line distribution automation and relay protection control strategies, adaptive adjustment is made to the distribution network protection considering distributed photovoltaic access to ensure the safe and reliable operation of the distribution network lines.

articleTitle: Distribution System Security Region considering Flexible Resources (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Intelligent distribution network contains multiple flexible resources such as distributed generation, energy storage and demand response. This paper proposes the distribution system security region model considering flexible resources. The security operation range of the system is described. Firstly, the load and distributed generation are regarded as the served objects of the system, and the operating point and state space are defined. Secondly, taking the energy storage and demand response as the regulation means of distribution network, the normal operation security and N-1 security of the system are discussed. The security region model is established. Finally, the model is verified by a case study, and the application of the model is shown. The distribution system security region model can conveniently evaluate the security of operating points, intuitively reflect the effect of flexible resources on system security, and show the cooperation of different flexible resources.

articleTitle: Research on the Effectiveness Evaluation and Investment Decision of Distribution Network Assets Based on Multi-dimensional Lean Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the deepening reform of electric power, the company is facing the challenge of continuous steady operation, to actively adapt to the new situation of reform of electric power, promote the development of the company and the grid quality, based on the power big data information, combined with the financial value of the asset information, using big data analysis technology, the main research point is the assets of the power grid station area, first of all, based on multi-dimensional lean management system reform, revise the calculation logic of power sales revenue, power purchase cost and power distribution area expenses in distribution area, automatically generate revenue, cost and profit statements, and integrate them with related business indicators to form comprehensive statements of industry and finance integration. Then, based on the characteristics of assets, the requirements of power reform investment, and the methods of cost supervision, the evaluation index system of asset effectiveness is revised, the efficiency and benefit of asset operation are tracked and analyzed, the effectiveness of assets is controlled in real time, and the calculation of the capital and cost investment requirements of assets, providing effective support for the company's business decisions.

articleTitle: An Improved Predictive Current Control MPPT Method for PV System based on Markov model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control is the most common method in photovoltaic (PV) system. However, when the solar irradiation changes greatly, the traditional MPPT algorithm will consume more time and reduce the efficiency. Therefore, a new MPPT method based on Markov model and improved predictive current control is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the Markov model of PV system is established. Secondly, the current Markov state is determined to quickly locate near the maximum output power point, and then further accurately locate the maximum power point. Thirdly, the improved finite set discrete-time predictive current control is applied to PV system. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Exploration and Practice of Power Big Data Application
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the last decades, digital technologies have proliferated into various industries, including the energy industry. It is evident in the electricity grid - Smart Grid, the modernized electrical grid integrating digital technologies. This paper explores the "proliferation of digital technology and data analytics in the electrical industry." Some real-life experiences of data exploration and data analysis of the electrical power big data will be discussed. Additionally, stakeholder analysis is used to identify the potential interest parties of electric power big data, and thus the value of electric power big data is highlighted.

articleTitle: Refined Operation Control and Protection of PV Power Plant Collection Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The existing protection of the PV power plant collection line is staged overcurrent protection at the line exit. A fault at any point on the line causes the entire line to be completely removed, bringing unnecessary power loss. This paper addresses the problem that the existing protection is not selective and proposes a new collection line protection scheme based on the Distribution line Non-Communication Protection(DNCP). After a fault occurs, the Protection Terminal Unit(PTU) on the grid-connected side of the fault point system detects an evident overcurrent corresponding to the power side of the DNCP. The PTU on the PV generation unit side of the fault point detects a voltage dip corresponding to the load side of the DNCP. After the PTU at one end operates first, the PTU at the other end accelerates the action at this end based on the detected secondary disturbance information to achieve fault zone isolation and minimal cut-off. Through the analysis of calculation cases, it is verified that the new protection scheme can realize refined operation control and protection and improve operation efficiency compared with the original protection scheme.

articleTitle: Influence of charging load of Electric Vehicles on three-phase imbalance of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A large number of household Electric Vehicles (EVs) are randomly connected to the distribution network using single-phase wiring, which will aggravate the existing three-phase imbalance of the power system. Therefore, it is necessary to evaluate the impact of the load of EVs on the three-phase imbalance of the distribution network in different scenarios. Firstly, analyze the trip characteristics of EVs. Then, the charging load curve is modeled and obtained. At last, IΕΕΕ 33 node test system is taken for the simulation calculation. The results show that the same number of EVs, with different proportion of access phase and with different access site, will have different effects on the three-phase imbalance. And also, scattered distribution of EV charging loads can reduce the three-phase imbalanced rate.

articleTitle: A Simulation Model for Passive Oscillation DCCB Parameter Opimization
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimized simulation model and parameter selection method for direct current circuit breaker (DCCB) with passive oscillation. Firstly, the breaking process and arc characteristics of DCCB are briefly described, and the circuit simulation models are established and optimized. Then the influence of commutation branch parameters on interruption is analyzed by the obtained simulation model, and the appropriate parameters are selected. Finally, the experimental circuit is built to verify the correctness of the simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of IIDG Impact on Single-phase-to-ground Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the characteristics of Inverter Interfaced Distributed Generator (IIDG) and sequence network theory, the sequence network diagram of fundamental and harmonic fault component under single phase to ground fault in system with non-effectively earthed neutral is given, and the theoretical calculation method of fault current and feeder zero sequence current is deduced. It is concluded that the fundamental and harmonic components of IIDG can affect the fault current and the feeder zero sequence current Simulation analysis verifies the conclusion. Through waveform analysis, it is concluded that high content of harmonic in zero-sequence current may affect single-phase-to-ground fault identification, and wavelet packet algorithm is applicable to this case.

articleTitle: Faulty Feeder Detection Method for Distribution Networks Based on Time-Frequency Image Mapping
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Rapid and reliable detection of faulty feeder is critical for power system when a single-phase-to-ground fault occurs in neutral non-solidly grounded distribution system. This paper introduces a novel faulty feeder detection method based on time-frequency image mapping of zero-sequence current. Firstly, the zero-sequence current is mapped into grey scale figure in time-frequency domains with short-time Fourier transform. All the fault features, not just one of them, can be used to build the detection scheme in this way. Then the time-frequency images of each feeder are sent to a convolutional neural network (CNN), which is the classifier to detect the faulty feeder from healthy ones. The training set is generated by digital simulations on PSCAD/EMTDC with a typical distribution network. The validation set is from other simulation models with different topology and parameters to verify the generalization of proposed method. The results show that the proposed method has good performance with higher accuracy and better generalization. And it can be put into practice directly with no additional equipment investment.

articleTitle: Robust Capacity Planning for Power Systems with Reliability Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increase of installed capacity of new energy such as wind power and photovoltaic, its randomness and intermittency will greatly affect the safety and stability of power system operation; in addition, the safety and reliability of the system should be taken into account in capacity planning. A robust capacity planning model with reliability constraints is proposed. Taking Expected energy not supply (EENS) as the reliability index, the influence of uncertain parameters such as natural gas price and various power failure rates on the planning results is considered. Finally, an optimal power allocation scheme is obtained.

articleTitle: Demand Response Flexibility Prediction of Residents Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Demand response (DR) flexibility prediction are of great importance to load aggregators (LG) and operators for bidding and scheduling decisions. Meanwhile, residents are increasingly concerned about data privacy protection. Therefore, a federated learning based framework is proposed for residential load demand response flexibility prediction. The dataset is constructed based on the large scale demand response project implemented in Jiangxi Province, including load curves, sociodemographic information, and historical demand response information of DR events. Compared with the centralized framework, the proposed framework improves the accuracy of the prediction model with privacy protection on the dataset.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Single-phase Grounding Fault Section in Distribution Network on Zero Sequence Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the engineering application of distribution network fault location system, it is necessary to determine the fault section firstly. According to the gradual attenuation characteristics of fault signal energy in transmission, the paper puts forward a method of diagnosing fault section by comprehensively using voltage and current signal. Firstly, the core position adjacent to the fault position with the largest transient energy amplitude is selected by comparing the zero-sequence transient energy amplitude intensity of each measuring position. Secondly, the transient energy characteristics of core position are analyzed when the fault position is located outside or inside of the measurement area. Furthermore, the transient energy difference between the core position and adjacent position is deducted. Finally, the fault section can be confirmed by using the transient energy difference between the core position and adjacent position. The simulation analysis of 10kV distribution network demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: On-line Monitoring of Transformer Winding Deformation Based on Relay Protection Information System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper introduces a monitoring method of transformer winding deformation using fault recording data, and the effectiveness of the method is verified by the actual recording data. Relying on the relay protection information system, the long-term real-time on-line monitoring of transformer winding deformation is designed and realized.

articleTitle: Distribution Generators and Grid Planning of Distribution Network for Disaster Prevention
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposed a distribution generators and grid planning method of distribution network for disaster prevention. A probabilistic model of line failure under different disaster conditions was proposed and a bi-level planning model was established. The upper level decided the sitting and sizing of distribution generators, grid constructure was determined based on Steiner minimum tree algorithm, and the optimal objective was minimum total cost. The lower level focus on minimum outage cost, and should demand the security constraints of power system operation. An improved NSGA II algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm were employed to solved the proposed model. Finally, simulation experiments based on 20 buses were carried out to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Power Security Analysis Platform for Enterprise Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power simulation analysis has become an important work content of enterprises grid in China. However, other domestic large-scale production enterprises have less conventional quantitative calculations in the operation of power systems, and there is still a lack of a calculation and analysis platform for security analysis of enterprise grid. This paper develops a power analysis platform for enterprise grid, which implements quantitative analysis and calculation for enterprise grid operations.

articleTitle: Modeling and experimental analysis of arc high resistance grounding fault of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The distribution network environment in forestry and pastoral areas is complex and changeable, which is very easy to cause arc high resistance grounding faults, resulting in large-area electrical fires. However, arc grounding faults are mostly random, and the traditional analysis methods are difficult to describe their development process. Aiming at this problem, the arc high resistance grounding fault model was established and the actual arc fault experiment of distribution network was carried out in this paper. Through the arc fault experiment in wet grassland, dry grassland, trees and other environments, the development process of arc fault in distribution network in forest and pastoral areas was simulated. Through the analysis of experimental data, the influence of contact humidity, fault current, transition resistance and other factors on electrical fire was analyzed. The test results show that the high resistance grounding fault of branches has a development process.

articleTitle: Data generation and evaluation method for power grid simulation example
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a method for generating power grid simulation example data based on actual power grid data statistics, which can assign parameters to the example data of the existing power grid topology. Parameters include power flow parameters and component model parameters for transient stability simulation. Through the proposed method, a power grid simulation example that conforms to the characteristics of the actual grid can be generated, which can be used for steady-state simulations such as power flow and transient simulation calculations such as electromechanical transients. This paper also proposes an evaluation method for the rationality of the simulation results of a power grid example, which is used to analyze the consistency of the characteristics of the example power grid and the actual power grid. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by the generation and evaluation of a typical example.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Topology Identification Method Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Accurate topology is the basis for refined management of the distribution network. In order to make full use of the data available in the distribution network when the topology identification work is carried out. This paper combines the data which can be obtained from GIS, PMS and marketing to establish a knowledge graph of the distribution network. Then, based on the data, the topological relationship is identified from the user address and equipment power data. In the case study,taking a residential district in Jiangxi Province as an example. it is proved that the method proposed in this paper can better fuse the distribution network data to identify the topology with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Transient Characteristics of Fault Traveling Wave Under Different Fault Conditions in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of national economy, the distribution network becomes more and more complex and the load density is increasing. The safe and stable operation of distribution network is crucial to reliable power supply. The faults in distribution network account for a large proportion in the whole power system, and have an increasing trend. Therefore, accurate fault location of distribution lines is of great significance for fast power recovery. At present, the traveling wave fault location of distribution network is usually based on the fault location method for transmission lines. The engineering situation of distribution network is not fully considered and the analysis is simple, which affects the precise analysis of fault traveling wave transient characteristics and the improvement of fault location method. In this paper, the transient characteristics of fault traveling wave under different fault conditions in distribution network are analyzed and the analysis results are validated by simulation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Approach for High Voltage Circuit Breaker Mechanical Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: 12 kV high voltage circuit breaker (HVCB) is one of the most important equipment in the distribution network. Its reliability has tremendous impact on the safety of the network. The mechanical fault severity evaluation and diagnosis of HVCB is intensively investigated and studied in this article by means of vibration data processing and artificial intelligence methodology implemented. A deep learning based diagnosis approach is presented to overcome the shortcomings of traditional diagnosis models. We will benefit from this approach that single and compound fault are diagnosed with high detection rate and extremely low false alarm rate. The proposed method is purely data-driven and directly implemented by using time-frequency image of raw vibration data only. Experiments were conducted on a 12 kV switchgear with CB inside demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Set-based anomaly detection and interpolating predictive regulation of UPQC for power distribution quality improvement
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper investigates the monitoring and predictive control of unified power quality conditioner to improve power quality in a power distribution system. The proposed strategy is composed of a set-based anomaly monitoring method and an interpolating predictive regulation method. The novelty of such strategy consists of two aspects. On the one hand, the set-based anomaly monitoring scheme features a user-defined output observation set given to characterize the different severity levels of harmonic effects that the user can tolerate. On the other hand, a linear constrained linear programming control method based on interpolation optimization is designed to achieve fast predictive regulation of unified power quality conditioner. Simulation studies on a single-phase power distribution system are given to validate that the proposed strategy is able to guarantee the quality of power distribution, whether the supply voltage/load current has harmonics or sags/swells problems.

articleTitle: Protection scheme of flexible DC distribution line based on voltage variation weighted summation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Fast and reliable identification of line faults is a key factor restricting the application and development of flexible DC distribution system. A protection scheme using single terminal voltage and current to identify fault is proposed for medium voltage flexible DC distribution system. Firstly, the expressions of fault current and voltage of flexible DC distribution line are deduced. Based on the analysis of the difference between fault voltage and out of area fault in the case of metal fault and short circuit through transition resistance, a voltage variation weighted accumulation algorithm is proposed. The protection scheme is highly sensitive in the case of high resistance fault Finally, built a simulation model on PSCAD/EMTDC platform to verify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed protection scheme.

articleTitle: Massive Access Multiplexing Technology of Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As an important component of a new power system, the power internet of things (IoT) faces the challenges of explosive data growth and massive device access, where the key is to improve the utilization of frequency domain resources. In this paper, considering the scenario of massive device access, we discuss the application of non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) and random access in the power IoT system. We first present the basic principles of NOMA and random access, and then design the sparse code multiple access (SCMA) and two-step random access technology for the power IoT system. Finally, simulation results show that the system throughput of SCMA is improved by about 2dB compared with that of the OFDMA system, and the access latency of the proposed two-step random access scheme can bring a smaller average access latency compared with the traditional scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Demand Response Strategy of Electric Vehicles based on GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electric vehicle demand response system is established to overcome the disadvantages of disorderly charging and information island with the rapid development of electric vehicle scale. GRU neural network simplifies the training complexity by reducing three gating mechanisms to two compared with LSTM which is suitable to electric vehicle charging power prediction. The process of participation to the power demand response market of electric vehicles is divided to preparation stage, scheme stage, practice stage and transaction stage. The charging cost and benefit are calculated to reach the agreement of orderly charging control among trading entities. The construction of electric vehicle demand response system with various communication channels and safety guarantee measures is built to maintain the sustainable operation of the demand response market.

articleTitle: Research on IoT-based Online Monitoring Technology for Ring Main Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To deal with complex operation and maintenance (O&M), and high life cycle cost of today’s online monitoring device of ring main unit (RMU) because of low integration level, a monitoring device of RMU based on Internet of Things (IoT) integrated with interfaces for sensors, online monitoring of circuit breaker mechanical characteristics, online monitoring of partial discharge (PD) and standardized communication interfaces was developed. The structure of submodules and the software architecture based on container technology are introduced in detail. Zero drift compensation, sampling trigger threshold setting, and characteristic analysis related to online monitoring of mechanical failures are emphasized. An improved peak holding mechanism for PD sampling is introduced. To verify the performance of the developed device, a test platform was set up and some typical mechanical failures were simulated. The results show that the monitoring data are accurate and consistent, which meet the requirements of field applications.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Effect of Wind and Photovoltaic Installed Capacity Growth on the Adequacy of New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the related problems caused by the high proportion of new energy connected to the power system, an adequacy evaluation index model is constructed based on the system reliability, new energy consumption, and peak-to- valley difference in this paper. Then, real-data analysis is carried out under different penetration rates of new energy. The impact of the wind and photovoltaic installed capacity with their corresponding proportions in the total installed capacity for a certain province in China on the power supply adequacy index of the power grid is studied. It is shown that the reliability indices and the new energy consumption rate arise with the continuous increase of the penetration rate of new energy.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of high voltage circuit breaker based on ICEEMDAN sample entropy and SVM (CICED 2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to identify the fault of circuit breaker simply and accurately, a method based on improved adaptive noise complete set empirical mode decomposition (ICEEMDAN) and support vector machine (SVM) is proposed. Firstly, ICEEMDAN is used to decompose the vibration signal, and then the obtained modal function (IMF) is used to eliminate the false IMF component by using its correlation. Finally, the IMF component with high correlation is calculated by sample entropy to obtain the characteristic vector of vibration signal, which is input into support vector machine for fault classification, and the classification results are obtained. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy is 100%.

articleTitle: Application of Lifting Wavelet Transform in Resonance Detection of Clustered Grid-Connected Photovoltaic
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because a large number of distributed energy sources are connected to the grid, the system becomes a high-order LC network. When a certain disturbance frequency is close to the system resonance point, the system resonance phenomenon will occur. Therefore, it is necessary to study the resonance detection method of clustered grid-connected photovoltaic power generation. In this paper, the resonance principle of the clustered grid-connected photovoltaic system is firstly analyzed based on the resonance model of the clustered grid-connected photovoltaic system. Then an LWT-based resonance detection technique is proposed. Through this algorithm, the start-stop time and frequency range of the clustered grid-connected photovoltaic system can be obtained. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the LWT-based resonance detection method for clustered grid-connected photovoltaic systems.

articleTitle: Research on Simplified Tuning of PSS Parameters of Pumped Storage Units Based on Digsilent Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the advancement of the construction of new power systems, pumped storage units play an increasingly important role in the safe and stable operation of the power grid and the promotion of renewable energy consumption. The pumped storage unit is different from the ordinary generator set, and there are power generation conditions and pump conditions. The PSS parameter setting under different conditions is related to the safe and stable operation of the power system. This paper first analyzes the excitation operation mode of the pumped-storage unit, and draws the conclusion of the symmetry difference between the pumped-storage unit' s power generation and the pump condition based on the power angle stability analysis. Based on the symmetry difference of the angular stability analysis, it is concluded that the PSS parameters of the pumped-storage unit can be simplified under the two working conditions, which is beneficial to improve the PSS parameter setting efficiency of the pumped-storage unit.

articleTitle: Operation Control Strategy of Low Voltage Direct Current Supply and Utilization System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The trend of low voltage integration and direct current (DC) form of renewable energy and flexible loads promote the development of the low voltage direct current supply and utilization system (LVDCSUS). However, the operation characteristics and operating modes analysis of the LVDCSUS have not received too much attention. This paper proposes four typical operating modes of the LVDCSUS. With the analysis of the operating characteristics and application scenarios of the system, the switching conditions are proposed between different operating modes considering the DC bus voltage as the control goal. In addition, the corresponding voltage coordination control strategies of the four operating modes are proposed. These strategies can ensure that the DC bus voltage does not cross the line when the environment or load changes and works stably in the corresponding operating mode. The simulation results verify the validity and feasibility of the mode division and the proposed control strategy.

Author Keywords: low voltage direct current supply and utilization system

articleTitle: Model Reuse Method in Protection Schematic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Various types of protection equipment from different manufacturers are used in the substation. In different application scenarios, protection devices of the same model and version usually adopt the same protection schematic diagrams except only function switching and parameter setting are different. Therefore, the paper proposes a general model reuse method to realize multiplexing application of protection schematic graph model in microcomputer protection schematic simulation and training. First, basic protection diagram simulation model is established according to the software principle of the protection device. Then, instance protection diagram model is generated through the basic model and engineering configuration file automatically. In the simulation process, detail simulation data is recorded for each actual simulated device. Finally, the correspondence relation is achieved between a virtual protection schematic model and several simulation instances. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the method proposed in the paper is validated through case study.

Author Keywords: joint calculation of multiple diagrams simulation

articleTitle: Determination Key Indicator in Transformer Oil by Infrared Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Furfural is one of the most important characteristic products during aging process in current-operation transformer oil. It is more accuracy and convenient in determination of furfural content to reflect real-time status of current-operation transformer oil. In this paper, simulation software was used to confirm feasibility of furfural determination by infrared equipment. After discussion on data obtained by theoretical calculation and experiment, final formula of linear regression between furfural concentration and intensity of characteristic peak was obtained which can be used as a convenient path to determine of furfural in transformer oil.

articleTitle: Networking Communication of UAV Nests for Transmission Line Relay Patrol Based on OPGW
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) nest installed on the overhead line tower is an innovation to realize the relay patrol of UAV. In order to tranfer massive collected data fast, stably, safely and reliably, a communication network based on OPGW is designed. The network is distributed on a 32km HVAC overhead line, with 7 optical fiber access points connected to 7 nests. Based on the OPGW network, data of video, UAV status and nest status upload to the remote data server with security protection such as hardware tamper proof, identity authentication, access control, communication encryption and access isolation. In the application, it is found that the automatic relay patrol mode supported by the UAV nests can shorten the operation time from 3 days to half an hour by 7 UAVs or 10 hours by 1 UAVs compared with the traditional manual delivery-recovery mode.

articleTitle: How to Improve Green Power Market Competitiveness: an Analytic Hierarchy Process Method
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Analyzing the influencing factors and degree of competitiveness of green power market is very important to establish its market mechanism. Based on the Porter's five forces model, this study uses Delphi method to identify five primary indicators and nineteen secondary indicators which affecting the competitiveness of green power market, then carry out expert scoring which based on Likert’s Nine Standard method and uses Analytic Hierarchy Process to construct judgment matrix and calculate weight. The results show that the suppliers, the buyers and the substitutes have great impact on the competitiveness of green power market. Based on this, two strategies to improve the competitiveness of green power market are proposed: one is to develop the energy storage technology, and the other is to improve the accuracy of electricity demand forecast.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Extinguishing Characteristics of Transformer Oil Pool fire
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Oil-immersed transformers contain a large amount of Insulating oil, once a fire occurs, it will seriously damage the power grid and equipment safe operation, causing huge economic losses and affecting social stability. This paper takes the common No. 25 insulating oil as the research object, and conducts fire extinguishing tests under the action of different extinguishing agents for 30cm and 50cm oil pan diameter oil pool fires respectively, to provide theoretical guidance for transformer fire extinguishing. The test showed that the average heat release rate of oil pan fire in the stable combustion stage was 53.32kW and 130.54kW. All extinguishing agents can extinguish the transformer oil pool fire, perfluorocarbon hexatone extinguishing time is shorter (1s, 1.5s), followed by carbon dioxide (2s, 4s), heptafluoropropane extinguishing time is the longest (8s, 28s). Perfluorohexanone mainly through heat absorption to achieve the effect of fire extinguishing, both good fire extinguishing and cooling to inhibit the battery thermal runaway ability, can be in the converter station valve hall fire prevention field has good application prospects.

articleTitle: Review of Partial Discharge Detection Technology for Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Through the application of partial discharge detection technology, weak partial discharge signals can be detected to ensure the normal stability of the insulation structure of distribution transformers. In this paper, the detection methods of partial discharge such as pulse current method, ultrasonic detection method, UHF detection method, dissolved gas analysis method, and transient-to-ground voltage detection method are technically sorted out and summarized. And put forward the views on the future development trend of partial discharge detection technology, and the specific ideas of follow-up research.

articleTitle: Research on distribution network situation prediction model based on HMM-NSSP model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, most of the situation prediction models are established for the planning of large power grids, but a complete set of distribution network situation prediction models have not been formed. From the perspective of combining theory with practice, a real-time network security situation prediction model HMM-NSSP based on Hidden Markov model is proposed. The parameters are dynamically modified through the real-time performance of network nodes to realize the real-time monitoring and prediction of the security situation of the whole distribution network. The effectiveness and superiority of the model are verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Power Internet of Things Architecture and Access CTechnology for Massive Heterogeneous Terminals (CICED2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power Internet of things is the development trend of today’s era and the demand for national strategic development. With the development of the power Internet of things, the power Internet of things platform is facing the pressure of massive heterogeneous terminal access. Firstly, based on the current construction of power Internet of things, this paper puts forward an architecture composed of terminal, edge, pipe, and cloud. Then, the terminal management and control technology based on software definition is proposed to realize the flexible and efficient management and control of the power IoT terminal; A massive heterogeneous terminal access technology based on load balancing and multi-protocol analysis technology is proposed to realize the rapid distribution of traffic and the adaptive processing of service requests, improve the processing efficiency of the platform, and realize the decoupling of business logic and message transmission. Finally, the application prospect of the above technology in the fields of distribution network operation state perception, operation, and distribution business connection and improvement, power supply scheme optimization and auxiliary decision-making is given.

articleTitle: Hierarchical scheduling optimization method based on DSM multi-type flexible load model for smart grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to handle the increasing difficulty of power grid dispatching, this paper expounds an optimization model of power grid dispatching when flexible load is connected. The flexible load is divided into three types: interruptible load, translational load and adjustable load. And the Latin square quantum genetic algorithm(LSQGA) is used to solve the optimization problem in nonlinear programming, which improves the efficiency of the optimization model and solves the local optimal problem. Finally, a distribution network in a certain region is taken as a case study, and the results show the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Method to Improve the Stability of The Grid-Connected Inverter under Non-Unit Power Factor in A Weak Grid Considering Phase-Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Grid-connected inverters usually use phase-locked loop (PLL) to obtain synchronization information of the grid voltage. In a weak grid, grid impedance cannot be ignored. Voltage disturbance at the point of common coupling (PCC) can lead to the deviation of the output phase angle of PLL, which affects the operation stability of the grid-connected inverter. This paper discusses the influence of the PLL under non-unit power factor, and proposes a compensation control method that can effectively improve the stability of the grid-connected system. First, the small signal model of the LCL-type three-phase grid-connected inverter considering PLL is established in the dq-frame. Then, the equivalent output impedance characteristics of the grid-connected inverter with the small signal compensation are analyzed. The proposed method can ensure that the grid-connected inverter maintains a good stability margin, and enhance the stability and dynamic performance of the grid-connected inverter. Simulations are carried out to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Strategy in Intelligent Operation of the UAV Based on KLMS Adaptive Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To improve the efficiency of UAV fixed-point injection work, a new control strategy is proposed. Different from the existing UAV control strategy, this thesis pays more attention to the stability of the injection work dropping point rather than the absolute stability of the UAV in a certain position. Before the operation, the injection target is determined by laser spotting, and the drone will automatically arrive at the operation position according to preset parameters such as horizontal operation distance and injection speed, and set the electronic fence with this point as the center of the ball. During the operation, the spray landing point is calculated according to the position and attitude data of the UAV. The UAV control algorithm based on KLMS allows the UAV to adjust within a certain range to achieve effective multi-angle injection. Taking the drones live working carrying water as an example, through simulation, under the action of random disturbances such as backlash and system disturbance factors, the system compares LMS and RLS algorithm, which verifies the reliability of the control strategy in intelligent operation.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic fault diagnosis method based on BP neural network and rule-based control chart
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: PV (Photovoltaic) array is the fundamental power production unit that is installed in outdoors and continuously exposed to harsh environmental conditions. This inevitably leads to abnormal and various kind of faults among PV arrays at times. Therefore, the accurate detection of potential compound faults is essential to improve the operating efficiency, safety and reliability of PV systems. In order to monitor the operating state of PV arrays in a real-time manner, a fault diagnosis method based on BP (Back Propagation) neural network and rule-based control chart was proposed. A DC output prediction model of PV arrays was constructed using BP neural network. The actual output deviation of PV arrays was analyzed based on the predicted output of the model, and the EWMA (Exponentially Weighted Moving-Average) control chart was used to detect whether the actual output deviation of PV arrays exceeds the EWMA control limit to further determine whether a fault occurs. The proposed method builds a prediction model by taking advantage of the environmental data collected by micro-weather station and the measurement data of PV inverters for the remote real-time online monitoring and fault diagnosis of PV arrays without any additional monitoring equipment.

articleTitle: Research on the self-configuration technology of the whole station simulation test of intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The signal configuration workload of the whole station simulation test of the intelligent substation is large, and the non-standard signal model of the secondary equipment makes it difficult to realize the automatic signal configuration. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a self-configuration technology of the whole station simulation test of intelligent substation. Based on the signal configuration requirements of the whole station simulation test and the relevant specifications of relay protection, a standardized secondary equipment signal model is established. Based on the primary main wiring diagram of the substation, the unconfigured SSD file is generated. The improved edit distance similarity algorithm is used to realize the automatic mapping of the secondary equipment signal model to the standardized secondary equipment signal model, so as to realize the automatic configuration of the simulation test of the whole station. The actual example shows that the configuration method proposed in this paper can overcome the problem of non-standard signal models of secondary equipment of different manufacturers, and realize the automatic configuration of the simulation test signal of the whole station based on the similarity calculation of the signal model of the secondary equipment.

Author Keywords: simulation test of the whole station

articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Method for Protection Relay System in Distribution Networks based on KPCA-IF Model
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the complex topology, multiple line branches, and dense spatial distributions of the distribution networks, the disturbances and failures cannot be eliminated it is difficult to completely avoid potential operation disturbances and faults. Thus, a reliable and stable protection system is necessary the protection system is bound to ensure a high level of reliability and stability. In that case, the monitoring and identification of the potential abnormal operation status of the protection system must be ensured the monitoring and identification of potential abnormal operation status of the protection system are facing new challenges. To this end, a data-driven-based real-time anomaly detection model is proposed in this paper. The kernel principal components analysis (KPCA) process is deployed to compress the dimensionality of raw data, which can then reduce the computational complexity within a high-dimensional data environment. Next, the isolated forest (IF) model is applied to excavate potential outliers according to the numeric range of the normal operating state of each feature. It can maintain high detection performance in the biased or sparse distributions and present a high reaction speed. Finally, the operation data of a relay system in a regional distribution network are utilized in the case study. The results verify the better performance of the proposed model in practical application, which can assist in the automatic identification and response of the risks of the distribution network.

articleTitle: The Hosting Capacity Calculation and Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Regional Multiple Energy System Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High penetration rate of distribution generations (DGs) may cause the issues of voltage exceeding the limit, power flow reversed and power supply quality degraded. The hosting capacity calculation and comprehensive evaluation for regional multiple energy systems have great significance. In this paper, a digital twin model for regional multiple energy systems is established. Based on the model, a hosting capacity calculation method and a comprehensive evaluation model are proposed and implemented. The proposed method can calculate the extra capacity of DGs in a regional multiple energy systems with specific constraints. With the calculation results of proposed method, the proposed evaluation model determines the most suitable grid connection schemas for the system. An actual power grid is modeled in CloudPSS and used to validate the proposed method and framework. The testing results indicate that the allowable new capacity of DGs and the most suitable schemas can be determined accurately. The proposed method can provide some guidance for regional multiple energy systems planning and operations.

articleTitle: Improving Grid Power Balance Flexibility with Operation Optimization of the Cogeneration Units in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Presently exploring the peaking power capability potential of the existing cogeneration units has been regarded as one effective way to improve the grid power balance flexibility. Operation optimization technique of the high back-pressure cogeneration unit with its auxiliary turbine condenser and district heater is presented. Flexibility performance of the one example high back-pressure unit with auxiliary turbine condenser and district heater arrangement is studied and analyzed based on established models of 660MW cogeneration unit using Ebsilon software. The peaking power capability achieved and its economic influence on the unit is studied in detail for the different heating load conditions. Peaking electricity cost concept is introduced for comparing the opportunity cost incurred for realizing the peaking power capacity under each operation case. Three scenarios for five heating loads are analyzed. Taking Scenario I as the baseline condition, increasing the steam extraction flow for the auxiliary turbine in Scenario II can achieve moderate peaking power capacity of 12MW to 16MW, which is far less compared with capability achieved in Scenario III for heating load I. This peaking power capability is getting less with the increasing of the heating load as illustrated in various figures. The maximum peaking power capacity achieved is 63MW when the steam extraction flow to the district heater is 300t/h in Scenario III for heating load I, and this peaking power flexibility is further improved as the heating load gets higher. The peaking electricity cost is increased with the increasing steam extraction flow in various heating load conditions. It should be noted that the peaking electricity cost changing gradient is getting steeper with increasing of the steam extraction flow, which implies that careful consideration should be given to the high peaking electricity cost when significant peaking power capacity is expected for certain heating load.

articleTitle: Potential fault detection of power collection lines in large new energy stations
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As new energy accelerates to replace traditional fossil energy, large-scale new energy stations are under construction and operation in full swing. Potential fault detection of collector line can effectively avoid equipment damage and improve operation reliability. Based on the high-frequency traveling wave, the potential fault detection technology is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the structure of new energy station is analyzed, the definition of potential fault is explored, and the principle and technology of potential fault detection based on traveling wave are mainly introduced. Finally, this paper presents the potential fault identification system and its field application.

Author Keywords: Potential fault detection and location system

articleTitle: A Novel Busbar Automatic Transfer Switch Scheme for Large Data Center
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large data center is an important Class A load and high reliable power supply shall be satisfied. Conventional automatic busbar transfer switch scheme (BATS) based on N-l principle cannot fit for large data center. First, the limitation of conventional BATS for application in large data center is analyzed; then, the typical single line diagram (SLG) of large data center is described based on an example project; afterwards, the hardware and software of a novel BATS device for large data center are designed based on N-2 principle, such as overload of the transformer, outage of mains, failure of circuit-breaker, so as to ensure the high continuity of power supply; finally, the feasibility of the scheme is verified by RTDS simulation, which provides a design practice reference for a large data center to adopt BATS to improve the reliability of its’ power supply.

articleTitle: Imbalance Settlement Mechanism in Nordic Electricity Market and Enlightenment to Yunnan Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power system is balanced in real time. Due to the uncertainty of the completion of the power generation plan, the temporary failure of the power generation, consumption sides and the grid, there will always be a certain deviation between the transaction power and the actual power. Whether it is a medium-to-long-term market or a spot market, market players need to be motivated to minimize the amount of deviation and reduce the pressure on system scheduling. Therefore, the imbalance settlement mechanism is particularly important. The imbalance settlement mechanism in the Nordic electricity market has been in operation for nearly 20 years, and has been continuously optimized according to market conditions. This paper conducts an in-depth analysis of the imbalance settlement system in the Nordic electricity market, including the imbalance settlement structure, imbalance settlement model, imbalance volume calculation and imbalance fee calculation. Supplemented by examples to better clarify the settlement rules. Finally, combined with the current situation of Yunnan electricity market settlement, it is suggested on the construction of imbalance settlement mechanism from several aspects, such as the construction of imbalance settlement system, settlement index monitoring, imbalance settlement price and settlement rights and responsibilities.

articleTitle: Demand Response Potential Assessment for Energy-Intensive Enterprises based on Clustering with Dimensionality Reduction
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Fully exploring demand response resources and capability is the basis of demand response promotion. Energy-intensive loads are high quality resources with large capacity, fast shifting speed, low shifting cost and flexible response mode. This paper proposes a dimensional reduction clustering method based on load curve of energy-intensive loads, which can evaluate the demand response potential of different size enterprises in different industries based on the existing time of use pricing policies. This method does not need to collect additional enterprise information and has high evaluation efficiency, which can support demand response management and price policy improvement through efficient demand response potential assessment.

articleTitle: Research on Suppression of Transformer DC Bias Caused by Metro Stray Current under Different Grounding Modes of the Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The stray current leaked during the operation of urban metro will cause DC bias of transformers along the line. In order to reveal the influence of stray current leaked during actual operation of metro on the main transformer of nearby substation, the effectiveness of transformer DC bias suppression under different grounding modes of the grid was studied, and the dynamic distribution features of stray current was considered. The simulation model of DC bias suppression of main transformer in 110kV substation of urban power grid was established by using PSCAD / EMTDC platform. Through external controllable voltage source equivalent to DC potential difference between different substations, the phenomenon of DC bias hysteresis saturation of transformer was simulated. Further adjusting the grounding mode of transformer neutral point through small resistor or capacitor, the suppression effect of transformer DC bias caused by metro stray current under different grounding mode of power grid was analyzed. The simulation results show that the distortion rate of excitation current waveform and hysteresis loop is reduced, and the DC bias is suppressed when the transformer is grounded through small resistor. The distortion rate of hysteresis loop is further reduced compared with that of series small resistor, and the suppression effect of DC bias is better when the transformer is grounded by capacitor.

articleTitle: Temperature Load and Energy Storage Control Method Based on Prediction Error of New Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: New energy prediction error makes the system regulation capacity insufficient, resulting in new energy power rationing.And the capacity of energy storage device is limited. In order to improve the new energy consumption, a coordinated control method of temperature control load and energy storage is proposed.Firstly, the error distribution characteristics of new energy power prediction are analyzed, and then the predicted power of new energy is incorporated into the power generation plan according to a certain confidence degree, the cooperative control principle of temperature control load and energy storage is analyzed. Then, the temperature control load model and composite energy storage model architecture are established. The distributed temperature control load control method based on MPC and the improved hierarchical control method of composite energy storage are proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed method is correct and effective.

articleTitle: An abnormal identification method of protection relay setting data based on KLDA-INFLO
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Nowadays, the scale of power systems is enlarging, the types of input power sources are increasing, and the demands are also rising. Hence, the disturbance in power grids becomes more frequent, which requests higher reliability of protection relay systems. To achieve a timely response to the potential disturbance in protection relay systems, this paper establishes an anomaly detection method for early warning. Firstly, the Kernel linear discriminant analysis model is utilized to diminish the dimensionality of inputs, and therefore, to decrease the computation burden as well as accelerate the subsequent calculation. Then the Influenced outlierness anomaly detection model is built. This model can find the outliers in time according to the common range of operation setting parameters, and then react swiftly to distinguish the anomaly condition data via assessing their density. Finally, an empirical study based on the protection relay system in one distribution network is conducted. The results show that the performance of the proposed method is satisfying, and can be deployed to security monitor or to manage the countermeasures for potential risks.

articleTitle: Deformation Monitoring of High-voltage Transmission Lines in Huaihua based on DSInSAR Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Transmission lines are important infrastructures related to national energy security and the lifeline of the national economy. In order to ensure the safe and reliable operation of transmission lines, it is necessary to monitor deformation in the surrounding areas of power transmission towers. This paper selects the transmission lines in Huaihua, Hunan Province as the study area, collects the Sentinel-1 sentinel data of 40 scenes from 2019 to 2021 as the data set, and uses the DSInSAR technology to carry out deformation monitoring and risk investigation of the transmission line. The results indicates the DSInSAR technology can effectively improve the monitoring effect of landslide deformation near the transmission lines in the low coherence area and there are six relatively large deformation areas within 4 kilometers of the transmission lines in Huaihua, where for the B closest to the transmission lines and the D with the large deformation, we should further monitor deformation near the transmission lines by other means.

articleTitle: Research on Partial Discharge Accident for Cable Joints of the 10kV Switch Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a case of abnormal partial discharge(PD) caused by the blockage of the cable elbow in the 10kV switch cabinet is described. By analyzing the PD test data and using technical supervision means, the causes of this PD are obtained. The comprehensive maintenance and renovation plan were put forward for ensuring the safe and stable operation of 10kV switch cabinet.

articleTitle: Lightning Impulse Overvoltage Insulation Coordination Method Based on the Principle of Discharge Probability Comparison
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large test workload of existing lightning impulse insulation coordinate methods and unspecific data processing methods. From the perspective of discharge probability, the lightning impulse insulation coordinate method based on the principle of probability comparison and the supporting test and data processing methods are proposed. Through the analysis of the statistical law of repeated and independent lightning impulse discharge data, the data processing method based on the Weibull probability distribution model is used to process the repeated discharge data to obtain the discharge voltage value of the required discharge probability. According to the principle that the lightning impulse discharge voltage of the protection device with a discharge probability of 0.1% should be greater than the lightning impulse discharge voltage of the protection device with a discharge probability of 99.9%, the discharge voltage value of the protection device is determined. Using the lightning impulse insulation coordinate method based on the principle of discharge probability comparison, conducted lightning impulse insulation coordination between the parallel gap for 10kV distribution line and the support insulator of line PS15/500, and obtain the best gap distance of parallel gap. Through experimental verification, it is believed that the lightning impulse insulation coordinate method based on the principle of probability comparison is easy to operate, accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Compressed Sensing Based Temperature Field Reconstruction of Distribution Switch Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to realize non-intrusive abnormal temperature rise state evaluation for distribution switch cabinets, a novel temperature field reconstruction method based on compressed sensing theory is proposed in this paper. Based on the discrete temperature sensing parameters collected outside the distribution switch cabinets, combined with tensor block correlation matching and low-rank tensor super-resolution, our method can search for appropriate units in the temperature field tensor dictionary to fill the targeted spatial area from outside to inside, so as to realize the internal temperature field reconstruction of the distribution switch cabinets. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed method has a satisfying fitting effect on the two-dimensional temperature section and the three-dimensional temperature field, which can effectively support the evaluation task of the abnormal temperature rise state in distribution switch cabinets.

articleTitle: Voltage Current Hybrid Control Method of Series Active Power Filter for Harmonics of Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional series active power filter based on magnetic flux compensation (MFC) can be divided into current type and voltage type according to the control method. The former can realize accurate compensation, but has the disadvantages of complex controller design and slow dynamic response. Although the latter responds quickly, its strong nonlinearity of impedance regulation and the characteristics of open-loop control lead to low impedance control accuracy. Considering the characteristics of the two control types, this paper presents a new voltage current hybrid control method for harmonic control of wind turbine, in which the current loop is designed to control the fundamental current, which can simplify the current loop and realize accurate control of the fundamental impedance, while the voltage feedforward is used to controlled the harmonic impedance, which has fast response and can make the adjustable impedance present a large impedance to dynamically suppress the harmonic current in transmission lines. A simulation model has been built in Matlab/Simulink and the simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Mechanical Fault Diagnosis of 12 kV Vacuum Circuit Breaker Based on Vibration Signal Feature Selection and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: 12 kV vacuum circuit breaker (CB) is one of the most important components in the power distribution system. Its mechanical reliability plays a quite important role in the safety and stability of the power system. In order to solve the problem of poor accuracy caused by information redundancy and irrelevant interference in time domain, frequency domain and time-frequency domain features of CB mechanical vibration signal, a new intelligent fault diagnosis method based on ReliefF and PSO-BP neural network is proposed. The ReliefF algorithm is used for automatic feature selection to maximum the correlation between the input and output of the model. In order to get the minimum false alarm rate and the highest detection rate, the top sensitive features are selected. To identify faults more accurately, the initial weights and threshold parameters of BP neural network (BPNN) are optimized by PSO to solve the problem that BPNN tends to fall into local optimum and improve the diagnosis performance. The effectiveness of the proposed method for CB fault diagnosis was verified by orthogonal tests.

articleTitle: Optimization of Local Energy Supply Network using CHP to Reduce Cost and Carbon Dioxide Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the effect of establishing and retrofitting a CHP (Combined heat and power) facility in a region on the reduction of the total cost of local electricity, natural gas, and heating, as well as the cost and expected cost recovery period of establishing or retrofitting a CHP facility. In this paper, the different heating methods in different regions are classified and discussed, and based on the MATPOWER 118 case, and an optimization model is constructed based on different heating method. After that the construction cost and cost recovery period are considered and another optimization model is constructed. The simulations are carried out through the convex optimization algorithm Cplex and the optimized results including cost saving percentage and carbon dioxide emission reduction are explained and discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis on transient power disturbance detection and characterization
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Several methods of transient power disturbance detection are presented in this paper. The methods are used to detect disturbances and extract features and the results of simulation indicate respectively their characteristics. Fast Fourier transform can identify accurately frequency information of stable signals. Wavelet transform can detect discontinue points of signals. S transform can extract time domain and frequency domain features of signals. TLS-ESPRIT algorithm has high extremely frequency resolution, which can process the disturbance signals of several close frequency components.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Identification Method of Distribution Automation Graph and Model Change Associated Feeder Set Based on Graph Theory Depth Traversal Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Extract the key model information such as the equipment name to be added, deleted and modified in the contact list of planned outage project and its feeder to form the change equipment set. The equipment belonging to the same DTU in the change equipment set is divided into a group. The column switches that do not belong to any DTU are grouped independently. One equipment in each group is selected to form the minimum change equipment set, Find the corresponding PMS of each equipment in the distribution automation master station system according to the original equipment name and feeder in the minimum change equipment set_ ID and topology node number; Starting from each terminal of the equipment in the minimum change equipment set, relying on the topology node number and using the depth traversal algorithm of the diagram, find all the single line diagrams (n) associated with this diagram module change to form a change feeder set, so as to guide the maintenance of the source end of the diagram module on the PMS side.

Author Keywords: the feed line set of abnormal movement

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Method for Residential Transformers Winding Connections and Capacities Recognition in the Distribution Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to manual registration in the Distribution Management System (DMS), recording errors in the winding connection and capacity of residential trans-formers are inevitable. This paper proposes a linear regression classification method, which can estimate the real winding connection and capacity of residential transformers by exploring the historical operating data sets of residential transformers in the DMS. The linear regression classifications of three-phase outlet voltages are used for winding connections recognition. The inherent law is revealed that Dyn11 and Yyn0 residential transformers are with different zero-sequence current paths. That is different capacities Yyn0 residential transformer is with different zero-sequences, and short circuit impedance of the Dyn11 residential transformers is a fixed value. Ac-cording to the identification of winding connection, the capacity identification of Yyn0 and Dyn11 residential transformers can be obtained. Simulations on a practical line with 10 residential transformers show the effective-ness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Fault Early Warning and Location Device for Low-voltage Distribution Network Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Using traditional automation technology for fault early warning and location of low-voltage distribution network has some disadvantages, such as complex technology implementation, low early warning accuracy, long fault location time and so on. Therefore, firstly, this paper studied the implementation principle of fault early warning and location in low-voltage distribution network. Secondly, making full use of the edge computing to play the role of data analysis on the terminal side, a fault early warning and location device for low-voltage distribution network was designed. Besides, the overall process of realizing early warning and location was formulated. Finally, through the field application test, the accuracy of early warning and the rapidity of location of the device were verified. The results showed that the average early warning accuracy of the device was 92.11%, the fault location time was less than 10s, there was no false alarm and missing alarm, and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: Component Management Framework for Operating System Based on Microkernel Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Edge computing puts forward higher requirements on operating system in terms of security, real-time and scalability. Operating systems based on microkernel architecture can effectively meet these requirements. However, the current microkernel operating system lacks a general user-mode program organization and management mechanism, which makes it difficult to develop user-mode programs such as system services, device drivers and applications. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a system service dynamic construction framework based on dynamic loading and dynamic linking technology, proposes a capability-based component security mechanism, and proposes a cross-core IPC optimization method. Based on these mechanisms, an efficient, secure and flexible component management framework can be formed. We also developed a prototype system and verified it on a real hardware platform. The experimental data show that the component framework designed in this paper is efficient and secure.

articleTitle: Research on the Stability Improvement Strategy of LCL-Type Grid-Connected Inverter under Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The traditional proportional feedforward control strategy can effectively suppress the disturbance of the grid background harmonic, but the phase margin of the output impedance is low under weak grid, resulting in the stability of the inverter greatly reduced. Therefore, an improved grid voltage feedforward control strategy for LCL-type grid-connected inverter under weak current grid is proposed. Firstly, the interference of power grid background harmonics to grid-connected current is suppressed by means of serial bandpass filter in feedforward path, and the phase margin of inverter is improved to some extent. Secondly, in view of the limitations of the improved control strategy when the grid impedance is large, phase lead compensation and parallel multiple harmonic compensator are introduced in the current regulator to further improve the phase margin of the system. Finally, the performance of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: 5G-based Differential Protection in Distribution Network (CICED 2022)
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: 5G technology has achieved high-precision timing technology with time synchronization accuracy of microseconds level, provides very good communication foundation for differential protection of the distribution network. Form the characteristic of wireless communication, the uncertainty of air interface is mainly from time delay Up-and-Down time slot ratio mechanism of wireless transmission and retransmission mechanism. Differential protection based on 5G timing is proposed. Field test has carried out since 2018 in Shenzhen grid and 2021 in Guangzhou. The results shows that the time delay of 5G wireless communication can decrease to within 10ms, comparable with wired communication.
