Synchronization accuracy is less than 300ns, much better than specification, and can be used as timing stamp for differential protection. But the time delay varies from 6ms to 60ms. On one hand, it verifies the uncertainty of wireless communication. On the other hand, the differential protection should design larger memory to restore more sample value.

articleTitle: Frequency Resilience Evaluation Method for Multi-HVDC Feed-in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to assess the frequency recovery capability of AC / DC hybrid power grid after fault accurately and quantitatively, the frequency resilience of receiving-end power grid with multi-HVDC feed-in is proposed in this paper. Firstly, simulation is carried out for different HVDC blocking faults, and the frequency variation curves after grid faults are obtained. Then, the area of the zone between the actual frequency change curve and the ideal curve during primary frequency regulation, which is defined as the index of power grid frequency resilience, is calculated. This index not only can quantitative evaluate frequency resilience, but also can be the metrics of the frequency stability improvement. In the end, the actual power grid simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: power grid with multi-HVDC feed in

articleTitle: Fault Location Method for Distribution Network Based on Synchronous Measurement
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Faults in the distribution network, especially single-phase grounding short circuit, do great harm to the distribution network. According to the fault characteristics of distribution network, a fault location method for distribution network based on synchronous measurement is proposed. By configuring micro phasor measurement unit (μPMU) on the line, the data of three-phase current is processed to form a high-dimensional matrix. The multidimensional scaling (MDS) reduces the dimensions to form a coordinate matrix. The local outlier factor (LOF) is detected to identify the fault line, and the fault location is realized. The principle of this method is simple, and the simulation results show that the application of various fault features reduces the error, which can accurately locate the fault section.

articleTitle: Analysis of the characteristics of two types of overhead transmission line ice disaster in mid-eastern China
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electricity company disaster records indicate that heavy icing loads and mild icing transmission line galloping are the two main types of ice disasters that can compromise the security of a power grid. The characteristics of these two types of ice disaster were analyzed using 20-years of historical disaster data. The results showed that heavy icing events were concentrated in the mountainous area of southern China and galloping events were concentrated in the plains area of central and northern China. Twelve representative heavy icing events and eight representative galloping events were selected and the meteorological elements and circulation characteristics of the two types of disaster were investigated using the NCEP-NCAR Reanalysis Project datasets and daily gauge observations in China. During heavy icing events, the Ural blocking high was present over the 60 - 80 ° E region, the East Asian Trough (EAT) was strong and located in an eastward direction, with a cold airmass moving along the northwest path and affecting China. This caused a significant cooling process in most parts of China, and the deep southern branch trough transported water vapor to southern China, causing precipitation. During the galloping events, the Okhotsk Sea low pressure center was deep, the EAT was strong and located in the westward direction, with a cold airmass moving along an eastern path and affecting China. This caused significant cooling and strong winds in central and northern China, while the strong and northerly western Pacific subtropical high (WPSH) caused precipitation in central and eastern China.

articleTitle: User-side photovoltaic & energy storage configuration and multi-party benefit analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the context of the “dual carbon” goal, the installation of photovoltaic energy storage systems by users can not only effectively reduce electricity bills, but also reduce the cost of purchasing carbon emission quotas for relevant users. With the increase in the proportion of photovoltaic energy storage users, the economic benefit of power grid enterprises will be affected inevitably. In order to ensure the enthusiasm of power grid enterprises to participate in carbon reduction goals, it is necessary to analyze and measure their benefits. Firstly, a user benefit calculation model is established, and with the goal of maximizing the annual comprehensive benefit of user during the photovoltaic energy storage project, an optimal configuration model of the user-side photovoltaic energy storage is established to determine the user’s configuration plan. On this basis, a benefit calculation model is established to analyze the power grid enterprise benefits from three aspects: electricity purchase and sale benefits, technical benefits and carbon emission reduction benefits. Finally, from the perspective of the whole society, the social benefits are analyzed from the aspects of low carbon, environmental protection and energy saving. Taking the typical data of various users and the modified IEEE 33-node system as example, the benefits of all parties after the photovoltaic energy storage is connected to the distribution network are calculated and analyzed to verify the accuracy and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Designation and Implement of Relay Protection Integrated with Fault Pre-warning of DC Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at this painful point that the DC circuit of the substation cannot be monitored in real time for a long time, this paper proposes a solution to add a loop current monitoring module to the DC circuit to pre-alarm abnormal loops, and integrate it into the relay protection device. Finally, the correctness of the principle and the feasibility of the scheme were verified through targeted experiments. This solution is conducive to timely and accurate detection of defects such as increased contact resistance of the switch circuit, and can effectively avoid major economic losses caused by switch refusal.
